comments: Yann's Studio was perfection: Super accessible in a most favorite Paris neighborhood. *Anything* you might look for is 5 min away or under. Two of the finest of all neighborhood bakeries are *down* the street and great little joints are all around too! Yann's thoughtfulness shows in every detail of his set up and communications and his studio is super clean, efficiently laid out and full of light. Get this apt and have a blast in Paris,and, if you do get up early early one morning, take a stroll up the stairs to the foot of Sacre Coeur and catch a glimpse of the incredible city waking up all around you, you will love it!
It was excellent – check in and out super easy. Clean, secure. Would definitley stay again and recommend.

We had a lovely time at Sophie's apartment. She couldn't be there to meet us but lovely Angelina let us in and settled us. The place is in a fab location, and we walked everywhere in the main. It's a real home and we had fun feeling like we were Parisian's for 6 glorious days. I recommend staying at Sophie's place.
Perfect location, cosy apartment and a very nice host. The perfect place to stay for a city trip to Paris.

The apartment is quiet, light and original, we loved staying here. Stairs were no problem with small bags.Very close to Metro (though we walked everywhere) and lots of bars & restaurants. Sephora was very helpful & welcoming.

This apartment is just wonderful and is particularly wonderfully situated in the middle of Montmartre. Just around the corner are many little shops; it is possible to buy very delicious french food as well as cafes and little restaurants. The metro station is easy to get to and very central for all other lines. We were together with our teenager-kids and they just loved the experience. Marie-Ann was a big help in finding our way round. Everything was very good organized. So we just can really recommend Marie-Ann and her beautiful apartment.

Staying with Isa was a great experience! She is very welcoming and helpful, eager to make her guests feel comfortable in her home. The apartment is in the BEST location, walking distance from most important sights and has easy access to public transportation(metro 5 mins. Walking). The room is cozy and provides everything needed for a visit to Paris  The house is very clean, organized and well kept.I would definitely recommend staying here.

Very nice flat! Its located in a good place, very easy and near for metro and transport. Very close to Sacre Coeur. The apartament was very clean and organized. The host was very simpatic and cool, my fiance asked him to help  to do a surprise and he helped, very friendly! The apartment is very quiet. I liked a lot!

The apartment was amazing and Sophie was incredibly kind and welcoming. She made sure to greet us on arrival, showed us around the apartment and made sure we felt comfortable and settled. Location wise, it was perfect - just few minutes walk from the heart of the Marais, close to a ton of shops and restaurants and very near Canal St. Martin. All we had to do was walk out the door and within blocks we found great food and drinks.The place is beautiful - well-decorated, spacious, great light and equipped with everything we needed. 3 of us stayed here very comfortably.I'd definitely recommend staying here and would absolutely come back.  Merci Sophie!

Chokri greeted us at the apartment, he left us a bottle of wine, and let us know we could contact him if we needed anything. The neighborhood was charming and it was easy to get to and from the metro.  I would definitely stay there again.

I trully recommend staying in that appartement. The neighborhood is nice, clean and safe and metro is very close. But above all appartement is very nice and comfortable and clean, it is exactly as on the pictures. We only met Emmanuel, who is the friendliest host I could imagine. He responds very fast on the email and helps with the tips about Paris, directions how to get somewhere, etc. Thank you for everything, when I come back to Paris I will definitly contact you if the rooms are available :)Wish you all the best, Ana

We stayed in Yanns Studio for three nights and it was very pleasant. The appartment is small, but very cozy and comfortable.. it had the perfect size for the two of us.We didn't meet Yann in person, but we wrote several messages via email and he was very helpful and everything was prepared when we arrived!I definitely recommend this place!

Benoit's apartment was absolutely fantastic - we were welcomed by his friend Kathrin and have absolutely no complaints at all. What an amazing view of the Sacre Coeur and an amazing loft apartment with loads of light, space and features. Highly recommended to all!
The appartement was perfect for our stay in Paris- clean, cosy and very well situated next to beautiful Sacre Coeur. We would recommend this stay to everyone!

we [husband and 3 adult children] had a wonderful stay in clarisses apt. The apt is beautifully done up and very comfortable, it  had everything we needed.Unfortunately we could not meet Clarisse but her lovely daughter was at the apt to meet us and full of useful information about places to go to. The apt is very well located with lots of cafes and shops close by. It was thoughtful of Clarisse to leave wine and chocolates for us we really appreciate the kind gesture, will certainly recommend to friends n family.

Yann's place was in the perfect location - right near the Sacre Coeur and metro! On the same street there was a supermarket which was helpful. We stayed in summer (early July) and it was quiet hot inside. Yann was very easy to communicate with and when one of the blinds broke he was very willing to come and fix it asap. Apartment is basically one room but perfect if you don't plan on spending much time inside.

I definitely enjoyed my stay, and Chokri was a good host.  The place is clean and looks like it does in the pictures.  The balcony was great, we always ate our meals and drank wine on it.  Paris was very hot when I was there, high 90s low 100s, but Chokri provided a fan and with the apartment being on the top floor there was a good breeze through it which made the heat bearable.  I would recommend staying at this place.

The place is small and cozy. Located in a good area that is easily accessible. Sarah was not there to meet, and the map labels the place in the wrong location, so there was some difficulty finding the place. Overall, the place is clean and a good deal for the price. In terms of hospitality, there was not much communication.

Sophie went out of her way to make sure everything was good for us even though we were uncertain of our arrival time and she was leaving for her vacation. The listing was accurate and we loved the location. Great spot for  a short 3 day visit to Paris.
Isabelle is a nice host. The house is small but very cute, and it is very convenient to visit the museums from it.

DO NOT HESITATE to rent this property, the view is crazy incredible, the  Eiffel Tower is way, way closer than it appears in the images. Forget about it not being "close" to main attraction, as taking a taxi was easy, subway minutes away, and a 15 minute walk gets you to Republic Square, which splits in several directions (2 towards sorta tourist directions)... if the weather's nice, you can walk all the way to Opera, shopping, eating, etc. along the way. We did this with my 5 year old son in toe with absolutely not complaints from him. All was super convenient and enjoyable to the point where we extended our stay. If I'm ever in Paris again, I will call this property home!

What an absolutely brilliant apartment. Simply the most incredible, all-encompassing view of Paris which words cannot describe. The apartment itself is lovely too – exposed wooden floor, bookshelves overflowing with books, a comfortable bed – you'll feel like it's your home. Book!
It's a very good trip of having such nice house,and also so convinent ,we will have stay next time surely.

Rita's apartment was a great place to stay in Paris. Her brother welcomed us on our arrival and left some food for our breakfast and a guide of the neighbourhood and the rest of paris. The apartment was clean and central

Clarisse and Eugenie made us feel entirely at home with a warm welcome in person from Eugenie, a lovely note from Clarisse and some wine and chocs.  The apartment was exactly as had been described.  It is clean and comfortable, well equipped and very conveniently located between two Metro stations.  There is a boulangerie downstairs and a small grocery store about 100m walk away.  We also enjoyed the fresh food market in the street.  This is a fantastic apartment for a family of four and Clarisse truly made us feel a little bit Parisian,
Yes, we found the place just fine and the listing was accurate. It was better than we imagined, and super clean. We had a brilliant time. It was hard to leave because of being so comfortable.
charming neighborhood uphill. A bit rough downhill. absolutely very nice and QUIET apartment with easy access to Metro. I would happily use it again.

Sophie's apartment is fantastic, an excellent place to stay for a short or extended visit to Paris.  The apartment is clean, spacious and in a very good location.  It's a short walk to the Terne metro station and not too far from a number of good restaurants, shopping and bars.  Sophie is an excellent host, checking in and out was very easy and she was always available to any questions or help with any issues that came up.Overall I would highly recommend this listing.

We were two families staying at François' accommodation for four nights. Everything was just perfect - great location (very close to the Sacre Coeur, Moulin Rouge, public transportation and lots of good shops and restaurants), very comfortable, cozy, well equipped and quiet apartments (exactly as described), François was very kind and helpful. Our flight arrived early in the morning and Francois  offered us to come to the apartment at 7am despite the fact that the time of check in is only at 1pm (free of charge). It was very nice of him and really helped us. Thank you very much, Francois. Also thanks to Sue.

The listing was entirely accurate and the apartment was ideally suited within close walking distance of all the art galleries and Sacre Coeur on Montmartre. A quiet street made for a secure and safe comfortable place to stay. Catherine welcomed us on arrival, gave us a grand tour and was always helpful in answering further questions. This is a wonderful Airbnb.

Unfortunately I could not visit Paris because of some personal problems at the last minute. However, my host Agnes was very helpful. She constantly reminded me of my travel dates and gave me detailed descriptions of the address. When I travel for the next time, I would definitely like to choose her again.

Check in was a breeze. Whilst Celine wasn't there to great us, she arranged for a smooth check in anyway. The apartment was beautiful and suited the 4 of us quite well. The view was very French and listening to the church bells was a real treat.  There are many good supermarkets close by and walking distance to a metro.

Marina's apartment was simple and perfect for our stay. It was conveniently located near the metro and in such a wonderful neighborhood of paris to walk around. Marina as a host is very nice, helpful and readily available. We felt comfortable in her home.
Our stay at Nicola's appartment was great. The flat is lovely, it looks exactly like on the pictures and we had everything we needed.Nicolas was also very responsive. Thanks a lot !!
5 stars! Had a great experience, and Benoit was quite helpful and responsive. Great neighborhood and view as advertized!

The flat is quite nice. Its location is almost perfect. The Metro-station and supermarkets are about 5 minutes away and you can get to many sights (Louvre, Opera, Sacre Coeur/Montmartre, Centre Pompidou) in 20-30 minutes by feet. The flat itself is kinda cute and perfect for a short stay, if you're supposed to spend your days in the city. It was clean, and beside the noises the bed makes, when you turn over, there's absolutly nothing to complain about. The communication with the host was on a very friendly level and worked smoothly.

Our stay at Luka and Adrien's place was nothing short of AMAZING.  Luka was a saint - He was waiting at the apartment to greet us even though we arrived 8 hours after our planned arrival.  The apartment far exceeded our expectations.  The decor was wonderful.  The mattresses were devine as were the linens.  The kitchen was very well equipped - the cappuccino maker was a nice surprise.  The apartment is VERY WELL located, with so much nearby.  All the sites were within walking distance.  The area is also filled with great places to dine and shop.  Without any reservation or hesitation we highly recommend a stay at this fabulous apartment!!

This is a nice apartment,  very small bathroom,  good location. Nice view of rooftops, not a view of streets though. We did not meet the hosts, they were very accommodating.  Even when we forgot the code to get in late at night, had to call them,they were very nice.

Mary was a very warm and welcoming hostess. The apartment was the perfect size for the three of us and we loved it. Everything was in great condition. Wonderful location- only a block from Odeon metro and numerous resturants, bakeries and shops. Apartment was simply adorable and decorated beautifully. My only issue was the five flights of stairs- I thought I was in better shape than I really am as climbing up those at the end of a long day of walking through Paris was exhausting! I highly recommend this apartment and Mary. She checked in with us throughout our trip to make sure everything was ok.

Marina is a great host - very friendly, helpful and understanding when I requested to make some changes to my plans! (Thank you Marina!)  It was lovely to stay in her apartment for the week.  It is spacious and comfortable and in a fantastic location.
Everything is perfect expect one neighbor put VERY loud rock music at 3am to 5am at the second night which made us cant sleep at all.

The apartment is a lovely private studio in the Montmartre area which is a really great part of Paris with a lot of restaurants, shops, bars right nearby. It's also only a couple minutes from a metro stop for getting to central destinations throughout Paris. I had no trouble getting into the apartment using Yann's instructions and Yann was flexible and responded quickly regarding arrival and departure time. Would highly recommend!
The appartment is very good in location, it's very new and harmful, nice place to go. Really enjoy the stay in Paris

All I have to say is, simply amazing. This is my first time using Airbnb and it was truly an amazing experience. The house is clean, and all the things that Sarah stated in the website were there. But I found it hard to find the place as the address is a bit confusing. Sarah is very attentive whenever we need help. I will most definitely return back to this beautiful home whenever I'm back in Paris. This stay recommended by my friend, Liz and Amin.

Most wonderful and safe location we could have chosen in Paris! Luca also sends over an intro PDF which was very helpful. It was in walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go or a very quick metro ride. There were a ton of restaurants, cafes, bars within a 5 minute walk. There is also a grocery store within 2 blocks.The apartment was very clean, both bedrooms were spacious. The bathrooms were very new and showers had wonderful pressure. The kitchen had everything in case you needed to cook- we went out each afternoon/night.Would highly recommend for another stay in Paris with a friend!

We had a great stay at Gilbert's place. He is a very kind and friendly host. The room is situated at the garden of the building so it's really quiet. We slept very well.Everything you need is there. Just around the corner is a beautiful park. We'll come back for sure!

The apartment was perfect, very comfortable, and the area exceeded our expectations.  It is a quiet neighborhood, very close to Metro, and plenty of restaurants and shopping close by.  We had a wonderful experience.  While the host was not there to meet us, as she was away, she went out of her way to ensure our arrival arrangements were in order and would frequently check in by email to ensure everything was fine.  I would definitely return, and I cannot thank Mireille enough for providing an excellent place for us stay to enjoy Paris.
Great location, the apartment is small, francois is great host, really helpful and nice

Loved the place! Cute studio, fairly new and well thought out with everything that was needed: nice quality appliances, countertop hangout, fixtures with a big tub, a nice big comfortable bed and a sunny balcony with rooftop view that makes up for having to walk up 5 floors with no elevator.Great location. Close to subway, supermarkets, restaurants and shops in a very nice neighborhood centrally located in Paris.Chokri is a very welcoming host, easy to communicate with. Would stay again!
Nice place, very goog location - very near Metro and RER stations. Supermarket at the entrence to the building, very convenient

This airbnb had a great location.  The place was very clean and easy to find.  The host was great.  Thy were able to let us check in a little early.  I would recommend this place to anyone visiting Paris.
Natsumi is very helpful and attentive. Two comfortable beds. The couch is not great to sleep on but we hardly spent any time inside because the neighborhood offers so much.

It was an amazing trip in Paris! The house was near the best places, I loved running every morning near the Eiffel Tower! I just realized there, the meaning: "clean" it's not the same meaning for everybody.

Joan and his partner Sophie were absolutely amazing as hosts! They went above and beyond in terms of communication and assistance. The apartment is most suited to a solo traveller, however the bed does expand to the double size if needed. The room is clean with a mini fridge, tv and microwave. The bathroom is also seperate from the main area of the house which is handy, and especially good for the value of the stay. The unit is very close to public transport and plenty of restaurants and shops. The area is safe and easily accessible. Right outside the apartment you will find laundry services and Franprix (super market).I would highly recommend future travellers to stay here. Joan and Sophie made me feel very welcome and taught me a lot about french customs and their way of life.
The place is conveniently located down the street from a main metro station that can take you all over Paris in 15-30 minutes. Lovely inside as well!
Georges apartment is an ideal place to start loving the Paris! It's very cozy, practical and comfortable. Great location near lovely Montorguel area with best fromageries and wineries! 10/10

Clarisse was an amazing host! The apartment was as pictured--clean, spacious, and with everything one would need for a longer stay (washer, fully-equipped kitchen). Clarisse was very welcoming and easy to reach the entire time. The location is great--it's away from the tourist center but everything is very easily reachable from Place de la Nation. I would definitely recommend the neighborhood and most certainly the apartment and Clarisse!
We had a lovely stay in your small, but well equiped, appartment. Public transportation is easy to reach and the neighbourhood is pretty calm.

I had a lovely stay in Marvin's apartment which is modern, well equipt, clean and quiet. It's in more of a residential area but it's very close to various metro stations so getting around Paris was easy. The area around Pyrenées is lively with little shops and bars. Marvin and his son David are very pleasant.

Joan and Sophie were amiable and easygoing hosts who made my stay in Paris really pleasant. All the facilities were clean and well managed. The place is located in a nice and safe area and has easy access to metro and bus. Highly recommended!
We had a great time in Paris. The apartment is close to the metro which is a necessity when you have two younger children.
Great location, close to Metro stop and was exactly as described. Definitely would stay here again while in Paris.

Gilbert is very friendly and flexible. When i said last minute I would arrive earlier that was not a problem. As there where no guests the day after us, Gilbert let us stay during the day to be able to take a shower after the marathon.  Merci Gilbert!

The house was well located, we loved being in the 20th as we were out of the touristy part of Paris. The apartment is close to good public transport which got us into the center of Paris very quickly. The house was clean and had everything we needed. We enjoyed our stay.
Natsumi was super friendly, easy to deal with and the apartment was great. Would definitely stay here again next time I'm in Paris.

Perfect location. A whole street of bars, cafes and restaurants just in 4 min of walk + 2 subway stations nearby 👍🏻 Hosts are very friendly and kind. Really liked the electric stove - super fast)) The apartment is equipped with everything you might need during your stay.

Excellent location. Excellent apartment. Excellent host. The experience is on par and even better than how it is advertised. It is a stylish apartment in a very central location. Alexis, the host, was helpful at every stage of the stay. Can not recommend highly enough.

This apartment was perfect for our short stay in Paris. The view of the Eiffel Tower is breathtaking and the location is perfect to walk to all of the major tourist destinations. This apartment comfortably fits two people and has everything you need for your stay. Alexis is a fantastic host who made sure we had everything we needed and even offered to arrange parking for us!
Had a great stay with Agnes! She was great at communicating and helping us get where we needed to go. The apartment is also right by a metro station so we could be anywhere very fast. Wonderful stay!

Loved our stay here! Absolutely phenomenal Eiffel Tower view and we just loved the location with fresh baked croissants nearby and quick access to the Metro. The unit is small but exactly as portrayed in photos and was perfect for my wife and I. Check-in instructions were clear and WolfWolf did everything they could to accommodate our arrival and departure times.  Highly recommend this lovely flat.

Muriel's place is amazing , exactly how it is described on the listing. It's bright, extremely clean and the view from the balcony is very special.We had a wonderful time and felt very comfortable.The area was perfect for us, walking distance from the vibrant rue Oberkampf with a lot of great restaurants.Muriel is wonderful and one of the best host I ever met and she made sure we had everything we needed. She truly loves the Airbnb experience :)We hope to come back soon!

If you're looking for the perfect Paris pad, this amazing apartment won't disappoint. It is immaculately appointed, with modern furnishings, appliances and a balcony with a gorgeous view - we felt right at home from the get go. Check in/out was a total breeze. Stephane was kind enough to help us settle in and answer all the questions we had. Plus, everything you need is just a stone's throw away, with various public transport options available and a grocery store just across the road. Thank you, Stephane and Sophie. Your hospitality made our trip truly unforgettable.

Nathalie's place is in a great position in Paris, easy for travelers to get around and a lovely vibe to the area. Comfortable with a relaxing environment all you need to enjoy Paris in a truly Parisienne way. Loved it
Yann's place is in a great location, on a quiet street, a stone's throw away from Sacre Coeur. Lots of great shops and restaurants close by to chose from as well.

The flat is in an excellent location. You really can't do much better if you like the shopping offered on Saint Germain, plus an easy 20 mi mute walk to Notre Dame and the Louvre. The host was a very timely and accurate communicator which isn't always the case with other hosts I've dealt with in the past so that's a big plus. The only reason this isn't a 5 star review is that the apartment did tended to hear up a bit and it was noisy enough on the street that opening the window got a bit noisy. But I would certainly stay here again.
It is very homey apartment, near to public transport, shops and cafe. You will feel Paris in it, I recomьend to stay here.

Alexandre's apartment is perfectly located in a roaring area. We arrived at Gare de l'Est, which is only a few minutes walk away. The neighborhood is quite lively, there are lots of bars, restaurants and down the street you can find a tiny supermarket where you can buy everything you need at almost every time of day or night. As soon as you're in the apartment you don't hear anything that's going on on the streets. Although the place is very small itself, we didn't miss anything. The existing space is used optimally and well appointed with tasteful furnishings. Everything was perfectly clean and Alexandre himself was a great host. He welcomed us warmly, recommended us wonderful places to go and even explained us where to find the next Vélib station to rent bicycles - which is the best way to discover the city. We'd love to come back whenever we visit Paris!
Beautiful property - very well maintained. The location is perfect; near the subway, trains, monoprix (massive supermarket), Sacre Couer and lots of restaurants.

Amazing house, our family(6 adults and 1 kid)all loved the house, 2 mins walking to metro line 9, even located in the centre(close to Bastille), the house is quiet and clean. Nicole is a nice host and always ready to help. We will come back for sure.

Cute little quaint place in very sought after St-Germain Des Pres.  Location, location, location.  Beware of no A/C and street can be loud at night with the windows openOtherwise has all the necessities

Our family of 5 just stayed at Christine's apt. She was a wonderful host, she helped me and the little girls get into the apt with all our luggage because my husband had to keep going and return our car. The place was big enough for all of us and it had exactly what we needed. The kids loved the top bunk and the games. I loved the location, it is very central with a bakery right next door and walking distance to Sainte Chapelle and the other sites near by. It was great for our first visit to Paris.
Stephan is a great person, very kind and warm...he´s apartment is wonderful, well decorated and ubicated in a very nice neiborghood, near the principal points of interest in Paris.

The view of the Eiffel Tower is worth every penny! The apartment is a little east of the tourist attractions, but there is a metro station close by with cafes and bakeries just around the corner! We didn't have any trouble getting to where we wanted to go. And did I mention the view was worth it?! The aparement is clean and comfortable. I would highly recommend staying here.
What a wonderful location in a wonderful part of town. The metro station was just around the corner and the best food in the city surrounds the apartment. I hope to make it back again someday.

Christine is very nice and will show you around her place/how to use everything. There were plenty of places to sleep. There is no A/C, but with the windows open at night it does cool down quite a bit. There is a very good small bakery down the street. There was an issue with a pipe and the water on our last day, but Christine communicated with us well and even offered to treat us to some cocktails. Overall it was a great place to stay.
Value for money.Private room with attached terrace garden.Spacious bathroom.Host's English is not good ,however he make sure we don't faca any problem.Overall great stay..
A quaint apartment in a great location.  François was very hospitable and helpful with advice on our arrival. Great place.
Marie was very easy to communicate and the apartment was in excellent distance to a subway station. Very clean and convenient apartment.

5 stars for the location. restaurants, bars, boulangeries and groceries are about a block away. metro stops are within a 10 minute walk.we rented both units for 6 people. the space is not large but comfortably fit all of us. the units are in separate courtyards and connected by a short set of stairs. travel time between both = about 15 seconds (according to my 7-year old). the nespresso machine was a bonus.be careful not to lock yourself out. there are signs posted in both units saying don't leave the keys in the doors. the signs should also say always bring your keys with you or leave them in the lock boxes. the doors to both auto-lock and can't be opened from the outside without keys. the locksmith cost for us was 150 euros.

It was a perfect place to stay. First of all there was a great communication between us and the hosts. The apartment had the perfect location and made us feel close to everything. Everything was clean and nice, as on the pictures shown.So overall a perfect stay!

Chachou's place is very clean and has a great bathroom and kitchen. It has air conditioning which is also a plus. We arrived a little earlier than we planned and so they were still cleaning the apartment when we got there but they allowed us to leave our bags and go walk around for a little bit. The only downside is that the apartment is not as close to the monuments, museums, and restaurants as we would have thought so we ended up walking pretty far to get to those. Overall, great stay!
Great host. Quick response to our needs. Great location in Paris. Perfect so long as the temperature outside doesn't get too high.
Alexandre is a great host! The apartment is really lovely. Great location for the metro and local shops and bars. We would definitely recommend Alexandre and his home :)
Ana was incredibly friendly and accommodating. Had a great stay and will look for this place again next time I'm in Paris. Highly recommend!
Had a little miscommunication at first but the apartment is really nice so it didn't matter. Very charming apartment. Very good job Gilbert I am impressed. Hope to come back

Gilbert as a host was really nice and friendly. Breakfast was always nice and set from the previous night. The room was cozy, and Gilbert even provided us with a radiator. The place is located in a quiet and nice area. There are three supermarkets nearby and two bakeries. The metro is close enough to the flat. I would definitely recommend Gilbert's place.

Excellent choice and excellent host! Five of five stars. The flat is as described and with the big windows even a bit prettier than in the pictures.  Everything is there, great location, very clean and all but one of the best things was that Yann really took his time and always responded promptly and helped us out with our questions before we arrived and after, which made check-in/-out and our stay a breeze. Great! Merci beaucoup, Yann!

Fantastic apartment for our family, close to everything, great shops and café nearby.  Apartment had everything we needed and more.  Bruno was very friendly and helpful, welcoming us and providing useful tips.  Would recommend this place to everyone

Clean, fresh apartment in a well connected neighbourhood. It was nice to be in a residential area where children were playing on the footpath. The apartment is quiet and peaceful, not huge but it has everything you need. One note is that the "shower" is just a hand held attachment in the bath - can be tricky.

This apartment is truly beautiful, furnished with great taste and equipped with all the amenities. The location is even better, just minutes away from shops, restaurants and bars, but located in an internal court away from noise. Communication was fast and the check in was easy. We were there with our 2 sons and a new born, a cot was made available to us. We didn’t meet with Adrien or Luka but their friend who met us was very helpful and accomodating. I would recommend this apartment to families with older children, couples and people on business.

Great apartment. Two blocks away from the subway and walking distance (20 min walking max) of many attractions....the area was great also...Eiffel tower 5 min away, supermarkets and restaurants nearby...Chachou was very attentive and responded super quickly. Definitely recommended!!!

Ana communication was great from the beginning, she was very attentive and helpful during our stay in Paris. The place is absolutely nice and well equipped, very well located. It is clean and bright! I recommend it to anyone who visits Paris!

First class stay all the way!  Like a first class hotel room but with a kitchen and a deep bath tub. Very comfortable king size bed and the neighborhood is outstanding. Near the metro. You can go anywhere to paris from here. The stairs is not really that tiring. The balcony offers outstanding view . What more can you ask for? Everything is here, in this flat.

Great place to stay with the nicest hostess, very patient and kind. The place is very clean and everything is thought out for the guest. Location is perfect, only a few minutes from the metro and or bar/ cafe. Recommend this place to anyone looking for convenience and prefers a nice place to stay while visiting Paris.
Great location, wonderful host and clean. This is a great spot if you are in need of two bedrooms.

Yann was an awesome host! Place was clean and tidy, very central and great access to public transport! Was a small place, but is perfect for those who are out all day and want to come back to relax. Highly recommend especially value for money wise!
Wolfwolf was a delight to deal with and the apartment is super convenient and the view is a postcard.

The location is wonderful, the apartment is spacious. Centrally located to the Lourve and Markets!But there was a leak, and they didn't fix it when asked. We had to spend out limit resources to ensure the entire bathroom wasn't flooded.If I come back to Paris, this will not likely be my choice of accommodation again

Me and my sister had a really good time at Majid apartment. The location is great, very quite neighbourhood with supermarkets nearby and well connected and close to the centre. Majid is very kind and always available if you need anything. I would highly recomment it!

Amazing apartment, fully equipped with all you need for a perfect stay. You will not find someones clothes and other belongings like many other airbnb places. It is simple, stylish and extremely (!!) clean which was very important for me. Lovely neighborhood around with many nice small caffes and restaurants. I would definitely recommend this place and stay here myself again and again. Thank you Thomas!

We had a fantastic stay in Georges and Sylvie’s apartment. The location is perfect for seeing the tourist attractions. The neighbourhood is lively with lots of bars and restaurants nearby. The street and apartment block are quiet. Communication and check- in was absolutely perfect. The apartment was immaculate and stylish. The bed is very comfortable. We had everything we needed to make ourselves at home and there were lovely extra touches like coffee and toiletries. One of our best ever Airbnb experiences. Thank you Georges and Sylvie.

Amazing place in the Heart of the Marais.  Very romantic with a balcony view. This is by far the best air bnb we have stayed in Paris.Now, as everyone else mentioned, there are 98 stairs (not that we counted) or 6 flights of stairs.  This might deter some people but it is worth the climb.  Our host was very helpful and the bottle of wine was a nice touch. The rain shower was also amazing. Can’t say enough about how much we enjoyed the flat. Will stay here again and again if we get the chance
We had a wonderful time, there were 4 of us and the space was perfect for us. A nice 20 min walk to the eiffel tower and local bus and metro close by!
Aurelie’s place is wonderful and superbly located to explore Paris. The apartment is beautiful and full of character. We would highly recommend.

This place is such a great deal in Paris with a caring and helpful host. Located in a cool neighborhood, close to pretty much everything. Alexandre is for sure one of the most thoughtful hosts I've ever met. Helped me with a big concern when we arrived, and made sure our trip was perfect. Once again - thank you Alexandre.

The apartment was nice, as expected- warm, very well organized and equipped; very well located; but Vincent was more than nice - he went some extra mile to assist us on our stay - beginning from the very late check-in throughout the visit. So - thanks Vincent.

This apartment was exactly as advertised, quiet location but close to everything you need. Check in was really easy and communication during the booking process was clear and promptIt is a short walk to Notre Dame and there are plenty of good places to eat close by. There are two small supermarkets within 2 mins if you need to stock up on supplies.St Michel station is 5 mins away for the RER and there is a metro station just around the corner which made things easy A really good find!

Location is amazing! 2 blocks from the metro (line 8), walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and Invalides. It's a studio apartment but good size for 2 people and really nice. It can be a little bit noisy during the night as it is in the first floor but not terribly noisy.

Gilbert house is extremely clean and is way better in reality than the Airbnb pictures! He’s an extremely warm host, our flight got delayed and we reached late night, but he warmly welcomed us! Location is great as well with good eateries nearby. He was thoughtful enough to put up a breakfast spread for us too! Would definitely recommend his place to everyone :) Thank you Gilbert

The apartment is located perfectly, 10 min walk to the Eiffel Tower. The apartment has everything, it is completed as for myself. I really liked the sink for two. Separately, I would like to note the fresh repair, a good mattress on the bed, excellent bed linen, beautiful dishes. There is a coffee machine, washing machine, microwave, hairdryer, iron. There are three beds 2 + 1, so the apartment is suitable for everyone: singles, couples, couples with a child, two friends. The house has a clean entrance and a cozy patio. David is a very hospitable host, I want to return here again.

Mireille’s place is cute, clean, safe and the perfect space for 2 people. The location is perfect! You can walk to the subway or to the metro. A block away is a pedestrian street full of food markets, bakeries, restaurants and bars. There’s also a grocery store a block away. All the tourist stops are only 20-30 min away by train. We would stay at Mireille’s the next time we are in Paris for sure! She is a great host and very accommodating!

Every stellar review I read about Hannelore’s place is true.  She is a lovely lady.  I only wish we had visited with her and her husband more, but we all tended to be out and about most of the time.The apartment is very nice, well decorated, and is kept extremely clean and is within a few blocks of the metro stop.The mattress on the bed is extremely comfortable, but as one other reviewer wrote, the top of the mattress is low to the ground which can make getting out of bed a greater challenge than usual.I whole-heartedly recommend this place and I hope I get a chance to stay there again!P.S. - About a half block before you reach the apartment from the metro on the other side of the street is a place to buy pastries.  Try the almond covered one.
Ana's place is conviently located to many metro lines and is in a quiet, residential street. Ana was a wonderful host and very communicative during check in/out.
Fantastic location, which also means it can be a bit noisy if you like to sleep with the windows open! It’s a huge apartment for Paris, and we enjoyed the space!
Very comfortable, spacious and beautifully laid out.  Lots of storage and all the appliances worked well.  Vitalina was available via messaging whenever we needed her.
Great place but you should know that it is above a very popular bar that stays open late. They get loud in Paris in the evenings. Cheers

The apartment is cosy and clean, and the location is good. Charming neighborhood, many restaurants and shops nearby. Catherine is a great host, very friendly and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment.
It is cozy house with great eiffel view! I can feel kinda french mood here ☺️

I highly recommend this place! Our family stayed here for 4 days while visiting Paris. The apartment is so unique with a truly amazing view of Paris. We enjoyed some beautiful sunsets! It's a great location for buses and metro to explore the rest of the city and the neighbourhood itself is very fun. Benoit and Bertille were super kind and thoughtful hosts with helpful tips for exploring the city. Very communicative and professional.
Good apartment if you travel as two families/groups and want a bit of independence. We loved the location with lots of bars and cafes near by. Metro is very close too making discovering Paris easy.
Isabelle and her son are extremely friendly. They were both very accommodating. Isabelle even let me keep my suitcases there after checkout, a huge lifesaver.

Wonderful place to stay with family. Great hospitality. Very clean house, organised and comfortable. Very close to transport and to everything. 20 minutes from metro for the touristic points. Thank you!! We loved.

Chloé's apartment is in a very nice location, a few steps from attractions in Montmartre and very close to the metro. It was very clean. And, Chloé was very responsive and flexible with check in/check out times.
Fantastic apartment!!!!!  HIGHLY recommend this apartment based on cleanliness, location, and service by owner.
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay here, sadly only 1 night, but with the amazing view, hospitality and location of the apartment it would’ve been easy to stay there for weeks on end!

Staying with Isabelle is like staying with family. She is warm and sincere and goes out of her way to make you comfortable. Her sons are also incredibly nice and helpful as well. I highly recommend Isabelle for anyone who wants more of a true Parisian family experience instead of a sterile, boring hotel.
Sparkling clean, very modern apartment in a nice area of Paris! Daily cleaning service was excellent and nice touches on arrival. I would highly recommend this host!

We had a nice stay in Jean's place. Within walking distance to many attractions and to the Metro. One reviewer mentioned the bustling night life. That is true, but it did not have an effect on our sleep with the windows closed.

The apartment is great especially the location. It’s decorated like a museum and is very clean. One cons is that the apartment do not have air conditioners as the temperature is 37 degree in day time when we travel, however it’s ok at night.  Other than this, everything is super.

This flat is in an exciting neighbourhood full of shops, restaurants, cafes and museums. The Moulin Rouge is down the street and it’s lively every night. I highly recommend it, especially with the pleasure of a balcony included.

My third time to stay & each time just as perfect.  The accommodation is really comfortable & private, separated from the family apartment.  Julien is a well-deserved 'superhost'.  A lovely area of Paris too, easy walking distance to metro lines 3, 2 & 13 & lots of cafes, restaurants, shops (incl.  convenience stores) right on your doorstep!  Looking forward to visit no.  4!  Highly recommended.  Thank you.

Comfortable and everything you need in this studio! Ana was quick to respond and we had a great experience. The apartment is near the Nation metro which connects to everything and there's a supermarket down the street. Very convenient!
Great apartment with beautiful light! contemporary bathroom. Strong wifi connection. Comfy bed. And very close to Metro! I would definitely stay here again!

Alexis should be awarded a Superhost plus award! A fabulous stay from start to finish. Excellent communication and nothing too much trouble. Early check in and late check out really did make all the difference!The apartment is beautiful and the balcony was perfect for morning and afternoon drinks. Nespresso machine meant we felt very at home. The bed was super comfortable, the best sleep I’ve had in months. Alexis is lovely and warm and nothing was too much trouble. Thank you again.
An amazing location. So near a subway in an amazing neighborhood. Would love to return to this apartment and neighborhood again.

Very clean apartment with three full sized bedrooms in a good location, close to the metro. Breakfast was delivered daily - a lovely touch. Jean-Daniel is an excellent host who responds very quickly to any questions.

This location is close to the Metro Line and close to the grocery stores as well. We woke up and would normally grab some food at the nearby bakeries or the grocery store in the mornings before heading down the Metro.

Very well situated.  Very well appointed apartment.  It is important to know that this apartment is Celine's home, it is not a rental unit.  Guests should be prepared to be careful in the use of all amenities, such as cookware, knives, plates.  Some people may not be ready for this.
Great place in a great location, with a good plaza down the street for food and drinks. Ultra modern loft.
nice surrounding, easy to reach, pretty quiet at the 7th stock. Entrance via her own place, but that was ok as well. I can recommend the place

Our stay at Ulysee's place was fantastic. Anne was very accomodating allowing us to leave our bag with them so as we could get to an exhibition early of our check in time. When we checked in the flat really did have the wow factor, a really beautifully decorated and cool flat. Locationwise its a 5 minute walk from Notre Damm Cathedral, it has a little market just down the road which was great. If you come out the flat and head left up the road towards the church Saint Etienne Du Mont there are some really cool bars, we really liked one called Le Piano Vache.We really enjoyed our stay at Ulysee's flat and would definatley like to stay here again one day for longer.

This was a perfect stay, we were 3 couples doing a weekend of cultural and gastronomic pleasures. All the three rooms were spacious and clean. Everything was clean in fact! Jean-Daniel the host was warm and informative! Highly recommended!

Philippe was very responsive from the beginning. He answered all our special requests and was very attentive to our needs. His nice assistant received us upon arrival and gave us time to refresh after the flight even though we came before agreed. The place was clean and spotless. Large two rooms with a separate bathroom. Plenty of extra beddings and towels. The neighborhood is fantastic - the chicest part of Paris, with small boulongeries and the most famous ice cream. The island itself is very quiet but just a walk to all the bars and cafes. Our vacation was marvelous. Thank you, Philippe!!!

Very lovely and cozy space, you enter a beautiful patio or courtyard and the feel of the place is soo nice and inviting, the rooms, bathrooms, kitchen  felt very comfortable, only the stairs made it a bit complicated.

the room is quite clean and tidy,  equipments are easy to use.  The bed sleeps well .The location is very good, it is very convenient to go anywhere, there are a few steps from the subway station, there are many shops downstairs, the restaurant is still at 10 o'clock in the evening, and the convenience store is also 24 hours. Totally, a perfect place to live in Paris. I want to  live again in the future !

다른데 볼 필요 없다. 하루빨리 여길 선택하라. She is professional host. Everything is perfect as I expected. Location is perfect and safe.And, I was little sick , but I cleary recovered becasue of advil,cold pills they gived to me very quickly.

Emmanuel's place was lovely. Easy check-in with Ronald, super clean, well located, comfortable in every respect and a few lovely touches to make you feel immediately at home. We enjoyed it. I'd recommend to anyone, Phil

Mr.Jean-François is so nice! He is very friendly! He carefully prepared all the things what you need in daily life. His house is clean and beautiful. His room's deco is so cool and so Paris. Everything is perfect. I think that it is a really good choice to live in his house. : )

The flat is located in a very good place for tourists, the metro is close (6-7 minutes by walk). The room is well taken care off and elegant, you will see that there are several details that makes it appealing. we had no problems and Gilbert is a kind person, if you have questions he will be available. Merci!
Very modern and practical. Thank you for hosting us. We had a great time. Xx

My husband and I stayed for a week and this place was great. Fantastic location, clean and modern. It’s less than 2 blocks away from the metro so it’s easy to get around the city. The location felt safe at all hours. The bed was comfy, the bathroom was very modern and had a towel warmer and the kitchen was fully equipped. This was my husbands first air bnb experience and he really enjoyed it. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Fabulous location right around the corner from Sacre Coeur and close to three different metro lines which provided a lot of flexibility in transportation through Paris. The room is simple but we didn’t need anything more than that, since we were touring Paris during the day and only staying there at night. Don’t expect any frills but for the price we paid it was decent. Would recommend to those traveling on a budget who are okay with the bare minimum.
Quite delightful! A little less spacious than expected, but really great location and fully supports five people!

This apartment is in a superb location close to the centre, river, buses, shops, restaurants, etc.   Being on the ground floor in an inner courtyard means that it lacks daylight a bit, but there are plenty of lights inside, and the apartment is secure behind two gates and a front door.  It is very quiet.  The bed was very comfortable and the kitchen well equipped.
Sophie's welcome and Sophie's place is 5-star all the way.  I feel very comfortable in the apartment.  It was beautiful, spacious with high ceiling and tons of natural light.  Highly recommend.
The best location!! So close to the Eiffel Tower and cafes! A very cool flat but be sure to take toiletries with you.
Adams Paris apartment is a gem ,everything you need in the way of amenities to feel like home. Steps away to all the sites and metro line close by. Perfect location!

Great flat in a quite backyard, close to montmartre and good connected by metro. Clean & well equipped. We would definitely come back! Alain was super friendly, answered within 5 minutes and had helpful recommendations.

The apartment is well appointed with most of what is needed. The main bed (queen) is very comfortable although the sofa bed less so.  There was plenty of ice and cold water available which was wonderful on the very warm days we had. The apartment is close to great restaurants, some shops, cafes and the Metro. Melody was very helpful and responds quickly. 😀
This space is perfect for 2 people and in the middle of so many great restaurants and shops. I would definitely visit again!

Yann's place is great to stay in; it's close to the metro, in a very nice neighborhood with cafe's and bakeries all around, and the bed is very comfortable!If you plan to stay here during a holiday we highly recommend bringing ear plugs; we stayed over the Labour Day holiday and I think the bar below the apartment didn't quiet down until around 5am --- I believe this is normal, but if you sleep with the windows open and don't have ear plugs you might not get much shut eye (we came prepared though).Overall, it was a great stay!Thanks Yann

Colette's place is very nice, she is a very sweet and welcoming lady, a Parisian artist.The bedroom is big, very luminous, with its enclosed nice bathroom.The house is in a very nice enclosed court, really beautiful and very quiet.From here it is really nice to enjoy one of the few arrondissement not full of tourists, but still very close to the center.Overall my staying was good, however I did not appreciate the fact that one night, while I was away in my hometown for few days, her daughter slept in my bed where all my belongings where kept, and she did not tell me in advance, but had to find out and did not apologise for it either.

Thank you for everything, Guy!  Thanks to your place we really enjoyed our stay in Paris. The flat is in great area, it takes only ten minutes to eiffel tower, metro is 2 minutes away, so the location is perfect! You will find in the apartment everything what you need, it’s very cosy and clean.
This flat is the perfect place to be in Paris. Clean and modern.Alexis also gave us some valuable tips.Is one of the best hosts I've had.
Marianne is the best hostess I have ever met. It was like to be at home. Thanks for all Marianne. The room is really confortable and paceful.

A gorgeous apartment, with lovely amenities, a bottle of wine upon arrival and a gorgeous flower filled terrace to drink it on. Clean and a wonderful shower!!! The neighborhood is great and close to two metro stops. Emmanuel answered every email quickly. We’d definitely stay at Emmanuel’s apartment again.

Amazing place, easy check-in, great communication, sparkling clean, and such a great location.  What more could anyone ask for?! Everything was planned with great care and made my stay in Paris unforgettable.  I will come back to this place again and again!

Francine’s apartment was so beautiful and ideally located. Her private garden is immaculate and adds so much more. She has a love or art and architecture which shows beautifully in her apartment. It was a wonderful treat to stay there.
We loved Alexis’ place so much! The space was modern, clean, and beautiful. Location was great and Alexis was such a cool host!
it was a great stay and location was good too.Apart was clean with basic amenities.
A charming space perfect for a stopover in Paris. The high ceilings and chic decor make this a wonderful choice for anyone desiring a centrally located apartment.

This flat is in an ideal location - close to shopping, restaurants, metro and the Louvre. It was also clean and well appointed.  The kitchen and bathrooms are modern.  Our host was gracious and quick to answer all our questions.  Would highly recommend.

Everything was great, Jordan was very responsive and sociable.  I was delayed in arriving from the airport, but he waited until I arrived.  The apartment has everything you need.  The location is excellent, metro and other transport is very convenient, grocery stores nearby.  Jordan was always in touch and answered all requests quickly.  Thanks, Jordan!Paris is my love!!!

This home is spectacular and a worthy splurge for a trip to the fabulous capital city of Paris. It was a wonderful retreat from areas packed with tourists and an easy commute to all the desired sights. This incredibly stylish home enhanced our visit!
Highly recommend - Great location and apartment is as pictured. A/C units throughout the entire apartment. HighStay was quick to respond to all of my questions. Would stay here again!

Peggy's place was great! The rooms were very stylish and the apartment had everything we needed. Six guests fit comfortably and the 1.5 bathrooms were very useful. The apartment is located right near a metro stop so traveling around Paris was very simple.
Location is amazing. Super close to the metro and you can be anywhere in Paris in 30 to 40 minutes. The little town is super cute and has lots of places to visit.
What a great house, location and garden -we really felt Parisian!  Jeanne is a great host and made us feel really welcome.  Merci beaucoup!
Had an awesome stay! Great hosts, the view is amazing! Really quick walk to Eiffel Tower, very close to everything.

This apartment was perfect for our party of 6. Mathieu was very responsive and easy to communicate with. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. There are two nearby Metro stops and it is possible to walk to the attractions. Mathieu was very thoughtful and brought an extra fan during the very hot week in Paris. There are nearby grocery stores that are convenient. We had a great stay.

Location, location, location. This is a wonderful apartment with lots of great amenities but the best thing was the location, just steps off Rue Mouffetard in the Latin Quarter (picture a windy, pedestrian-only, cobblestone street with lots of little shops and bistros). We loved being able to step out 20 feet to the amazing bakery, cheese shop, wine shop, and bistro right there!  We also heard from locals that the pizza place next store is great but we never got to try it. The apartment itself was great! It had everything you needed, and the a/c and the washer and dryer were very much appreciated! The shower and bathtub were huge! It was also nice to have two toilets. Beds were comfortable as well.Mai was also very helpful and available via phone when we had an issue retrieving the key (it was no big deal and resolved quickly). Wish we could have stayed longer!
Great location for a business trip or travelers who like to be in the center of everything. The place was just perfect for a week-long stay!
Very nice and spacious apartment and excellent host. Sophie was just an unbelievable host. Thank you Sophie.
Great apartment in the perfect location to explore Paris. Beautiful views comfortable beds delicious pillows. Wifi worked well for my business calls

The host is excellent and helpful. The place looks better than the photos. It’s large and comfortable. We have a very good stay and we will come back. It’s 3 mins walk from Goncourt; 10 mins to République which can connect you to most places.

Would highly recommend this place! Very close to the metro and located in a beautiful neighborhood that is not too touristy. Language barrier was an issue, but we managed! The flat is beautiful and Gilbert had breakfast ready every morning. Loved it!

The apartment is very spacious, like really big. It is in old, well kept building with very high ceilings, I just adore them. The access is secured by two locked doors, from which we had a key. Metro 1 is just a few steps away. The apartment is having a unique character, very French. Around the corner is congress mall - where there is a really good upscale grocery shop and some nice clothing shops.  It has all the needed amenities and more.We had a great stay!
Our family of four stayed here. Great location, nearby bakery and stores. Close to transportation by metro or bus.
Bertrand was a great host during my stay in Paris. The Airbnb location is very convenient and easy to get around. Overall, the Airbnb was clean and very spacious!

I stayed here with three other people and it was very comfortable and was in a great area. When I come back to Paris I would definitely stay here again! It was close to many cafes, grocery stores, and the river. The space itself was also great to be in and made our stay amazing.

Mai's place has a great location.  The metro is very close and the flat is convenient for sight seeing in Paris.  She is very easy to communicate with and well organized.   Her directions were very helpful and she even had a French translation that we could give to the taxi driver.
It is a good place to stay with your family or friends, good price, accessible location, it is not next to Eiffel Tower but for the price is very fair.

Peggy’s place is so great!! 3 bedrooms are hard to find in Paris and this was just so beautiful and sparkling clean. From the outside the building doesn’t look like much but don’t worry it’s great inside. The neighborhood has some really lovely  hidden gems. Peggy’s recommendations are spot on, we also recommend Gaston’s as well. 😊 Next time I’m in Paris I would stay at Peggy’s again.

Julien is a wonderful host! From his welcoming to the amazing accomodation, my stay was perfect. The room is lovely and very convenient as Julien put lots of useful equipment (towel, coffee, tea, hygiene and beauty products). The neighbourhood is quiet, well connected to  public transportation and has many different options for dinner. I would definitely recommend a stay at Julien's.
Great location and wonderful terrace to enjoy your morning coffee. Chokri’s place has everything you need.

The apartment is really nice and comfortable, location is very convenient. Julien was very kind and friendly, always ready to help and left nice tips about the local area. This room is definitely wonderful place to stay.
This flat is so well placed being 400m from the main square. The entrance is via spiral wooden staircase but opens into quite a large living space with great views and so close to the amenities.
Marie was very helpful and responded quickly to any questions I had. The apartment is really nice and very well located, I had no issues at all during my stay!
This is a really beautiful, charming studio, feeling Paris in its best: unexpected silence to sleep, wonderful neighborhood and perfect tips from a really generous and helpful host.

Isabelle was a friendly and pleasant host, easy to talk to. The location is unbeatable- I walked to all the places I wanted to visit. The place was very clean. Having a kitchen to use was very convenient.

Amazing apartment in an amazing location. Far exceeded our expectations and made our trip to Paris easy and comfortable. Sophie is extremely responsive and the apartment is everything we could have hoped for. Location cannot be beat.
Amazing location and very safe. Close to metro and restaurants. Perfect space for 2-3 people.
This flat was in the perfect location with a lot to do. The place was clean and very cute. We had a great time.

Sophie's place was better than the photos posted. It was clean and well decorated and had no difficulty staying three people. It wasn't easy to climb the stairs to the third floor, but we had strong legs. Older people or those with a lot of luggage can be difficult. Sophie always cared during our stay. The major locations of Marais are ten minutes away and there are three subway stations nearby. I was lucky to be able to stay at Sophie's place. Thank you again, Sophie!
Staying at Gilbert's place was amazing. A beautiful apartment, super clean, comfortable bed. Gilbert goes way beyond the norm in being helpful in every way.  Hope to come back soon!
Beautiful apartment, safe location and Perfect for restaurants, shopping and access to the Metro. We had a wonderful time and enjoyed our stay very much

This apartment is an absolute dream for two people, the sofa bed would be fine for kids. It’s quintessential Paris, just walk away from the traffic and you find hidden gems in a beautiful neighbourhood.

The best value for money appartment I've rented. Decent location with metro within a two minutes walk. Only apt at that floor and elevator straight to the door. Felt secure. No problems with check in and -out. We were a family of four for three nights, and the  space was no problem (mainly sleeping there, no eating). Nice bathroom facility.Would definitely recommend!

Vincent was a great host, the apartment was very nice, well equipped with everything even a welcome bottle of wine! He was very responsive, checked in on me several times. I will come back to 20 Rue de Buci.
Beautiful home, and perfect location walkable to everything you want in Paris. Lovely hosts, made us and our baby feel right at home with a pack & play and toys! Loved our stay!

Alexandre's place is superb! Easy and effective communication with the host, the place is very conveniently located and it is really super clean. The host spent some time to give some tips about transportation and amenities and he gave me the opportunity to leave my bag at the apartment before leaving Paris. Recommended for sure!

My toddler, husband and I stayed at Clarisse’s house. We all loved it! She had a cot, changing facilities for the little one as well as a bath. She left us chocolate, wine and lots of tourist information, as well as answered any questions we had throughout our stay. We loved the location and if we visit Paris again, we’ll be back.Thank you Clarisse

Nicolas' apartment is located on a quiet street in the 14th Arrondissement.  The location is convenient and within 10 minutes walking to a major metro stop.  The apartment itself was very clean and well laid out and Nicolas was a great host, providing good communication and travel tips.  Would highly recommend.

Gilbert had been very professional on home stay. He used voice translation application to communicate with us in English as we don't understand French. He had been flexible with our check-in, and check-out times. Location is also great. The house seems to be historic building with big doors, and construction, but facilities are modern. Great place to stay. Gilbert is kind, friendly, and understanding.

Not worth this amount of money on my opinion:1. Cleaning wasn't made before our arrival2. It is not spacious as it seems from photos, 2 beds stand just in front of each other and separated with blind. So it won't be comfortable for 4 people.3. It is 1 floor without any sun lightBut I must say it has also pros: good location, kitchen fully equipped
One of my best AirBNB experiences ever!  Mai is awesome and this flat is perfect.  And the location is second to none.

I’ve had a perfect stay at Julien’s place. The check-in and overall communication was perfectly easy. The room as well as the area provide everything that you need. Even though you live in the same flat, you have your own space and a lot of privacy. I would definitely come back, merci beaucoup!
This is a large, three bedroom suite with a very nice full bathroom, and a secondary water closet; a clean, modern and spacious suite, easily accommodating the five adults in our group.

The apartment is spacious, with lots of natural light and great views. The location is perfect, with shopping, restaurants, and tourists points of interest all within walking distance. My favorite thing was the bed!!! One of the most comfortable beds I have ever slept in. I would definitely stay here again next time I am in Paris.

The location of this apartment is really spectacular. Close to everything, and close to the metro if needed. We really enjoyed walking around the neighborhood. The apartment is cozy and charming. The many flights of stairs were a bit troublesome only with luggage or after a long day of walking. We had an issue with WiFi when we first arrived that was quickly resolved which we very much appreciated. The hosts were quick to communicate and offer help and tips. Overall a great place to stay in a great area of Paris!!!
Close to RER B, Metro and Catacomb. The room is clean and perfectly fit for 4 people.

The room was impeccable, the location was chic, safe and close to the center, there is absolutely nothing to say - I really enjoyed my stay. If you are lucky enough to be able to stay at Suzie's, please be respectful and kind to her, as much as she is with us - she is a gem. 200% recommend this place. Incredible bang for the buck in the heart of Paris.
Very central apartment and Julien was a great host. My only criticism is that the apartment wasn’t as clean as I would’ve liked.
Exactly as it looks in the photos, clean lovely space. Only one loo, but actually for one night, really not a problem!
We had a lovely stay in Tristan’s apartment. We were their during the strike, and Tristan did everything he could to make our trip to Paris a bit easier.
Anne and Ulysse made our family of 5 feel very welcome. Great location, homely, very Parisian decor and warm hosts.
We had great time in Paris, when we have some problems or questions, Kathleen always so kindly and friendly give us suggestions. Highly recommend this place to everyone!

The location is wonderful. Easy access to metro and Grandes Magasins. Apartment is up 3 floors with no lift so not good for low mobility or heavy luggage. In general apartment is a bit tired and needs a de-clutter and spring clean. Communication is good although basic and no information shared on local area amenity or things like how to dispose of garbage. Ok for a short 3 /4 day stay as location is excellent.

Chokri’s apartment is in one of the best locations in Paris, from the easy access to shopping and the sites, to the ease of having everything you need in the apartment, it was a winner from start to finish. Chokri was super easy to deal with, and very prompt to reply, helping us out with our early arrival in the bitter cold. 10/10 recommend.

The perfect place to stay in Paris. Walking distance to everything. The bars and shops just around the block are fabulous. Lots of stairs!! If your at all impaired you should know the apartments are down a few staircases. A few steps did just allowed for more fresh baked goods. 😂
Amazing location! Julien is super nice, he helped us with our luggage and contacted a shuttle to the airport for us! His tips are amazing, really nice apartment! Fully recommended

Overall we enjoyed our stay and would recommend Georges’ lovely apartment. It was warm and bright, and there were a lot of personal touches throughout, including original art. The Nespresso machine, washing machine and spacious shower were all a benefit.

The location is excellent with easy access to metro and bus services. Also the local area has many restaurants, specialty food stores and supermarkets making it very easy for all types of catering. Having the two apartments is great for family groups travelling together. We had a wonderful time staying here.
Very nice and clean space at a good location in Paris. Eleanor was very responsive to any query I had and the check in process was smooth.

Here is a very good choice for Paris, it is cozy and clean.  Julien and his wife prepared some food in the room.  I lived in Paris for ten days and the room was in a very quiet neighborhood with local residents nearby.  It is safe and convenient.  You can go anywhere in Paris by public transport.  I would recommend it here.
You just feel welcome and like home in Sophies place. Perfect area full of small and nice cosy bars and restaurants. We can just highly recomend this beautiful place.

France was such a nice and welcoming host! The apartment was beautiful and in such an incredible location! (5 min walk from the Louvre) We had such a nice time and would recommend it to anyone visiting Paris!
She was just great!! Pretty helpful and kind! The localisation is great and the space is amazing also.I really recommend

Super Charming place. Enjoyed our stay a lot. Although there was a misunderstanding with the host about the piano and noise complaints incident one night. We did our best to communicate at our best and apologized regardless
We love Sophie’s place!  This was our second time staying here and it’s just as wonderful as the first. Her place is well equipped clean, charming, and in a great location.

Emmanuels place is above and beyond :) Walking distance to metro, canal, in fact gives you  opportunity to explore Paris by foot. The apartment is fully equipped with everything you need. Super spacious, with the terrace that takes your breath away :) I strongly recommend that place for stay in Paris. You will not regret it!
The apartment looks great and has all you need for your stay. Right in the centre of Paris. The parking is an added bonus. Def book again.

Brand new and very clean place , everything was perfect for one person but I can’t imagine a couple or more staying together,Only downside is that you can hear your neighbors so clear thru the door as is a converted unit into 3 mini unit and noise travels easy but overall a wonderful stay,Highly recommend for short stays .

Sabrina is an outstanding host, very accommodating and supportive. During my stay, Sabrina was dealing with me as a friend, rather than a host. She has been truly the best host so far! The apartment is clean, cozy and nicely located. I definitely recommend staying at Sabrina’s.
This is  great place in Paris. Location is great with an amazing market right outside on weekends.

Vanessa was a great host, everything worked out totally uncomplicated and she also had a lot of tips for us in Paris. Would absolutely recommend it, the Appartement was great and so close to the Eiffel Tower, we loved the stay!
We really enjoyed our stay at Hotel Malesherbes. Patrick was very welcoming and the hotel was perfectly placed to enjoy Paris.
Perfect value and great location.  Parking is in a secure location and included in the price!  Highly recommend this place.

Alex's place is perfectly located near an excellent bakery, a supermarket, and a metro station.it's exactly what you see in the pictures, there are no surprises.Besides the apartment I have to point out Alex himself as the best host I have encountered.he's helpful with everything you need, you can contact him and he will reply really fast.if you wanna visit Paris, I would really suggest to take Alex's place.
It was one my best stays in Paris, he responds very quickly, apartment is in very good side of Paris. Everything was clean, designed and professional.

Very kind and helpful. Helene even walked me through from the Airport tram to the Station to my location in Paris-door to door. No guess work and made my travels safe, quick, speedy and reliable! Merci beacoup!
We had a lovely stay with Gerard and Hannelore. The room was nice, the breakfast tasty and plenty and the area super. Paris felt like home

I loved the appartment, location is great and it’s quite luminous and spacious for Paris standards. The bed is not super comfortable though. I also had a problem with the Wifi password, but they manage to send me the right ones within the same day of the check-in. I would recommend the place!
We had a great stay here! Really nice Paris apartment in a great location, and good helpful communication from the hosts, would recommend!
A amazing location, close to a lot of metro stations. A neighborhood that's really living but not to crowded. Had a nice stay!

The best thing about it - its location.  But bedrooms are really small and inconvenient, we were unable to light family room - switches did not work, and Brigitte, that met us at apartment, did not know how to operate a/c ( she said that apartment does not have a/c), did not explain anything about our stay other then how we need to clean apartment and take trash out. We stayed only 3 nights and tolerated all these inconveniences but would not stay in this place next time.

Cristina is very responsive, attentive and helpful. Her apartment is beautiful and looks even better than the pictures. It is equipped with everything you may need. She provided a baby cot for our son, and there was even a little play area for him with lots of toys, which he loved. We highly recommend this place.
The apartment is really nice and the location cannot be better. The owner is always available for a chat. Highly recommended.

The apartment was absolutely amazing. Even better than what you see in the pictures. Anne was very sweet and even had a bottle of rose on ice for us when we arrived as a welcome gift. We look forward to coming back. Merci Anne!

Elise's apartment is wonderfully located among 4 metro stations, next to shops, grocery stores and tons of restaurants, not to mention just a step away from beatiful Marais. The apartment itself is really big and comfortable, beautifully decorated and sparkling clean. Elise was great in communicating and check in was really easy. Will definitely stay again when visiting Paris!
The appartment was super clean, from the terrasse you can see the Eiffeltower and Emmanuel is really nice. Everything was Perfect and we can really recommend it.

Alexander is a great host! Very accommodating and will even offer tips on what to see/do in Paris. The location is great, minutes away from metro, train and bus. The apartment is super cute and stylish. You'll have all you need to make it a memorable stay.

Just WOW! Brilliant sunset views from the balcony in an incredibly central and peaceful location. Perfect for a long weekend romantic getaway in Paris, in an elegant and luxurious apartment. Alexis was extremely helpful and always available throughout our trip, and offered us some great tips to help us enjoy our stay! Would highly recommend.

Extremely cozy flat, located in the very heart of Montparnasse. Within 5 minutes range from the RER & with a grocery store right next door – super convinient. I have enjoyed my stay a lot, many thanks to Clara's hospitality.

Anne & Jean-Luc are the best hosts. They gave us a quick tour to ensure we have everything we need for our stay. Jean-Luc went above and beyond from helping us take our luggages to/from the apartment to getting us a taxi to take us to the airport. The place has so much character and is centrally located. We felt very welcomed and delighted to be in their hands/apartment. Thank you, Anne & Jean-Luc! Wish all hosts are like you.
This place is in a great location and it is a really good value. The owner was very responsive.

Great apartment in Central Paris! Close to 2 metro stations with good access to lines on both RER and metro as well as walkable to many popular sites. Several good restaurants nearby and places to buy groceries. Showers work well with plenty of hot water. Host was responsive and friendly. it was great size for 3 or 4 people. Quiet at night, secure building. Would stay here again.

Aurélien’ s apartment was a perfect place to stay in Paris — bright, clean, quiet, and centrally located. Check-in and check-out were simple and the flat is walking distance from the marais, with lots of shops and restaurants nearby. I enjoyed my time there.

A nice apartment in a lovely little neighbourhood and near a wonderfull park. Public transport is nearby.The apartment has all the basic needs for a pleasant stay. The beds and the shower are good. Communication with Giovanni is quick.

As many have already communicated, Anne & Jean-Luc are exceptional hosts. They really go above and beyond to make you feel welcomed and comfortable. Their apartment is very spacious with everything you could need for an enjoyable stay. The location couldn’t be better. It’s in a central location yet it’s quiet at night. I highly recommend this Airbnb!

We had a great weekend in October here with our 10 year old and 7 year old.  The location was great in many ways - just round the corner from super street of food shops and lovely rue des abbesses which was very buzzy and lively - transport is also great and its a nice walk (30 mins or so) from Louvre etc.  It was noisy on Friday and Saturday nights if sleeping in the living room (which will be necessary if more than 2 of you) but the windows are double glazed and when close properly they keep out most of the noise.  Was fun to be in such a busy, buzzy part of town though - especially after the boredom of lock down!! Julian is great, very quick to respond to questions and feels like you are in his home enjoying his hospitality.  Highly recommend.
