Great location and communication. Beautiful, light-filled afternoons, and Julien was very flexible around check-in and check-out.

A well located, cosy apartment close to a metro station and the many bars and restaurants of Montmartre. The area is vibrant and lively and the apartment is perfectly located to take advantage of all Paris has to offer.

Great location, beautiful apartment, comfy beds with nice duvets and pillows. Very friendly staff when leaving the keys and showing the apartment. The only remark I have is that it should be more clearly stated that there is only one toilett eventhough there are two showers. We we’re 2 couples, one with three teenagers - we managed but info beforehand would have been good.Still, I strongly recommend the apartment and area - five star!
our stay was great. this place is stylish and bright, location is amazing and host is very nice to talk to!
The most amazing Parisian apartment! Everything was so well kept and beautifully decorated. Can’t wait to come back to Paris to stay here again!

This apartment is a great find—spacious, chic, quiet, a lift! It is located very close to buses and the metro, shopping, and tourist destinations. The host is gracious and check in was very easy. We had to work a little and there’s a wonderfully large table in the living room near the windows. We would stay again.

This Airbnb felt more like a hotel room than an apartment, but lacked the necessary essentials and cleaning protocol. The shower had hair from a previous renter, and there was no hand soap in the apartment! The apartment is smaller than it looks in the photos and the neighborhood is quite loud at night, and we were woken up by construction every morning.
Perfect location to visit the city. Great spot to stay, very clear communication by the host. Not a single problem of issue.Top
It was a great stay. Very good communication, the guide was helpful read it and it will not disappoint. Very clean and had everything we needed.

Cristina was a fantastic host and really made this our best Paris stay! She was very helpful and had a great communication style. Very prompt and understanding and accommodating to our slightly later check in. Her apartment was just the best you can picture for a Paris apartment - centrally located, with great taste and everything you’d need. The most comfortable beds we had for our whole trip (across five stays) and we enjoyed those lovely view in a lazy mode sitting in her living room looking out of the window. Would def recommend!

Great apartment with a wonderful view of many sights in Paris. Small elevator up to the seventh floor, but great access with public transport. Close to many good restaurants and some grocery stores at hand. Overall a great place to stay in Paris.

cozy place in the heart of Montparnasse. very well connected with all the city, it's easy to walk to almost every point of interest. Jean is available for every need and the check in procedure is perfectly explained in every detail.

Cosy, well-furnished studio, modern appliances, close to transportation and to many cultural attractions. Nice restaurants, markets in the area.  Very reasonably priced.  Hostess is very easy to communicate with.

We were not greated at arrival. The owner expected us to call him though no phone number was given.I had given mine, but he did not bother to check: we waited 40 minutes in the pourring rain!! Not a good start: We had to have Air b&b call him.The appartement is very confy, though. Because it’ s a ground floor there is less light and more noise from outside than a top floor.
Amazing stay, Elise and Bastien were very attentive and communicative. Home is exactly as the pictures and impeccably cleaned. Also close to the metro and bar areas. Highly recommended.
Location, location, location - couldn’t be better. Great size. We took our 5 year old and 5 month old and it was perfect. Had everything you need. Would happily stay again.

This place is great, clean, pictures are accurate and the location is great, very close to two metro lines taking you to city centre very quickly. You can book this place  with closed eyes, you will not be disappointed!

Great spacious apartment and fantastic location. Very comfortable for 6 of us. Check in was very smooth and we could contact our hosts easily with any questions we had. We’ll definitely stay here again

This apartment is a must if you are traveling to Paris. The place is exquisite, detailed and full of beautifull art objects. It has everything and more of what you may need to have an extraordinary time in Paris. To top everything of it has a spectacular views from three balconies.Alexis vas a superb host in everyway. He is very attentive, warm, and helpfull, always reachable withing few minutes. He made me feel welcome and comfortable in his one of a kind place. I will definetly be back soon!

BOOK IT! This place is great and so close to many restaurants and cafes. It's very walkable, only about 10 minutes to Notre Dame, but it's also very close to subway stations. For a week stay the washer truly came in handy. There are stairs to get up to the apartment, but not difficult. I would definitely stay here again if I traveled to Paris!

Wonderful location! Easy to get on the metro and go to all of the big sights. There were also plenty of food places near by. Great walking distance from the Louvre. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable.

A very lovely, clean apartment in an amazing location that was close to everything, but also felt very safe which was important as I was travelling alone. Jordan was a very attentive host who was very accommodating and generous - would recommend!
Gilbert is very kind and helpful with anything you need. The flat is comfortable and welcoming. A perfect stay in Paris.
Location was great, no problems during my stay except the wifi sucked. But you’re in Paris, enjoy the city not your phone I guess

The value of this place is incredible - real bang for your buck. A great size for a solo traveler or couple, incredible neighborhood, easy check-in/entry, and very communicative host. I extended my trip because I loved it so much!

Located in a great neighborhood. Near to plenty of restaurants and shops. The metro is about 4 minutes away. Keep in mind that there are two sets of stairs. Overall, we had a great time and recommend this flat.
Great location! Noisy bar next door, but couldn’t beat the value. Natalie was responsive with requests.

This was by far the most spacious Airbnb in Paris that I’ve stayed in, especially for the price point. Upon arrival we were greeted by the building manager. It seems as if Edgar Suites manages a few Airbnb properties throughout Paris. Check-in was seamless despite my late arrival after a delayed flight!One of the members traveling with me ran in the Paris Marathon and this apartment was conveniently located for catching the back half of the course. This is also a prime location for those looking to watch a PSG match over at Parc des Princes. It’s less than a 5 min walk.
This is a beautifully furnished, authentic Parisien apartment in a fantastic location just 5 minute walk to The Louvre! We had a great time!
Absolutely great location.  Very clean.  Be aware that a couple of the bedrooms have very steep stairs, making it a challenge for anyone who may need to get up at night,

great host: super friendly and helpful. went the extra mile when we forgot something in the apartment (thanks again!). apartment is really nice and in a good location, and overall a very good deal compared to staying in a hotel.

The apartment Is just as others have said, quiet, good location and a responsive host.  There are several good restaurants on the same street, a bakery, a pizza place, a Vietnamese sandwich place, and a Korean BBQ.  There is a monoprix a few minutes walk away. The metro, line 8, is very close.  Most destinations are 15-30 minutes away.  The Coulee Verte is less than 5 minutes walk, and it is delightful.  I was concerned that there was no clothes dryer, but everything dried quickly on the provided clothes line. Nathalie is an interesting, caring, person, and an excellent host.  She’s not just collecting payment, she does want you to enjoy the flat and Paris.
Fantastic stay! A beautiful and kind family who went above and beyond. They make you feel very comfortable. The space is beautiful and really clean. No complaints.

Olivier is a great host, really friendly and always help as possible. His place is really comfortable, in a great location and I sure that you will enjoy the stay if you select his place.I will definitely return there sometime.

Hannalore is one of the best Airbnb hosts I’ve ever stayed with. My wife and I stayed at her place for 5 days and really appreciated that Hannalore was kind and laid back but also always eager to be helpful. She gave us tips for enjoying our time in Paris and we definitely enjoyed our trip more because of her and her advice! The location is great because it’s just a few minutes walk from different metro stations so we were able to easily get around on the metro for the entire trip. Thanks Hannalore!
Thanks for the stay. The location is perfect for a stay in Paris so close to public transport. The apartment has many amenities. Great choice!

Lovely, quiet and very private room. Has all you need for short to longer stays. It is very well located and you can get anywhere from there by using the metro (5 to 10 min). Julien is very responsive and kind! I was received with a lovely welcome kit and all kind of instructions to make my stay the best (which it was!). I will definitely come back.

Super location with the Seine river just a short walk away.  The local restaurants near the Apartment were very good for breakfast choices and the famous late afternoon Happy Hour.The apartment itself was great.  Really bright light during the day time with shutters that will allow you to close out the light if you wish.  The washing machine was a nice extra to have in the space.  The bed was very comfortable and the big sofa cushion were great to lean up against when you were reading or using your computer.

Great stay! My family and I met up in Paris, a total of 8 of us, and had a great and comfortable stay. The back patio is lovely and a great place for a family or group to relax. Airbnb is a very short walk to the M4 metro, though the location is just a little bit outside the main Paris attractions, if that’s what you’re interested in. (About 25 -30 mins ride to Latin Quarter, Notre Dame, Louvre, etc…)Jean-François was very kind and communicative with all of us. Highly recommend!
Very nice apartment. Right near the metro so that was convenient. Stores nearby and places to eat or drink.

Beautiful apartment. Great location. The apartment is quiet, clean, and well equipped. Safe neighborhood within walking distance to shops restaurants and tourist sites. Jean-Luc is very responsive. He really is a super host!  Highly recommend this place. We will definitely stay there again next time we’re in Paris.

The place is perfect for a single or couple who's looking to be close to restaurants, bars, cafes, and tourist attractions. Julien's communication was wonderful. The flat was clean and had everything we needed.
The communication exceeded my expectations. Vinicius and Diego responded right away to answer my questions. I would recommend this stay to my friends and family.
Great location and nice apartment. Short walk from many big tourist locations and restaurants! Anthony is a good host and communicator.  Would recommend!
It’s was a really nice apartment.Super clean and great location. The surroundings where quiet so no noice from traffic etc. The host was super friendly.

Spacious, clean, comfy and with a great location. If you are traveling with a kid - look no further. The apartment is very well equipped: bathroom & kitchen have everything you need. Also, its interior design is very tasteful, you feel like you are truly living in the Marais. If we travel back to Paris and it’s available, we would love to come back.

Frédérique's place is in a great location,  with loads of great bars and restaurants nearby and easy accessibility to all the main sites. It's a really nice, spacious, art-filled apartment, quiet and comfortable. I would definitely recommend it.

We had a fabulous stay! It is a great apartment in a wonderful location. It was nice to have a kitchen and a washing machine. It is a very comfortable apartment, and there is no street noise since it is in a courtyard. Jean-Luc is great about communicating. Overall, a great family experience in Paris.
Great location, amazing place! The check in process was not as smooth as expected. Otherwise would definitely come back!
Excellent apartment, ticked all the boxes; location, decor, facilities, cleanliness etc.  Our host was very professional and generous with towels, even bathrobes.  Will be back!
Lovely loft apartment, very spacious and the high ceilings ensured it stayed cool. Lively neighborhood with a diverse immigrant comnunity and tasty bakery around the corner

Gilbert's touch at making guest have a nice stay are evident. The baguette in the morning with butter and jam is helpful to get the mind going all while enjoying a cup of coffee. The bedroom is very nice and Gilbert leaves his guest to their own...something appreciated. Great location...felt safe and nice neighborhood; easy access to Gard Nord and East train stations and multiple metro and bus stops.

Quiet neighborhood, walkable to many things. Public transportation nearby.Checkin with Elias was great. He was prompt, courteous and friendly. He showed me around and explained checkout before leaving.The space was comfortable and it was conveniently located to many things.I would definitely stay again and recommend.

Great location near the Eiffel Tower and transportation options.  Super market a few doors down which made shopping for food a breeze.  We had a plumbing issue upon arrival which was handled quickly by Vanessa.  Read other reviews and bring silverware as there was only one set of silverware in the kitchen which required us to purchase silverware.
Nice location. You can find easily supermarket, restaurants and so on! There are lovely 2 cats welcoming you~! Kathleen made a booklet to introduce all around the area! Very nice place to stay!

Such a beautiful space. Quietly perched above a lively part of paris. Plenty to do and see, or simply relax and enjoy the city at your leisure. Responsive and helpful with questions and recommendations. Thank you Julien, it was a perfect stay.

Fantastic location, but extremely loud (even with ear plugs). I am big city girl, who grew up near the subway, and I found the sound level excessive. We stayed for 5 days and the shower broke on the first day. I hear they put in a new one after we left. All said, you can’t beat the price and location. If you can handle lively street noise this place is a winner for you.

We had an amazing stay at this apartment! It is located in a great location - close to a major metro station - with lots of nearby cafes and restaurants. The apartment is beautifully decorated, clean, and cozy, and Denka was very quick to respond to any questions we had!

Great location. It is near to any kind of bars and restaurants, and going on walk to Louvre, or Notre Dame. Very cozzy apartment with al the acomodations for a brief stay. Marie was very helpfull and she have a excelente comunication. I really recomend it!

Clean space perfect for 2 guests. A bit of a trek to the main sights in Paris, but using the metro is pretty straightforward. Paul was easy to communicate with and we didn’t have any trouble during our stay.

I visited with my partner and we had a wonderful stay at Sofia´s! It's a wonderful place and she a caring host. The Apartment is located close to a Metro station and several bus stops, has a small kitchen and shower. The bedroom has a tiny balcony and opens towards a side street. It can be noisy at nights, as there is a bistro just downstairs. Another positive aspect we found was that the quarter is not as touristic as some others, so there is more classic Parisian lifestyle instead of souvenir shops :)
Amazing! Clean and well located, the bed was extremely comfortable. Fernanda is a perfect host. Definitely stay here.

We had a lovely time exploring Paris for the first time, and this apartment made a wonderful home base. Vinicius and Diego were very good communicators, and were even able to accommodate an early check in. The apartment is very well sized for Parisian standards. The bedroom on the loft allows for high ceilings and tall windows which overlook the building courtyard.  There was a closet with hangers and a shower/tub with fantastic water pressure. Although the building was in the middle of some construction, Vinicius informed us about this weeks prior to our stay and the roof repair did not burden our holiday in any way.Would recommend to friends!

The apartment is absolutely beautiful and the hosts are super friendly.Through the courtyard you are protected from the hustle of the streets and surrounded by beautiful plants and flowers. All neighbors were accommodating and nice and our arrival uncomplicated. In the neighborhood is everything you need and the metro right across the street. If you want to have a really nice time in Paris - this is the place. We hope to come back soon.
Clean, easy, and a great host.  This unit is a wonderful and vibrant spot of Paris.  Off and away from all of the tourists but close enough to everything. I highly recommend this place.

We had an excellent stay at Gilles place.  A perfect location close to the RER and metro lines and a few minutes walk to the Pont Neuf bridge and Louvre museum. Plenty of space in the apartment and the washer/dryer really helped.  Everything was just as described which is always nice to see.  Looking forward to our next time back in Paris and a stay at Gilles place.

A very well located apartment. Yes - the stairs are long but nothing too bad. The street can be a bit loud (cars, motorcycles) but then again, nothing too bad. Abel was helpful with the hints. There are some excellent restaurants in the area and good metro connection. Would definitely recommend!

I wanted somewhere classy for a second honeymoon. This place delivered. We went during a heat wave in July, but the apartment stayed cool just by opening the windows. The mattress was very comfortable, the neighbors quiet, and the Metro only 4 minutes away.

Lisa’s apartment is the perfect place to relax and a great location to easily explore Paris. Many major sites and landmarks are within walking distance. The apartment was clean, the beds were super comfortable, and the kitchen was well stocked. But the thing we appreciated the most was the list of recommended sites to see, restaurants to enjoy, and tips on getting around. Brigitte met us at the apartment and took the time to explain everything. Highly recommend this apartment!

Unfortunately this was not what we had expected. Communication and apartment itself was good however at midnight our first night of our stay what sounded like construction started taking place on the floor above us ( machinery being used;saws and drills.)This ended up lasting for two hours. Come to find out there was a burglary  in the apartment above us and that’s where the noise was coming from. The machinery  was being used to remove and replace the broken door. Through out this situation (from midnight to 2:00 am) Ana was responsive and concerned through text  and phone calls. We chose not to stay the second night with the concern of our safety with the break in. Ana refunded  for the night we did not stay, however she would not compensate  us anything from the night of construction.
Lovely flat. Good location and near to metro stops. Nice building too. Everything clean and tidy. Check in was easy and well communicated.

A spacious, light and airy, tastefully decorated studio apartment, with incredibly comfortable beds and a great coffee machine! the neighbourhood was quiet and peaceful but centrally located, with two metro stops just a few minutes away. Ana was a great host and told us everything we needed to know about the area. We loved our little Parisian home from home and will definitely be back.

The place is great for a sightseeing trip to Paris. You can walk to the most spots and some good restaurants are near by. We really enjoyed our time and Lisa is available all the time to give support if needed.
Loved the location, the cleanliness and the communication with the host Elise. Wished there was another toilet available and wider doorways.

Our family of five (with 3 teenagers) recently stayed for 4 nights in Paris.  Edgar's apartment suited our needs very well.  Well equipped for our exploration of Paris.  The apartment was large by Paris standards.  The large shower and bathroom area was a nice surprise.  There are several good grocery stores, bakeries and restaurants nearby.  We would definitely stay here again.

Beautiful flat. Great location. Comfortable stay for our travel party of 3 adults and 3 children (one infant). If you need the crib or high chair, make sure to request them in advance as they aren’t in the flat full time.

It was great place and very well occupied. The host was extremely organized, helpful and made our stay very pleasant! The apartment located in great location with many eat and drink options nearby and great public transport connection. I highly recommend this place - it is indeed a great value!

Cristinas appartment is just wonderful. We were 3 friends in Paris and just had the best time. The appartment shows the the owner has a great taste in art and design and we felt immediately welcome. The elevator is a great convenience for the luggage. The street is very quiet and you are still in the middle of the town. On foot or with the Metro you can get anywhere very fast. The restaurants and cafes in the area are inviting and the street just around the corner does not have a lot of car traffic, so you can easily relax while enjoying your meal. Overall we would always want to come back and would prefer NOT to tell anyone else, just because it is so wonderful, we feel, it should be a secret. Thank you so much, Cristina!
A beautiful home. Great communication, clean and tidy and we had everything we needed. So lovely to stay somewhere with character, and our son loved feeding Gaston the goldfish!

WOW! This was the most charming, beautiful, intentional home - the owners incorporated elements of their family history throughout the space and were incredibly helpful and communicative. It would be fabulous to stay in this Airbnb again in the future!
I really like this place. Very well located. Zineb was very kind and helpful #GoodHost😀
The check in was really easy! The place also pretty and packed with amenities. It also have an ac that really cold during the summer.  We loved it!

Very spacious and well located apartment with some gorgeous 19 century details : high and decorated sealings, marble fire places, wood floors… You can easily walk from the address to visit some famous Paris monuments .2 if the most convenient metro lignes are also close (Lignes 1 and 2).I liked my small and cozy room.The host is very nice and helpful, she let you use the kitchen and you can put some of your groceries in her own fridge which is great if you don’t want to spend too much money in restaurants !I adore her 2 cats Nero and Felix , they are both adorable, they for sure enlightened my stay in Paris and I was so happy to find them behind the door each time I was coming back from my daily visit . I hope I will be able to go back with one of my family member  in the future at the same address . The price was also very reasonable.

Francis was very nice and welcoming. The place is small, as stated in the description. The stairs that lead to it are pretty dirty, as the shared bathroom, but the room itself was ok. It’s not ideal, but it’s definitely ok for the price.
Beautiful and pittoresk place in Le Marais. It’s on walking distance from all the shops and restaurants. Excellent communication with the host, would definitely recommend!

Yoni is very helpful. We communicated very easily. We really enjoyed his flat. It’s quite spacious and the  two big porches are really nice spaces for hanging out and rare for Paris. The flat is very clean, and the kitchen is well equipped. All shops and restaurants are nearby. The restored old railway track is a gem for taking a walk in a green quiet space. Tram, buses, Metro are all in walking distances, though one can use some caution walking back alone late at night. The place is very quiet for sleeping (also rare for Paris). I certainly highly recommend it to couples or families.  - XR

The apartment is just as depicted in the photos. It has been renovated to a high standard and is very comfortable. They left lovely Aesop products and provided water in the fridge. We did have a small issue with the toilet being quite noisy while not in use but overall the apartment was very good and we could recommend it to others.

Tatiana’s home is wonderful, lively neighbourhood, very clean home with really good design and character.I stayed here for 8 days and it really felt like home the moment I step in. Check in and out process was also very simple, friendly and responsive ❤️❤️❤️
Hugues is very nice and kind. The house is close to the museum area and places to eat.

Love the location of Louise’s place, it was absolutely perfect for us. We enjoyed Luxembourg gardens and walked to the Orsay, Rodin’s + the lourve. There are also so many great restaurants we are at very close.  It was perfect

Room is small, nice bed. As per picture. Great location. But since its hot we have to open the window to get air during the night. But as the room is right above the street, it is very noisy and we dont sleep too well since we can hear everything from the street if you open the window.Breakfast is great.

We really enjoyed the apartmentWe were a couple and three children, the communication with the host is easy and available and he responded to everything!The location of the apartment is perfect near the metro and a quiet street.The apartment was clean and well equippedThe only drawback is that there are no windows, otherwise it is perfect

We stayed for a week while traveling Paris. The apartment is in a great location in Monmart, close to many good restaurants and cafes and in walking distance of transportation alternatives. Chloe was very communicative and flexible with us. The place is lovely and well lit with a great balcony and very good wifi connection. We could easily work from the apartment. I’ll definitely recommend staying here;)

Loved it! Gorgeous street, handy location & lovely place to stay. Cedric was very welcoming. The room & bathroom are "compact" - as we would expect in Paris anyway - but perfectly suitable still. It had everything we needed, including a lovely shower. The breakfast was great for us - crossant, bread, jams, cheese & fresh fruit & various drinks.

Catherine was the absolute best host, attentive and responsive to all questions I had and went above and beyond for my checkin and checkout needs. The place was also the most ideal location, very safe, close St.Germain and Marais as well as lots of metro stops. The apartment had an unbeatable view, lots of amenities, and well equipped. If you are looking for an apartment in Paris- this is it!!

We loved this place! It’s very cozy and well equipped. The location was perfect, so much going on around the area and so many places to see. Hugues was also so helpful in providing suggestions for things to do during our stay. We would definitely come back to this place:)

The pictures were accurate: this room has a view of the garden and very little room for activities. If you're only looking to sleep and maybe do a little bit of computer work done here, the space is adequate. The apartment is conveniently located by the Crimée metro station; a ~3 minute walk. The hostess was warm and friendly!
Alex's place is great! It was just as advertised, on a nice, quiet street in Monmartre. It's very close to the train and lots of shops/restaurants.
Stayed in green room. This place is good if you just need a place to sleep. 1 block from the metro. Functional above all.
Great apartment, homely and nice. Thomas is a friendly and helpful host. Everything was perfect!
This stay was very convenient for my short 3 days in Paris. And suited my basic needs and felt very safe! Public transit is very close. Very pleasant and responsive hosts as well!

Terrific apartment in a fun, lively location.  The apartment is clean, well appointed and close to shops, restaurants, the metro and the Sacre Coeur. The host was very responsive and flexible with checking in and out.  We really enjoyed our stay!

Jean-Daniel’s apartment was perfect location about a 5 minute walk from the Metro with close by conveniences. The beds were comfy and everything was a smooth check in and out process. Would recommend this place to anyone.
Hugues was very responsive to all of our questions and provided a clean, inviting space for our stay. We highly recommend this place and will likely stay there again when we head back to Paris.
This place I just like the photos. Very spacious and literally so quiet! You wouldn’t think you’re off a busy street with plenty of restaurants and a grocery store nearby. Check in/out was super easy
Great appartment, excellent location, stunning view. Comfortable and spacious. Aurelie is a very pleasant host.
Great location in Pigalle, clean and well-furnished rooms, communicative host. Would definitely recommend!
The decor does not disappoint..its beautiful with wonderful facilities. A bakery close by for breakfast and the metro is so close. Fabulously close to Sacre Couer. Highly recommend

Wonderful, beautiful apartment and the location is great. Close walk to the Metro and there’s a lot of great shops, épicerie, and bistros in the area. There was a tiny problem with the toilet (that wasn’t a big deal) but Tatiana still gave us a complimentary discount, which says a lot. Overall 10/10 would highly recommend and definitely stay here again. P.s. There’s a lovely courtyard attached

We had a great stay in Mariana’s  beautiful apartment. The apartment is walking distance to main areas of the city with lots of bars and restaurants and close to a number of Metro stations. We had a very comfortable stay and would love to stay again!
The house is really amazing, comfortable, very well designed, great location. Nicolas & Jean Yves were disponible to everything we needed. We will definitely come back next year!

Location: absolutely top, hard to beat .. House itself: Great details - nice cutlery, comfortable beds/sheets, sound isolation, nice decorationVery centrally located, yet pretty quiet (didn't hear anything during the night). Would certainly come back
We had a great stay at Tatiana's Airbnb.  We highly recommend.  The space is beautiful and spacious.  Tatiana is super responsive and helpful!
This place was great! A really nice central location. The airbnb was beautifully decorated, and very comfortable, just as promised!

Excellent apartment in a great neighborhood with beautiful views.  Very safe building and neighborhood with plenty of bakeries, restaurants and shops in walking distance.  Comfortable bed, and plenty of amenities.  I would stay again.
Had a wonderful stay at Nicolas place. Clean and very convenient to the metro to see all the sites. Nicolas was also very helpful and attentive to any needs a guest may have

We loved our stay at Jean Christophe’s appartment. The appartment is beautiful, spacious and well equipped. The location is perfect, situated in a calm private street in the heart of Batignolles. The owners welcomed us very warmly and made us feel at home.

Its a good hostel, although it is too expensive for 200 a night. The towels had bloodstains in them but overall it was very clean. Like all the other reviews said, you can hear people on the hallway, we did not hear the bar that’s outside. People that come from towns, i would suggest another place but for city people or people that like some ambient sound, i really recommend this place. Has alot of nice restaurants around!I personally would recommend this though this will be my first and last stay.
Apartment is tiny but very good with all comforts except tv, it doesn't work. Hatch's team is very good in communications and self checkin is perfect.
Very clean place in a great location. I would highly recommend it. Check in is very easy as well which is nice.

This was probably our best AirBnB booking ever!  The apartment is incredibly cozy, bright and fully equipped.  A new renovation has been made and the apartment is furnished with taste and style, from furniture to dishes.  Very good internet.  Quality appliances, even a washing machine with a drying mode. Julia is a wonderful personality and a great and helpful owner.  The location is just perfect, you can see the Eiffel Tower from the window.  Generally, don’t even think, just book - you will not regret it one bit!

We loved staying at Tatiana's place - the flat is very beautiful, clean and well connected. The host responded very quickly to all of our questions and was very helpful, all in all we had a very smooth and lovely stay in Paris !

The apartment is very nice, modern and in a great location and it offers all amenities one could need. It is rather small, which was fine for us, but I can imagine bigger people could feel a bit uncomfortable. Also the apartment is atypical with a lot of stairs so I wouldn´t recommend for those who have problems with walking the stairs. Anyway, we enjoyed our stay, the communication with Sébastien was smooth, he is responsive and helpful.
Enjoyed our stay in Paris! Apartment was a little squeezy for 4 pax, would be best for 2 pax. Very safe neighbourhood and clean!
Jerome is a lovely host. He has a cool apartment in a really fun area. The apartment could use a deep clean. Just a heads up to other remote workers that the wifi isn’t secure. Would stay again.
great location and a lovely place too stay. really made our Paris trip perfect. thank you ☺️

This was a great location, despite the fact it's tucked away and may not have the best view. It is close to three different metro lines. Lots of shops, patisseries, restaurants, and other shops. I was worried of noise because we're close to the hospital, but it was very quiet. There was some construction under us that we weren't expecting, but I spoke to John and he was able to help with it. I wish I could have stayed longer, but I lost my job and had to leave early. It was a very pleasant stay and I would definitely stay again.

A place I definitely want to go back to! The location is perfect, and the very spacious balcony is great (definitely the biggest one I've seen in any places I've stayed at in Paris! I was truly amazed 😮). There's everything you need in the flat, and Jean-Michel is extremely helpful. You can tell he cares a lot about visitors. Thank you again Jean-Michel for making our stay so easy and enjoyable.
Me and my daughter had a lovely stay at Nicolas appartment. Walkable distance to the Metro station and nice nighborhoods. Thank you Nicolas!

Emmanuel’s place is in a great location, right near rail lines but with plenty to do in the area.  The apartment is great with a comfy bed and lovely patio and stocked with a tasty bottle of wine.  Emmanuel had good suggestions and was really flexible with our check in.  Would definitely stay here again.
Anne and Jean-Luc were great hosts, they were responsive and accommodating. The apartment is conveniently located and had everything we needed. If we find ourselves in Paris again, we will be back!
The house is in a good position, the appartament’s forniture is nice and modern but it lacked of cleaning; it was dusty we also found a hair.
The location is amazing.The responsiveness was very good.The place is clean.It’s just too small for 4 adults. Excellent for a couple.

Great location! We were able to walk to all major tourist attractions without even needing to take the metro. Apartment had everything we needed for an affordable price relative to hotels in the same location. Sofa bed was comfortable, shower was hot, Internet was a good speed, heater controls for the room were provided, tea and coffee were provided. The space is small, but it was comfortable for the 2 of us spending most of our time out and about. Team (and it really was a team!) operating the rental was super responsive and very helpful. We would be very happy to stay again.
The house was located near train station so it was easy to go anywhere from here. The host was really nice, helpful and responsive

My partner and I felt right at home and very comfortable in this Airbnb! It was clean and had beautiful art decorations. The location is very close to anything you need: metro stops, cafes, restaurants, and a grocery store. Cristina worked with our travel plans and accommodated our check-in time.

We all read the reviews to check if the description meets reality. It does here completely. The compact appartement was exactly as described. Key words: attentive host, quiet, clean and fully equipped apartment,  excellent neighborhood. All you need for a stay in Paris. As usual in Paris, there is no "outside" like a balcony or garden access. So if that is a key importance, look elsewhere. Otherwise no negatives at all.
Very good and kind communication, easy access to public transport and a very comfortable stay in general. Will be happy to come back!

Stayed here with my wife on our honeymoon. Great location within walking distance to the metro station, as well as the Eiffel Tower and restaurants. The host was very responsive and helpful and the space was nice and clean!

We would highly recommend Nicolas's bijou charming little place. it had everything we needed and more. Lovely welcoming touches. Nicolas was very responsive to a few questions before we arrived which we appreciated. The metro is 10 seconds from the front door , but the place is quiet and secure.  5;stars
Staying at Nadir's apartment felt like being at home, loved everything)))  as a matter of fact, I rebooked another week in September as I checked in the first night)))

Mandana's apartmwnt is greatly located and very cozy. I was there for three weeks and thoroughly enjoyed my stay. I highly recommend. It is exactly like the pictures. If you are ok with 6th floor no elevator  that is the place for you!
Well located close to Sacre Coeur, good communication, cozy flat, very authentic. Bit noisy, which is probably normal in that area. it's really like living at a friend's place.
Really nice Apartement! Stylish as in the pictures and very comfy! 10/10 ✨
Very well located Adrien was extremely helpful There was works around so it was noisy and the outdoor areas were dirtyBedrooms are pretty big and clean

It was a great place. And host was very friendly and nice. When i have a questions about the house, he answered it very quickly and solved the problem. Thank you for that. It is conveniently located. I totally recommend this place.

The location was great for the event I was attending at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles - only one Metro stop away. It is a very nice neighborhood, with a street market several times per week, and a carousel at the Metro station (Convention). The apartment was very comfortable - I wish I could have spent more time enjoying its tranquility. Nice deep bathtub :)
Really happy with Katleen and her place. She’s a great host, replies quickly, makes you feel like home and the place is really quiet and the bed is comfortable.

David’s place was very clean and had a sliding section to give privacy between the two beds which was very nice. The place is close to public transportation and is also walkable to the arc and Eiffel. Had a great week and would recommend to stay here!

Yann’s apartment was really nice with everything you could need and at a very affordable price for the location. The Sacre Coeur was just 3mins away from the flat and there is a supermarket just next to the flat. The flat was tidy and nicely decorated. We had an incident with the key but Yann answered immediately to the messages and everything was solved within 30 mins. I will come back and I really recommend this studio.

Highly recommend.  Great location.   Very walkable to the Eiffel Tower, restaurants, shopping, a river, and several metro stations.  The apartment was very clean and well stocked.   The grocery store downstairs is very convenient.  The location was very quiet and we felt safe there. We will stay there again on our next trip to Paris.

Amazing host, great place with a lot of personality! Perfect for a quick business trip or short stay. Very close to restaurants, a supermarket, the train station, and more. Would recommend and stay again!
Great place to stay in. Very nice apartment in a beautiful Parisian building. Responsive and very accommodating host.The apartment is also very beautiful and well decorated, all amenities are there!

Overall, I had an amazing stay! It is in a great location and many of the must see spots in Paris are easily accessible. Brijid is an amazing host and is very responsive. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a cozy space in a great location.

Beautiful apartment right at the heart of Paris. Easy to walk to anywhere and have amazing restaurants nearby. The whole place was well-decorated, clean, and had everything you need. You would be pleasantly surprised by the beautiful view from terrace. Alexis was a wonderful host, he gave us great local suggestions and this stay made a difference to our long weekend in Paris.
Venus and Magali are prompt to answer and super friendly, the place has everything you need as a foreigner:)

I had a great time at Delphine’s. She was warm, welcoming, helpful and approachable, and her place is in an excellent location close to the 12 Metro Line. Would definitely stay again next time I am in Paris!

Henry was very responsive and Bernard was extremely helpful. They were very accommodating with our travel plans and any changes that occurred, which made for a wonderful start to our trip as we had a flight change. The apartment is located within minutes of the Eiffel Tower and there were plenty of restaurants within short walking distance. We really enjoyed our stay, and the view doesn’t get old!

Thanks for this apartment, it’s really good. All furniture are clear, including bathroom. And location is fine,  I mean bakery, supermarket, metro station, some sightseeing all is near, just a few minutes from apartment. For sure, I will stay here again next time!Je recommande :)
This apartment is wonderful to spend a short period of time. We had a great time watching the Tour Eiffel from the windows and the kitchen.

Great apartment in a perfect location! Pictures and description are 100%, the place was very clean and comfy. Very friendly host, it was a pleasure to visit this place. Check-in was easy and we could even arrive earlier than it was mentioned. Thanks Paul 👍!

The ground floor-room is adjacent to the garbage room of the building. As a result, there is some noise when others throw their garbage away. The location is good if you need to work around Gare du Nord.
Fantastic Air BnB if you’re looking to stay in Paris. The location is great for sight seeing. The apartment was spotless and the shower was sweet. Would highly recommend!

We had an incredible time at this lovely home. Ju was so responsive, kind and friendly. They had everything we needed, and in fact, this airbnb far exceeded our expectations. It is very large and the two bathrooms are wonderful. We all agreed that our family of four could easily live in the apartment. Thank you Ju and Ch.
Location in relation to sights of Paris is great.  Lots of things to do and see within walking distance.

We found Marie’s place as per the description and previous reviews. The noise from neighbours, the street, the school and even builders in the unit next door was not bothersome, in fact it was was extremely quiet at night. Well fitted out and comfortable.
It is a wonderful apartment in a great location.  Walkable to many of Paris's attractions and close to the metro.  Eric and Laure were responsive and flexible.  I would stay here again.

We had a wonderful experience during our stay, Jean was an amazing host! This Airbnb is perfect for two. The location is great; you can easily catch the metro or bus, less than a block away. As soon as you walk out of the apartment complex, you have all kinds of cafes/restaurants to choose from. We had no issues getting in and out of the unit during our stay. It is pretty quiet building, and the neighbors we interacted with were extremely nice. Thank you for everything, Jean!
Great location. Lots of stairs but we didn’t mind this. Loud nightlife but again we didn’t mind. No shower, just a bath.

This Airbnb is in a prime location for exploring Paris. It's really close to a Metro stop and literally one block from the Seine river. The apartment itself is really cute, very clean and spacious. Highly recommend!

Convenient quirky place but quiet at bed time. So many restaurants around and a few supermarkets to choose from. The fishmonger at the end of the road is not to be missed. The kitchen is tiny but functions well. There was even a mini food processor!

Anne is hands down the greatest hostess. We were warmly welcomed, in person, with open arms, champagne, fresh roses and macarons. Her apartment was super clean, airy, inviting and beautifully decorated. With the Maubert market and metro stop on the corner, the amazing Erik Kayser boulangerie around the corner,  and the Pantheon up the street, the location can't be beat. My husband also loved the elevator. 😘 Thank you, Anne for the loveliest stay.
Liliana is a great host, very responsive and friendly! The apartment was nice and well equipped.

I love how close his place is to the metro, it was convenient for us to travel around the city. The apartment unit is a bit tight for 4 people but we make do with it. I love how modern the decor on the inside with clean kitchen and bathroom. Overall we had a great stay here.

If you're hoping for a quiet little place to call your own in the heart of Paris Catherine's apartment is just for you.Close to everything you could hope for the apartment has a great view of the river, metro access, and everything you would need inside of it.On top of that Catherine is incredibly kind and communicative throughout the whole process if you need anything.Highly recommend.
Irfaan’s place is an unbeatable value. It is as small as it looks, but not a problem for 2 people for a few days. Make showers speedy as hot water can run out rather quickly. Great location!

I really enjoyed the Apartment. Everything was as described and Anna was very helpful with instructions. The place was clean and had a nice kitchenette as well as a Coffeemaker. The elevator and shower are very tiny, but that is also very Parisian. I can recommend the apartment.

This was our first stay in Paris and we found the apartment to be incredible! Exactly as described and easy to navigate. Eric was very responsive both before and during our stay. There are lots of great food choices and local food shops nearby. Metro is just up the street so it was easy to get around the city. I would recommend this flat to anyone traveling to Paris.
overall a clean place, quiet and good location. would prefer a later checkout or flexibility in storing luggages after check out given next check in only happens at 4pm.
Sophie and Joan are very approachable hosts. They were always ready to respond when I needed something. And the location is also spot on :)

Would recommend this apartment to anyone who would like to be in the heart of the action in Paris. The great thing about this apartment is that you are close to lots of bars and restaurants but it is very peaceful because the apartment itself is on the 4th floor away from the street so you can sleep soundly. The apartment itself is clean and matches it's description. As a host, Jean-Francois was very accomodating to us even with our late check-in. He was very friendly and personable and made me feel right at home. I'd definitely recommend this apartment to anyone looking to stay in Paris.

Great location, very close to the metro which unlocks the city of Paris. Caroline was very helpful and eager to be of assistance. very accommodating and gave greay recommendations. Honestly couldn't go wrong with any of the restaurants within walkin distances. Apt is on the 5tg floor, no elevator, but honestly wasn't a big deal. Did plenty of walking every day since there are a lot of things within walking distance. Felt very safe in the area at all hours.

Very small apartment.  Would have been beneficial to have instructions on raising the outside window blinds ahead of time.  Suggest a small wastebasket in each bedroom.  Good location.  Walls are quite this and could hear the other tenants quite easily.

We were two people in the apartment and for two people it's fine. It's small but you have the most important things. The best thing is the location.  Montmatre is so beautiful! There are so many beautiful restaurants and cafes. Also the communication was easy and fast. the check in and checkout were flexible, we were lucky! All in all we enjoyed it very much!

Highly recommended. Francoise was really helpful and friendly and we appreciated how flexible she was with check in and check out times. She also greeted us with coffee and croissants - just a really nice touch. The apartment was superbly located, clean, and we had a private WC. She gave us many helpful tips on what to see and visit.

Comfortable place with a lovely terrace. One of the best coffee machines I’ve ever used. Flat is compact with everything I needed and the shops are right downstairs. But for me it was all about the terrace.

What a treasure this charming apartment is!!!  my two adult children, and I absolutely had a blast with enough space for each of us to spread out. Easy access to metro! Great cafes all around as well as other fun little shops and a Monoprix 2 blocks away!!I can’t wait to go back!
The place is well located to reach famous spots around Paris.It's a perfect stay for a couple willing to explore the city.
Fab modern flat, really easy to travel everywhere and Adrien is really helpful! Thanks so much again:)

Throughly enjoyed our stay, great location in a safe and quiet neighbourhood. Apartment was clean and exactly as described. Just a few minute walk to the nearest metro. Nice restaurants and wine bars nearby. The self check in was seamless and coded doors made it easy to access.  Would recommend for a safe and central stay in Paris.
I had a lovely stay at Benjamin's apartment. I was there for 45 days for a work trip, and everything was perfect.
We loved our stay here. It was centrally located yet not at all touristy. It was a fun area to explore and a safe place to come home to at night or throughout the day.

Everything was perfect. The best thing was the host chat response was beyond what you expect at a high end hotelNothing to do with this place but if you have 2 kids above 2y, get a larger place (700sq ft instead of 400sq ft) if you can :)

We loved this place! Highly recommend for couples traveling to Paris. The location is amazing. Host is very kind and responsive. The shower pressure was wonderful! And we felt right at home. 5 stars all the way though!

We stayed two nights in Giovannis place and enjoyed it very much! :) The host gave some recommendations on the area, which is a beautiful area, there is an amazing view on sacre coeur only few meters away from the apartment. Would definitely recommend this!

The apartment was very nice and clean. The apartment is on the ground floor and sometimes noisy because a couple of schools are in the neighbourhood. The host was always available for us. I can fully recommend this apartment.

Lovely place with in walking distance of local shops and restaurants. The Eiffel Tower was close and other attractions were walkabale or the Metro could be used! Paul was great at responding to messages and made instructions really clear. Overall, a perfect couple of nights in Paris.

The place is exactly as described - it is nice, comfortable and very up-to-date. The beds were very comfortable, as were the towels and linens. The kitchen is modern and had everything we needed. The location is a busy area, but it wasn't loud with the windows closed, and we appreciated the close proximity to the Metro. Henri met us upon arrival, showed us the apartment and answered questions. Where he really shined was when my daughter got sick and needed to see a doctor. He helped us get this set up through a 24/7 healthcare service, and we had a great experience with the doctor who came to the apartment that night. Henri is easy to communicate with.

The location was ideal to be close to everything. Easy to get too and close to some great restaurants. Loved that when you walked to the corner you could see the top of the Eiffel Tower. Great airbnb!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Josephine’s apartment! The location is amazing and the building is very secure. Love the triple glazed windows, you can’t hear any of the street noise.
Great location, great host and easy to find. Located in the 10th arrondissement, near many boulangeries, restaurants and cafes. Easy metro access too. Wonderful all around.

A gorgeous apartment, beautifully decorated and very spacious.  Perfectly located with easy access to a number of metro stations on different lines, but also a lovely part of Paris to walk to and from.

Location,location!  Gabrielle’s apartment is beautiful and is walkable to anywhere. Close to the Louve, Norte Dame and the metro station.  Awesome apartment. The 2 bedrooms and 2 baths were perfect for 2 couples. Bridgette was great at meeting us and showing us everything. The security of the building is very reassuring and safe. We read over some of Gabrielle’s recommendations. We ate at Au Pied Du Cochon and took in a concert at Saint Chapelle. Both were wonderful.I highly recommend Gabrielle’s apartment and look forward to returning soon!
It was an enjoyable stay in Mai's place, in a vibrant neighbourhood. We loved walking to the boulangerie to grab breakfast every morning. We will book Mai's place again if we go back to Paris!

This place was excellent located 5 min walk to the Effeil tower, near the train and the place was cleaned. However we went middle June which was very very hot there was No AC and the fans are small to fresh the house.  We couldn’t get the Wiffi to work either.

This space has everything you need for a bright, comfortable stay in a wonderful neighborhood of Paris. I liked the big windows. I appreciated how clean the space was. There were enough surfaces for my belongings. The kitchen had everything you could need. Host was responsive when I had a question.

Not only were Maria, Alain and their apartment everything you'd hope for in an Air BnB (clean, well appointed, fabulous location, quiet with attentive hosts), on our last night in Paris they became our hero when we suddenly realized we'd left our phone on the tour bus from Versailles! Alain manage all communication with the bus company and then he personally went to retrieve our phone from the company and brought it to us at the apartment and refused our attempts to reimburse him for his efforts.  Our last evening on vacation went from being a nightmare to a wonderful cap to our time in France.  THANK YOU Maria and Alain!!!
Stay was very pleasant 😇 Beatrice was very helpful. Apartament is really equipped - hair dryer, iron, that was very helpfull

My husband and I and our 12 year old granddaughter had a wonderful experience at the beautiful chic apartment. The location just can’t be better for visiting all the museums, parks, shopping and restaurants. We had a great experience booking this as our host Gabrielle was very responsive to all questions. Would definitely book this again and again!.

Laurent’s place was close to different metro stations and few stops from major attractions. Laurent was very responsive to every message sent and willing to help. Laurent also help us finding good restaurants and breakfast placed around the area.The apartment has 2 shower bathrooms but these doesn’t have a toilet. There is only 1 toilet in the apartment. For 6 adults and 2 kids, this was a stretch. I explained to Laurent about an incident with the cleaning personnel and he immediately took care of it.Overall, I will definitely recommend staying at Laurent apartment because of the proximity to major attractions and cost of accommodation in Paris for many people.
We had a beautiful stay at Chloe’s place, it was even better than the photos and the location was amazing :)) would stay again
Lovely apartment in a great location with a very friendly and responsive host!Would definitely recommend.

Beautifully appointed flat and felt like home from home. It's on a peaceful square, and it's  got all that you need. It's close to Gare du Nord and easy walking distance to central Paris. Great windows for watching life on the square outside. The hosts were super helpful, very accommodating and responsive.We received very clear instructions on how to find and  access the apartment.
Karine is welcoming host and her home is a lovely space to enjoy the city. Clean and fully equipped.

We enjoyed the airy and lovely decorated apartment with interesting art and lots of books. We read about small bath so weren’t surprised. I believe an elderly person might have difficulty stepping over and into tub.Close to metro so very convenient to get around. Nice bakeries and Monoprix nearby. I would stay there again

We had a wonderful experience from start to finish! The apartment is located on a quieter street but so close to all of the action, cafes and more. We walked everywhere and came “home” to a comfortable and cool (hooray for AC!) apartment at the end of the day. Brijid was so helpful and quick to respond to any questions we had and her instructions were clear and easy to follow. It was absolutely perfect for our family of four!

Vitalina was a fantastic and responsive host- even staying up until midnight to let us in after a flight from Australia. House was clean and tidy. East walking distance to lots of restaurants and the metro station. Vitalina provided a map and info on how to get to the main sights. Would throughly recommend as a place to stay

The apartment was a great place to stay, close to 2 different Metro lines so very convenient. A couple of great bakeries and Bistros within a block or two. Comfortable and quiet apartment, fit 2 adults and 2 kids nicely. Look forward to returning one day!

This is a great apartment in my favourite area of Paris. Tucked away in a courtyard , it is quiet and yet so close to Montparnasse Boulevard. Anne was very kind and helpful. The apartment was so comfortable and well looked after.  A perfect stay for my wife and I,  plus  our two children (12&15).We would definitely highly recommend and want to return.
Street was a little messy and was noisy even at night.  The apartment was nice, clean  and matched the description.

Simply a perfect place! Beautiful Neighborhood, very well located, high quality building with high quality apartment. Loved the 70's style decoration. You can't ask more. We were party of 4 very comfy in the 2 queen sized beds.
The place was nice, very quiet, close to subway, supermarket, boulangery, etc Benoit was cery kind and accommodating with check in and check out time.  All in all, a nice place to stay in Paris!
Matt’s place was very comfortable, squeaky clean and we had a lovely stay. I recommend it to anyone who wants to discover this beautiful and fun area of Paris: classy, cultured and great cafes!

I had the pleasure of staying at this Airbnb apartment in Paris, and it was an absolutely delightful experience. The apartment was cozy, with a tasteful decor that beautifully captured the quintessential Parisian charm. It was a home away from home.The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and equipped with all the necessary amenities. The host was also extremely helpful and made sure that my stay was comfortable. Every corner of the apartment was thoughtfully designed, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.In summary, this Airbnb apartment in Paris exceeded my expectations in every way. It was not just a place to stay, but a significant part of my Parisian experience. I highly recommend it to anyone planning a trip to Paris.
Alex’s place was fabulous. Great location, super clean and easy to check in. We would highly recommend.

Nice little place that was perfect for my solo trip. It’s probably too small for more than one person, and the shower is small enough that I don’t think a taller/bigger person would be comfortable- I’m petite and still struggled a bit. But, the place was great for me, easy to walk where I wanted to go. Having laundry in the unit (washer, no dryer) was awesome. And I was surprised with how comfortable the sofa bed was.

Our stay was great! Monique and her husband were so lovely and welcoming. They gave us recommendations to check out during the day and made it feel like home whilst we were there. Would definitely try to book with them again if we are ever in Paris.

Lafkir’s unit is perfect. It was better than originally envisioned when I started looking for a place to stay in Paris. The view from the balcony is unforgettable and I could have spent a lifetime sitting, watching the city streets, and looking at the Eiffel Tower. There is not a better place to stay. Lafkir was very responsive, reasonable, and helpful. Highly recommend this stay.
Central location that’s very walkable and accessible to many places that we wanted to visit. The home was indeed quiet and cozy. Seb was a great host.
Wow!!! This apartment was fantastic. It was extremely clean, centrally located and was perfect for our little family of 4. I would highly recommend. And additional bonus was daily housekeeping.

We loved staying here! The balcony was beautiful, the metro was close, the street and apartment felt very safe, and there were delicious bakeries down the street! We will definitely stay here again when visiting Paris!
I’m so happy with choosing this hotel. Super friendly staff. Nice room and breakfast. Very close to train station but still a calm street. Would recommend this hotel to my friends
Nice flat well located near lots of shops restaurants and supermarkets open till very late.Near metro and place de la NationVery alive part of Paris

Excellent location, great restaurants and bars in the area, easy to get around on foot. Great communication with Alex who gave some excellent recommendations. The only thing was that the bed was a little small for us.
Clean , spacious, well-equipped, beautiful . Located in a very good place. Many good restaurants are just near by and easy to get to metro and shopping places. Highly recommend!

We had a fantastic 3 night stay at Mai’s place. Ideal for the Latin quarter, Notre Dame and walks along the Seine.A chilled part of Paris with a really good vibeThe accommodation met all our expectations being clean and good amenities Thank you

Sandra's apartment in Montmartre is fantastic. The location is the best part: you will be in a charming old building in a wonderful neighborhood in Paris, unique and beautiful, close to a number of landmarks like Sacre Coeur and Moulin Rouge, but not directly in a busy touristic area. You are on a small, quiet, local street with a number of excellent cafes and restaurants just down the block.Sandra is a very nice, responsive host, and the apartment is very clean, cozy and homey.This is a great place to stay!
The place was fantastic.  Paul however did not respond which caused me to call him.  We checked in well after the 3pm checkin time which was frustrating and caused us to miss our evening plans.

Marie responded to all queries immediately and the appartment was beautifully decorated. The use of space was very clever as we never felt cramped. The location was perfect as it was near a lovely park, Chaumont-Buttes, as well as many amenities.
We had a wonderful stay at Jean-Luc's place, it was in a great area and everything was easily accessible. Would certainly recommend!Asante Sana!

Stephan's location was perfect. It was accessible to tourist sites but did not feel touristy.  He was very communicative and great with tips about the neighborhood. The place was as described, and the small nook overseeing the street was great. Highly recommend it.
Thank you for a very memorable stay. The apartment was perfect and so well situated, close to the tube stations and restaurants, shops and sites.

Our stay at Edgar Suites was one of the best Airbnb in Europe so far. The apartment was squeaky clean and felt like home. the check-in process was really simple just enter the code and you get in. The laundry area was really spacious and the dryer was a life saver. The kitchenette was really purpose built and had everything stove, dishwasher,oven fridge. the dining table was very big easily seated 6 people. The bathroom was grand which I didn't expect in Paris. Both the rooms were spacious and mattresses were really comfortable. The view of the outdoor patio was very amazing and gave a soothing effect. Overall our stay at Edgar Suites was just like we were at home. On our next trip to Paris this is our first and only chose. keep it up!
Fantastic location  for this stay!  Place is tiny but for the price it is as good as you will get in Paris. Clean and funtional.
Excellent apartment, it was very clean and 10-15 minute walk from Eiffel Tower. Would highly recommend this air bnb.

We stayed with our 2-year old for 4 nights. The neighbourhood is great if you look for a family-friendly area with lots of restaurant and shopping options and great access to the Metro. The apartment is cute and tidy, and offers everything you need with a small child.
Fernanda was polite and friendly. Even though there was a language barrier she tried her best to communicate. She ensured everything was ok
Great place to stay. Quite close to metro, with sightseeing close by.  Excellent amenities and very quiet.All in all a very enjoyable place to stay.

The place was just as described but better the bathrooms was beautiful...the only 2 things i.suggest is putting a full length mirror on the main floor and having more detailed on how to operate the washing machine and tvs and in English for people like me that doesn't know nothing in French
Great clean comfortable place in a very nice location. Close to metro and easy to get around. Very pleased and would come again!

Paul is an excellent and extremely responsive host. The AirBnB was very conveniently located and easy to get around from. The place was cozy and had everything we needed. Check-in and check-out is straightforward and simple. Highly recommended!
The apartment was perfectly located. We walked everywhere with no problem. Cindy responded quickly with any questions I had. Although Paris had a heat wave, the apartment stayed cool.
The place is very clean and in cosy neighbourhood. Helena always responded quickly. The lock on the toilet door was a bit broken, but everything else was perfect! Would recommend.
Lovely flat! Pull out is very comfortable and the location is amazing! Very clean. Awesome responsive hosts. Walking distance to montremarte and mall. Would def recommend !

It’s hard to capture the elegance and quality of this space in photos. There is such a lovely attention to detail any creative person will appreciate the level of taste and restraint. But there is also attention to detail in all the comforts of home at your fingertips. Lots of space with an authenticity that is intrinsically French delivering the total experience. The location is so special we did everything from a miam miam sandwiches and the best croissants to vintage to high end streetwear shopping for my daughter. I would only ask if someday Tiphaine would share her color palette with me. She made it very simple to have a great time. We would jump at a chance to stay again.
We loved our stay in Paris. This accommodation was perfect for our needs. Very clean and comfortable. Thank you to the hosts who keep a lovely accommodation 👍✨
Wonderful location and lovely apartment. Stairs may be a challenge for some as others have commented. Comfortable bed useful kitchen and great location! Enjoyed our stay.
John’s apartment is perfectly situated for exploring the 10th arrondissement, especially all the cafes and stores along the canal.

My husband and I loved staying here! Julien helped with check-in and even let us check in early since our flight arrived before the designated check-in time. The apartment was very clean and had everything you need! The shower was big and had a rainfall showerhead as well as a detachable one. The location was great for visiting the louvre, opera, seine, etc. Everything was walkable! We definitely recommend Clarisse’s place if you’re staying in Paris.
Denka's place was clean and comfortable.The location was perfect. Very close to metro station and has many restaurants nearby.

Excellent location, clean and tidy. Good size washer/dryer which came in handy. Kitchen was compact but was well equipped. Small hot water issue which the host arranged a technican to fix. Other than that, great stay. Would recommend.

Sirine's apartment is situated in the 11th and close to several well-known restaurants such as Paul Bert. It is only less than 400 yards from the closest subway station, but at the same time, quiet at night in a safe neighborhood. The apartment is bigger than pictures suggest with a living room, kitchen, bathroom and one bedroom. This is bigger than your average 1BR apartment in say, New York. The building is nice too with a beautiful exterior. Thankfully, there's also an elevator, making it convenient to move luggage to and from the apartment. Sirine is also great at communicating throughout our trip and helped us a lot. Highly recommend!

We loved this place.. very French! The building is attractive and quiet. The Walk up could be an issue, as other reviewers have stated.. But once you make the initial assent, Life is good. Paul was very helpful. If anything, a days worth of refreshing might help.. a little pealing wallpaper a missing bathroom knob.. nothing to worry about. Overall, the place is in excellent condition and had everything we needed to enjoy a lovely stay. The bedding was very nice. And having a bath after a long walk in Paris divine.
We stayed for 3 nights and it was a wonderful trip. Easy to check-in. Nice view on a small balcony. Very clean and cozy. Good Location for trips to Montmatre and city centre.
A lovely little apartment, nicely decorated in Montmatre - calm in the daytime and bustling at night. Anthony was really helpful and responsive. Would certainly recommend.

We absolutely loved Stephane’s place in Paris. We were able to walk to all attractions and loved having so many restaurants to choose from all around us. There is a supermarket directly across the street and we loved the view from the little terrace window. Everything was immaculately clean, which I so appreciate.
Delphine’s place was homely and interesting. The location is nice - a block away from the canal and approximately 25mins walk to place de La Republique.

Fabulous location in the fun, bustling Marais - quiet street with very secure double entrance. Easily walkable to bars, coffee shops, restaurants and shopping. Apartment is very clean and nicely appointed. It is how we very small and really only appropriate for two people if you want to have a little space to move around. Loved having a shower for each bedroom but would be extremely tight for two adults using the bathroom at the same time. Toilet is in a TINY room in the sitting area . This is a door but it doesn’t feel really private - all fine though as long as you are traveling with close friends or family! I would definitely recommend and rent it again.A couple suggestions:A full length mirror is greatly needed as is a trash can in each bathroom… only one bath had a trash can.
Perfect, tidy little apartment in Paris including a lovely balcony! We had a really nice stay. Pauline is very friendly, we had an easy check in and very flexible check out. Definitely recommend!
We had a great stay here, thank you to Gilbert for being so helpful and welcoming. The place was spotless and had everything we needed. Would definitely book again.
Luke’s place is a lovely little getaway to access all of the sights of Paris! It is a small space but perfect for a short visit and exactly as pictured. Very easy access to Paris via metro or Bus!

Fabulous location in arguably the best part of the city!  Grocery store below, wine shop across the street, restaurant and bars in every direction.  Walkable distance of Sacre-Coeur.  Metro stops walkable in either direction.  Rentable bikes around the corner.  On and on... can't go wrong with this one!

Beautiful place with beautiful people. 10/10 would recommend this stay. Hannelore and her husband were so amazing and their place is super cute and has everything you need. They even provided us breakfast, and we had a little afternoon snack with them. Location is close to the metro, cute cafe across the road, and a park. One of the best stays we've had.
Top class place. Brilliant location and lovely apartment. Ed was great for communication and check-in was a breeze. We will definitely stay there again.
We felt very at home in Antoine’s place for our stay (9 days.) Loved getting to know his area of Montmartre, maybe as much as the rest of Paris!
Lovely place to stay. Cedric was very hospitable and helpful. Myself and my husband really enjoyed staying there. Definitely recommend 👍

I stayed at Sebastian’s place with my 9 year old daughter. It is a small apartment and it was perfect for us. We are vegetarian and like to make food instead of eating out all the time so it was very convenient for us to have a small clean kitchen and a very nice supermarket nearby. We could walk to Nortre Dame snd Louvre museum. We could take the bus easily to ho other places. Overall we had s good experience.

Alice's apartment is very bright, decorated with an artistic touch, lots of flower pots.  Close to connections for public transport. Surrounding is nice with bars and restaurants and of course  with boulangeries! We enjoyed our stay here!

Joy was a great host, always responsive and helpful for a seamless check-in and check-out. Great location for any visiting point in Paris thanks to the underground hub Nation which is 5 minutes away by foot.
Great place in a great location, with a very responsive and accomodating host. Thank you!
I really liked the location. Please don’t accept room 121 on the first floor, I was unable to sleep due to noise , I guess from the stairs.

Honestly the space was easy to find surrounding was gorgeous. Host answers quickly and has positive vibes. The space is just right for one person and would recommend if it’s your first time in Paris. Though the bathroom is outside there’s minimal interaction with neighbors but overall people are nice.
Nice little apartment in a good location. Host was super responsive to all requests and let us check in early.
Great apartment with functional kitchen, fridge and freezer. Easy walk to large metro station with 3 lines. Patisserie located on ground floor is a bonus

Laurent’s Airbnb was superb! Great location and spacious for 5 guests. Kitchen is well-stocked with pots, pans, and dishes. Elevator can only fit 3 people maximum or 2 people with luggage. But it is quick, so not a problem. The street noise is loud, but we slept through it. Wonderful experience!!!
Lovely, friendly host and great apartment. Spotless and comfortable. Good location with the metro, supermarket and bakery nearby. We had a great holiday.

Amazing stay in the perfect location. Yohann graciously accepted an early check in (perfect for a group of four who flew in on a red eye and had a limited time in Paris) - the welcome manual was so detailed so we had ample time to prepare for what to expect. Great communication throughout. Merci!
Great stay - very responsive host!Only point is that there are several sets of stairs and if you have big bags this could be problematic.
Delphine was awesome and made me feel at home from day 1! I could not recommend her more as she was very helpful and inviting throughout my stay!

I am glad that we found this place for our 1st family vacation in Paris , perfect for family vacation.We had a blast, and it's walkable distance to Eiffel tower.Everything was clean and nice as we entered the house.We will definitely come back again.Highly recommend.Hsiao Lin has been a great host, very responsive 😊

Absolutely incredible apartment in a great location. Center of everything you’d want to do while visiting Paris. Extremely quiet location - if you’re looking for peace and rest, this is perfect. Communicative host, and even allowed for some flexibility in early checkin. Would absolutely recommend to family/friends.
Convenient studio apartment. Very small but had what was needed for a couple of nights stay. Very near the metro.
The rooms were really nice and polite for us!! They explain plenty information to support when in trouble.The room was clean and the bed was really comfortable and made us sleep well:))

Great host, super friendly, and amicable! The neighborhood is great too.Keep in mind the gates have a closing time so you will have to coordinate in advance with Agnes to enter or leave during closing hours. She is very helpful so it was not a problem.
Very happy with our stay. Fabulous location. Gorgeous apartment building. Super quiet and very well presented. Would recommend.
Great place and fantastic location! It’s certainly an Airbnb that we will use again when we go back to Paris. The location is superb, indeed.
Had a very lovely stay. The house and the small backyard was very cozy and perfect for our trip. JF helped us out with what we needed and responded quickly. Very recommended:-)
A really great location in Paris! Tomaso was a great host and very helpful. The place is very clean, spacious and the view from the balcony is beautiful. Highly recommend.

Cindy’s apartment is very well located. There are lots of great restaurants and brasseries nearby. The apartment is very cosy and clean with everything we needed. Cindy was very responsive to our questions.  Highly recommended.

Othelie was very responsive and tgere was excellent communication throughout my daughter’s stay. Othelie was welcoming and checkin and out was smooth. The apartment was very comfortable and clean and a home from home experience. Thank you Othelie for your great hosting and assistance.

I had a wonderful time in Paris. Marie’s place was the icing on the cake. Lovely apartment, easy to get around as it is close to multiple metro stations. There’s some really cute restaurants nearby and also a Carrefour on the same street. The place was clean and cared for with great attention to detail. I’d highly recommend this place! It’s so cute and inspiring. Enjoy!
