Great place, very central. Could be great with allowable early check in and late check out even at a cost. Otherwise great quite place
Merci Didier for an amazing time in Paris. We felt so at home and it is such a wonderful neighborhood for families. We hope to return soon
Erwan was ever present to deal with queries and very helpful. Spotless and perfectly located apartment which was perfect for a Christmas break. I will definitely stay again

Super easy check in and easy to coordinate with. Space is a little smaller than in pictures, but it was cozy and provided all my needs. Neighborhood is close to metro stations and very quiet/safe, but only a few minutes away from restaurants. Will definitely stay here again!

Pierre and Irene are friendly host. It is easy to get to their place using the Metro. The place also seems incredibly safe. It is easy to get to majority of the attractions and you could see the eiffel tower from the room. The guests have their shared bathroom but not much problem to that.

I really liked staying at this place. It was in a central location, the room was comfortable, and it had all the services that were announced. Bathroom had heating which I really loved. I would stay there again.

The apartment was spacious, clean and in an ideal location. It was just a few minutes walk to the Eiffel Tower, grocery store, metro, wonderful Boulangeries and great restaurants. It is well equipped. We were pleased that it was a ground floor unit, it made it so easy to bring our luggages in and out. Vanessa was a pleasure to communicate with. We look forward to staying in the future.

Hélène and Alain are very friendly and lovely hosts. Gave me great recommendations on what to do, assisting with my travels for the whole duration of my stay. The space is clean and in a great location too.

We had a lovely stay at Mandana’s place! It was the perfect apartment for our time in Paris. Great location in Bastille. Mandana was very helpful and always checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. Would highly recommend her apartment if you want to feel right at home 🙂

That was ok but the smell of the apartment was so bad!!! The flat needs a better cleaning!!!The neighborhood is safe and full of local friendly people.The host had a so well organized home book and gave us on time all the information needed.
Clemence was wonderful and so helpful! the apartment is gorgeous, in a lovely neighborhood, and in pristine condition. I would 100% recommend anyone stay here

For one night in Paris was perfect! Definitely only for one person, but very clean and everything I needed. The stairs were a bit exhausting (6 flights), but that is extremely common in Paris. 5 minutes to trocadero and trains to the rest of the city, so very accessible. Beverly was so helpful. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Absolutely loved staying here. Amazing location, lots of light, a great place to come home to every day, and it felt like home. Mao is incredibly friendly, helpful, and communicative. I would love to stay here again during a future trip.

Very centrally located, well furnished appartment. Typical Parisian flat which was quite spacious for the city (for 3 adults and 2 kids). Many restaurants, pharmacy and shops within walking distance including Les Halles (Châtelet). Small elevator was useful for larger suitcases and young kids who don’t want to walk the 4 floors. Hosts were responsive for any questions.

A great stay at this place. Check in was easy and flexible with good responses from the host. The studio itself was clean and exactly as described. Loads of local amenities, including restaurants, cafes, bakery and fast food. The host recommended some great places to eat and party. The surrounding area of the flat is very secure in a quiet area.
Beautiful place to stay. As described and felt extremely safe - perfect place if you’re going to moulin rouge. Thank you
Vanessa i s a great guy, and we enjoyed our stay. It's quiet and clean. It is convenient to shop nearby, very close to the subway station. I will recommend it to my friends.

This was the most amazing experience. I feel so lucky to have experienced Paris for the first time through this apartment and neighborhood. We found the restaurants to be excellent and loved that it was less touristy but you could easily hop on the metro and get anywhere in 20 minutes. We had everything we needed in the apartment. The beds were comfy. The views are beyond belief. I just loved it and would love to return.

We loved our stay at Georges and Sylvie's apartment! The location can't be beat and is a short walk away from lots of great bakeries, cafes, and restaurants. The apartment was also very well stocked and laid out, and Dimitri was extremely helpful in checking us in and making sure that we had everything we needed. Would love to stay again the next time we're in Paris.

Amazing area the metro is very close to get around the Emily in Paris restaurant & fountain is literally down the street it feels very safe even at night the building has a code which feels extremely safe the only downside I had was no WiFi & having to share restrooms but that is listed so I can’t complain would stay again the area is extremely nice in my opinion would recommend if you do not mind not having the things I listed

We stayed at Marc's place with 6 adults and a baby.  The purpose of our visit was primarily to spend time with family, and secondarily to tour Paris.  As such Marcs place was wonderful.  Located in a quite, less touristy neighborhood of Paris, close to the Gare du Nord train station (which we used to get to Amsterdam after our visit), we felt right at home.  The house is as described, and as appears in the photos.  To begin we were greated by his assistant Nathalie who speaks fluent english and helped us check in and familiarize ourselves.  The kitchen had everything we needed to cook.  The washing machined worked well.  The house is supplied with shampoo and body wash.  The living room is spacious.  The beds have good quality cushions and sheets.  In all the place is great and highly recommended.

We had an amazing time at Paul’s place. Everything about his place was as described. Location is super close to the Eiffel Tower and the neighborhood is peaceful to stroll through. I would definitely recommend staying here if you’re planning a trip to Paris.
Gorgeous space situated  in a fabulous neighbourhood of Paris. Very closed to everything, yet wasn’t too noisy. Haiyan was  corporative and very helpful, will stay there again.
I had such a great time in Paris. The location was a short walk from the station. I would highly recommend!
Met by friend of Mao at access.  Place was very clean, some road noise but location overrid this.
Fantastic location! Easy to get everywhere. The daily cleaning service was a great addition. Great communication from the host at all times as well. We would definitely stay here again.

Great place to stay in Paris. Few minutes walk to Eiffel Tower and lots of nearby restaurants,  supermarket and train station. Hsiao Lin is very responsive and the description of the apartment is very accurate and more so, exceed our expectations! Definitely recommended specially on big group like us (7 adults plus kids)

This place is great, it may seem far from all the sights to see but it is steps away from a metro station that will take you to all the Paris staples. It’s also conveniently located directly across from a fine grocery store and next to a very good bakery. Overall it is a great spot

The location was great and the space very comfortable. Some small challenges with communication - incorrect information for the lockbox code and the wifi network did not work for the two days of my stay.

We really enjoyed our time in Paris, the location we really liked, short walk to major attractions and to the metro. Shops and cafes extremely close. The apartment had everything we needed and was basically what we expected. Bathroom is small. Overall a great budget option.

We loved the apartment! It was so close to everywhere we wanted to go, and the animals were so sweet! Kathleen was a great host and the beautiful accommodations in the heart of Paris greatly contributed to our wonderful experience!
Great place. Spacious enough, both rooms were quite big. Very effective for a weekend in Paris.
Cozy, Clean, and Convenient. I would stay here again for my next solo trip in Paris and will also recommend this place to all my friends.

This was a great location, very close to the major sights, and lots of good restaurants nearby. The property was private, safe, clean, spacious, and met our needs. Jean-Luc was a wonderful host, who was very responsive and provided clear instructions.

This was a Parisian dream. Beautiful decor and such a comfy bed! Exactly what we needed for our trip to Paris! Breakfast was delicious and the hosts were very accommodating and kind! We hope to be back!!
Amazing apartment, super clean, looks just like in the pictures..host very responsive.Felt like home, will def stay again! Great location too.

The apartment matched the pictures and was very clean.We met the kind manager briefly , other than that, all communication was via messages, which wasn't a problem. The kitchen was very  well equiped. All four of us were really happy to stay there and had a great time.
The locatuon was amazing ! The host was really helpful when we have a problem or a question. the place was clean and tidy. Definitely stay in this place if you have a chance !

The apartment is in a very good location close to the train station and attractions. Check in was simple, and apartment looked just like the photos. It can get noisy during the night, and shower wasn’t draining well during our stay. Otherwise, it was an enjoyable stay.
A home from home in Paris Very comfortable flat for 4 people in good accessible location if you are comfortable with the metroGreat balconies and viewsHandy kitchen and seating area
Aude is great - very proactive with clear instructions and very responsive to any queries. The apartment is really lovely and exactly as advertised. Merci, Aude!

Amazing location - in a lively neighborhood, but on a quiet street, easy walking to many popular spots, public transportation close.  Very clean.  Comfortable beds.  Easy access and instructions.  Was perfect for our family of 5 staying for a week, definitely would stay again.

John’s place is really great not only because it was very clean and everything a person could need was provided, but also because of its location. It’s close to multiple different metro stations which can take you into the centre of Paris in 10 min. It also has two different Supermarkets right by it, lots of different bistros (a great one to try is Brasserie Au Comptoir) and of course boulangeries! And it’s close to canal St. Martin. John is also a great host as his response time is very quick and friendly. I would definitely recommend this place if you ever visit Paris whether as a solo traveller or with another person.

Louise’s apartment was lovely and perfect for our family of 3. Louise also made an effort to leave out items that would be useful for us given we were traveling with a baby. We loved the neighborhood - lots of great restaurants and shops in walking distance but still very quiet in the apartment itself. Would stay again!
Great apartment. Very neat and clean and near the Metro station.Paul was very responsive and helpful.The area was also very central.

This place is in a perfect location for visiting Paris. It’s in walking distance to the major museums, Notre Dame, the Metro, shops and cafes. It’s small but had everything we needed and more. It’s an attractively decorated space with great light. It’s in a busy area but quiet inside.

Charles met us at check-in and showed us around, offered recommendations, and even checked in to make sure our trip was going well. His home is gorgeous and close to multiple metro stops. We had an amazing trip and staying in such a comfortable home was the cherry on top!
The place could have been more clean and there were some dishes/cups missing for more than 3 people but overall it was superb and I can recommend.
Joan and Sophie were extremely accommodating. The apartment was clean and matched the description. It is close to the metro station, making it easy to move around Paris from their address.

My recent Airbnb experience exceeded all expectations, thanks to a remarkable host. Despite unconventional filming requirements, she was incredibly accommodating, making the entire process smooth and stress-free. I highly recommend her property for a hassle-free stay.
Loved this place. Eiffel Tower was just around the corner with a view from the window. Everything else is walkable with the metro down the street.

Excellent locationSpacious apartment with good sized rooms, by European standardA word of caution! Global warming necessitates Airconditioners in April in Paris tooVery good area with excellent and many many restaurants and bars within walking distanceStrongly recommend this Air BNB Keep it up Laurent and PaulaNever met Laurent, but Paula made our checkin and stay very comfortableShe was good and proactive in communicating Zero complaints

Elsa’s place was exactly how it showed in the pictures. The place was fully renovated with modern furniture and decoration. The sofa bed was very comfortable unlike other sofa beds. Elsa was very prompt in responding to our questions and giving us recommendations (Chez Margot, So Hotel, bakery) We would definitely recommend this place.

We absolutely loved the location. We were close to the metro, local sights and lots of restaurants. We also had enough space to spread out comfortably, which is unheard of in Paris. We had everything we needed and more, and we would absolutely stay here again.

Very pleased with our stay at Adrien's place. Adrien was communicative and provided us with very clear instruction on how to find the apartment, how to use the amenities and best places in the vicinity of the apartment.
We had a very pleasant stay at Elsa’s.  As everyone commented, Elsa was always responsive and friendly.  Everything worked out great 👍😊
A tiny little spot placed within good distance to the Louvre and Notre Dame. It can be quite loud through the night but that’s to be expected.
The place was exactly as described.  Great for our family with 3 teenage boys.  Thanks Charles!

We enjoyed our stay!  In a quieter part of Paris, at least while we were there.  The location mmediate access to transit, to get to other parts of Paris, and Elsa recommended a great bistro! Felt safe and secure.

Would be five stars if we had some suggestions on the neighborhood restaurants etc.  Really this is a great area for restaurants but we weren’t given any information in that sense.  The location is great since there is easy access to several metro lines.   Very clean, well organized with well equipped kitchen.  I would recommend it if you don’t the fourth floor walk up. Tony was very responsive and communicated quickly 👍🏽👍🏽

Beautiful, huge for Paris standards with tons of light. One of the best Airbnb’s I’ve ever been to and I’ve been to a lot of Airbnbs. Very classy yet comfortable. No shoer just huge bathtub with hand held shower fitting. Highly recommended.
My group of 4 had a wonderful stay at this perfectly situated flat. Modern amenities with comfortable beds, this property was a great place for relaxing and sleeping while exploring Paris.

Stay was amazing, perfectly located within walking and view distance of the Eiffel Tower as well as train/bus transportation to go anywhere in the city right outside the door. Perfect place for people looking to explore Paris

Sophie was a great host, very easy to communicate with and friendly. The location couldn't have gotten any better too! Easy walk to many cafes ans restaurants as well as metro/RER stops. Would love to come back here in the future, thank you for being a superhost!
Pierre & Irene are perfect host. easy to communicate and friendly. They have also lots of ideas which are helpful to explore Paris. I stongly recommend their place! Merci Pierre et Irene!

Great location - within 30 min by metro to a lot of the museums and in a residential area where there’s lots of good cafes, bakeries, and grocery stores. The interior was beautifully designed and well maintained. Highly recommend walking along the Ave Daumesnil!

One of my best experiences with Airbnb apartments and the hosts. The apartment is gorgeous, very spacious with everything you need. I found my room exactly as it was described. Kathleen was very welcoming and very helpful throughout my stay despite the fact that we missed each other. The cats are friendly and lovely and make you feel at home. 10/10 would recommend and stay again

We had an enjoyable few days at this apartment! It was as shown in the photos, clean and organized. The location is amazing…lots of great cafes, restaurants, attractions and metro stops all within close walking distance! Kevin was an excellent communicator and always available when needed.

We were looking for two nights near Gare Montparnasse, as we had to catch a train from that station. Benjamin's apartment was the perfect spot. It is away from the most touristy areas and in a neighbourhood mostly frequented by locals, which appealed to us. Metro stations were easy to reach, taxis were plentiful and there were plenty of cafes and restaurants in the area. We particularly enjoyed exploring the Rue Daguerre markets and patisseries.Benjamin was quick to respond to our needs and provided a lovely place for a stay in Paris, at a very reasonable rate. Would stay there again.

Great for a short stay, the location was amazing, it felt safe, not that touristy and the Luxembourg gardens were very close - perfect for walks and breakfast! The accommodation was small, but clean and the host would always respond right away, we could even check in a few hours earlier. :) Would definitely recommend, if you are planning to walk all day and only need a place to sleep.

I loved staying here! It was so comfortable, I felt like I was visiting a friend. Julia was so fast and helpful in her communication. I am already thinking of when I can go back. Location was great for walking to the Eiffel Tower and seeing lots of other sights!
We had an amazing time in Paris. Everything was perfect, with good windows that let us have breakfast with the sun. Thank you!
Charles is a wonderful host - the definition of why Airbnb exists - cares for his home for himself and sets it up perfectly for his guests . wonderful weekend in Paris :)

I highly recommend staying here. It is a great location with lots of restaurants, shopping, and tourist attractions within walking distance. We had a small issue with the lock (our fault) and Paul was very responsive and quick to help us out.

Françoise is so so nice and gave me a lot of advice about traveling in Paris. She was very considerate, and during the trip, when I suddenly had an allergic reaction, she offered me a lot of help and care. Her house is beautiful and spacious, full of vintage charm, and conveniently located. Super pleasant experience!

He was a great host. I loved the book with recommendations. It was clean, cozy, and very easy to get it. There were great instructions and directions giving. I would definitely stay here again. We had a flight cancellation and we had to leave earlier. The host was very responsive and helpful. He even offered and gave a refund, for something that wasn't his fault. Wonderful person, and Awesome host!

I found this apartment  in the center of Paris by chance when I was looking for accommodation just to stay for one night on a transit.The apartment was very pretty ,the bed was very comfortable. & the metro station was just a 2 min walk.I was very fortunate & happy to have found such a nice apartment by chance 🍀❤️Next time I’ll come back for a longer stay !!!

We loved our stay in Paris at Bruno’s airbnb! As soon as you arrive and look outside the window you see the beautiful Eiffel Tower!! Bruno was very helpful and always responsive, he even left us pastries when our flight was delayed! The studio was small (as to be expected in Paris) but we still managed to move around with 2 big suitcases and lots of shopping - also made having an elevator to the 6th floor a dream! Would 100% stay here again!
Great apartment in quiet place wifi was great apartment feels very safe and short walk to metro also there’s easy check in and Helena was a perfect host
I felt right like home in this beautiful studio full of light and with a view on a garden. Unlike many places this one has a soul thanks to the nice hostess!

Honestly this was one of our best Airbnb experiences. Erwan’s place is very quiet even in a busy neighborhood. We loved the neighborhood and Erwan is a very gracious host and gave good recommendations! The bed is also very comfortable and the bathroom spacious. Highly recommend!

Great area and check in and checkout process easy. I appreciated the flexible check in time. The place was a bit more run down than it appeared in pictures but overall clean and had all amenities as advertised.

Fernanda was a wonderful host and was very happy to be of help with whatever we needed however I must say that I was shocked by how small the unit was and that we had a shared toilet in the passageway. Per square metre of space I found the unit very expensive but I suppose this is to be expected with public transport and the Eiffel Tower being so close.

We are a lovely stay for two nights. Co-host Maria was very responsive and even met us at the apartment to give us the keys when our flight arrived late. The location is great—walking distance to Montmartre, 10 minutes to Gare l’Est, and right next to a metro station. The apartment was spotless and very quiet.
This was the perfect location in Paris! So close to great bars and restaurants. Ines was super responsive and helpful as well, really made everything a breeze!

A lovely stay. The place was exactly as described in the listing, and very clean and well-kept. Denka was such a great host and always so responsive. Readily accommodated my request for a later check-in due to a last minute delay! Highly recommend!

The place is beautiful, clean and as shown in photos. Less than a block to the metro. Close to Boulanger & brasserie, as well as supermarket. Beautiful outlook over courtyard. Peaceful neighbourhood away from the chaos and noise of the city. An ideal location to stay in this beautiful city.
The apartment was nice and clean, and Chloe was very welcoming. There was a problem with the lock, but if this will be changed - everything else was perfect.

We loved staying at Erwan’s flat! It was spacious and comfortable in a great location. Walking distance to lots of great coffee and food options as well as public transit. Erwan was a super responsive and welcoming host with lots of recommendations for the neighborhood!
we had a really comfortable  stay.very clean apartment.very nice staff. ready to assist.
While one of the rooms had a very powerful mold smell, everything else was ok. I was satisfied by my two day stay here.

The neighborhood is very quiet and close to many cafes, restaurants, the metro and more. The apartment was large enough to comfortably accommodate our family of 4. The couch is very wide and soft and the kids had no complaints.

We had a great stay at Bruno’s lovely airy apartment. It’s spacious and comfortable.The location is good, close to the metro and bus services. Lots of places to eat and drink in nearby streets. Bruno was very accommodating and friendly.
We had such a great trip to Paris, this place is in a perfect spot, lots of places to eat and close to the metro.  Also had an awesome rooftop deck as advertised!
We loved our stay! The flat was beautifully appointed, the view was drop dead gorgeous, and our hosts were wonderfully responsive. We would recommend it highly and hope to stay there again.
The location of the apartment is great each access to shopping and the metro. Had some complications with the wi fi but host was very responsive.

We stayed at Alexis's lovely home with our 2 1/2 year old. The apartment was as described - clean and welcoming. The brilliant neighbourhood was so easy to get to from the Gare du Nord. We enjoyed lots of the independent shops, including the wonderful toyshop.
A great apartment in a lovely neighbourhood. Very close to the Metro, very clean and in a quiet area.

My husband and I spent two nights at John’s place and had a great time. He was very accommodating when we arrived much later than expected, which we greatly appreciated. We walked everywhere - the Louvre, Notre Dame, etc - long walks but if you don’t mind walking you can get around on foot just fine. There were lots of nearby restaurants as well.

We loved our stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and centrally located. Elsa was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Definitely recommend, and we would stay here again! Thank you, Elsa!

To be honest, I have a lot of good things to say about this Michael, his team, and the entire experience.I just have to get to the point though - I love the entire AirBnB experience!They made our vacation totally memorable!The instructions were on point! Nothing more, nothing less.They have complete amenities! If you'd rather just stay in your room, it'll be like a total vacation itself.Best part are:1. Place is way cheaper than anywhere near it.2. Totally walkable to most sights!3. Michael was so helpful and had assisted us all the way.From the bottom of my heart, thank you so much for making my first Paris experience magical!
Everything about Luc’s apartment in Paris was just perfect for my family! We were able to walk to everything and experience the beauty, history, and of course the delicious food of Paris.
We were only there for a few hours overnight,  but it was a really cool place, very clean, close to everything, and quite lovely overall!

Fantastic location for exploring Paris with a large group.  The metro is a two min walk away and the line takes you right to the heart of Paris.  My kids loved the back yard and Mont Rouge had many options for breakfast and dinner.
Great host & great location with a lively atmosphere. Lots of bars & restaurants good metro links or easy walk down to the Seine. Had a great time & will definitely go back!
We enjoyed the stay very much.  Excellent location. Near everything. Apartment was clean and was perfect for my family of five

Hélène & Alain were not merely accommodating, they were intuitive to guest needs. Friendly and available yet also respectful of space and privacy. The space is perfect for a solo traveler who wants to experience a real Paris neighborhood - away from the tourist traps but also only a short train ride away from all the classics (Louvre, etc.).

My new favorite place to stay in the Marais with our two small children. A beautiful couple hosting their beautiful home. Much thought and consideration has gone into this place. Recent, very modern, and sensible renovations while retaining the soul and integrity of emblematic hausmann architecture. Close to everything - the best boulangeries, bistros, museums, and restaurants. Perfect. Home away from home.
Beautiful view and perfect for our plans in Paris this time!  Comfortable and easy to get around the area.  Would definitely stay again!
Great location! Walking distance to most major tourist locations. plenty of restaurants around. Our family had a great time here
Great place to stay in Paris! Easy check-in and the apartment was very clean. Also great communication by the host when we had some small issues with the kitchen. Would stay here again!
I had a great stay at Pierre’s apartment! It had a great little kitchen and spacious living room. I would definitely go back!

Really a pleasant place for a short stay in Paris, easy to reach almost all famous spots in Paris. Ling is super friendly and provides support before and during our stay. Will definitely recommend this place.

The location was perfect for my family of 4 (two teens) for our 3 night stay. We walked everywhere and Metro was super convenient.  The Pompidou is visible from the balcony and so many dining options within a short walk.The front bedroom was louder than the rear, but to be expected on a major street in Paris. Although we didn't spend much time there, the balcony was just what we were looking for and was used every moment we were in the apt.  The photos are accurate and beds were great.   The Wifi was as struggle but David and even the apt owner jumped in to help trouble shoot with us.   We had a wonderful time in Paris and likely due to the convenient location of the apartment.

We had the best stay at this apartment!The location was absolutely perfect, super central, right in the heart of Paris. The flat was really cute, very clean and comfortable and Maroussia was friendly and gave us great recommendations of things to do in Paris.Thank you so much, we will definitely be back!
A little smaller than expected and no windows so it gets a little musty but overall good for the price and in a decent location away from most of the crowded areas.
We had an amazing stay here. Great location in a peaceful neighborhood with lots of food nearby. Beautiful views from the private room. I recommend!

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in the 15th arrondissement of Paris. The apartment was incredibly calm, clean, and safe, providing a perfect retreat after a day of exploring the city. Its location is excellent, just a 5-minute walk to the Metro Line 10, making it easy to get around. The Eiffel Tower is a pleasant 20-minute walk away, ideal for evening strolls. We appreciated the convenience of having an Auchan supermarket right below the apartment, which made grocery shopping a breeze. Highly recommend this place for a comfortable and convenient stay in Paris!

We had a great 6 night stay, a great space, convenient location to restaurants, bakeries,  Basilique du Sacré-Cœur and train stations.  The shower had great water pressure, it was fabulous to have the grocery store downstairs, an elevator and multiple secure doors to access the building. We also greatly appreciated having access to a washing machine/drier.  We would stay here again! Merci!

Our stay at this Airbnb was fantastic! The apartment looked exactly like the photos – stylish and spotless.Didier was incredible. He welcomed us with a nice bottle of wine and was super friendly and responsive throughout our stay. It really felt like staying at a friend's place.The apartment had such a cozy vibe; it felt like a home away from home. Plus, the location was perfect – just a short walk to the metro, and there was a supermarket and bakery downstairs for everything we needed.Overall, we had an amazing time here. We would definitely recommend it and would love to stay again next time we're in Paris. Huge thanks to Didier for making our trip so enjoyable!
Overall, we had a great stay here. Very clean space and a great location. I would recommend!
Bruno’s place is wonderful and it is filled with amazing views! You will not be disappointed.
Lafkir was friendly and very responsive. The location was easy walking distance to Eiffel tower and many other great spots.
This was a great place to stay. So close to the train. We could get anywhere quickly. Lots of great food options nearby and obviously, the Eiffel Tower is just a block away.

The apartment matches the pictures. Venessa is a great host. I’m really grateful to her. As others have mentioned there is a strong and unpleasant drain smell in the apartment. But it has everything you need

Saying the location of this apartment is amazing would be an understatement. It is very walkable and plenty to do in the area. Lively restaurants steps from the apartment, and just a short walk away from the Seine River. The apartment is more spacious and pleasant than the pictures look. A full bath upstairs with the two bedrooms and a half bath downstairs in the common area. It is a 2 floor apartment that takes up the two top floors of the building. We loved our stay and would recommend highly if you're looking for walkability.
Very responsive and helpful hosts. Nice place was comfortable even for 4 adults. Very beautiful and modern
We had a great long weekend at the flat - it’s a great location to explore Paris and we enjoyed walking to lots of different food and drink spots. Thank you Aurélien!
Great place for our family of 5!  Close to Metro, very clean, responsive hosts! Would definitely recommend!

A gem in Paris. Benoit’s apartment is one of the best places I’ve been to. Quirky, cute, fun, superb location. It is on the 7th floor, in the attic (with a lift) with five windows looking at the Sacré-Cœur. The perfect Parisian cliché that’s actually works as a home. Absolutely brilliant.

This place was the epitome  of a  French apartment in neighborhood whose French charm knew no bounds. If you have wondered after watching a romantic French movie if places like that exist, this is prove they do. With it comes the expense. This is not the cheapest area yet which apartment 5 minutes away from a natural monument and tourist icon would be. In this case that being the Effiel Tower which towered over us displaying it majestic beauty daily as we ate dinner at one of many restaurants to choose from.The only issues we had was the WiFi did not work, and there was 1 roll of toilet paper for 2 bathrooms for a 3 day visit. Lastly,  our host agent did not meet us for check in, however they were very responsive when I called and got that rectified immediately. Overall, this apartment and neighborhood is lthe setting to live a romantic French dream.
Sofia’s place was great choice for my daughter and I. Close to Metro and just few stops away from the major attractions! Wonderful host and we had a great time in Paris!Thank you!

Sandra’s place was very comfortable and in an excellent location. It is on the upper floor and has incredible views throughout the apartment and it is located in a very walkable neighborhood that has great food and activities around. It is also just a quick walk to the metro. It is not self check in, so make sure to communicate with Sandra about when you will be arriving at the apartment so she can meet you. Overall, it is a great apartment to stay in while in Paris!

Me and my three young ones (10, 9, 5) stayed here on our first trip to Paris.  The location is unmatched.  Walkable to everything and after walking the city for five days I’m not sure I would have wanted to be located anywhere else. Catherine is a very responsive and helpful host and I would certainly stay with her again.

This is a beautiful apartment. Anne met us there when we arrived and even had some toys for my children to play with, which was unexpected and a big hit with my girls. The location is very walkable and despite being in the heart of everything we had no issues with noise from the neighborhood bothering us while we were sleeping. I would happily stay here again!
Great apartment just what we needed, excellent location - charming place perfect size and nice outdoor balcony. Will stay again!

Cozy apartment with a unique feel to it. Instead of the typical empty airBNB, you feel like you’re staying at a friend’s. The rooms are spacious, nicely decorated and well equipped with all the necessities. We definitely enjoyed our stay, merci!

Karine’s home is lovely. My family of four was comfortable and content, didnt want to leave and cant wait to return. We loved the smell of jasmine, the decor, the quiet, and the location. Thank you, Karine!

This is a beautiful apartment in Paris. We did have a couple of issues but they were addressed extremely quickly. The metro noise didn't bother us at all. The apartment was very clean and easily accessible. I would stay here again.
This is a beautiful apartment with great style in a wonderful location. We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend it.

Was a great stay, excellent location, great for families and loved the little extras like games, puzzle, books for both adults and kids. Linda was super responsive and gave clear instructions for check in!

We would definitely recommend staying here. The host was communicative and responsive. It’s a great apartment in a wonderful neighborhood, and close to transportation to get you elsewhere in Paris. We had two adults staying in the bedroom and two kids (ages 4 and 8) staying on the couches in the living room. Everyone was comfortable and happy. We feel really grateful to have booked this Airbnb. We had a wonderful time.

A gem in a fantastic neighborhood! We loved walking around Paris but especially enjoyed the neighborhood - it had everything we needed - grocery, cafes, bakeries, pharmacy, people watching… easy distance over the bridge to the major sights. Claire met us upon arrival, was very friendly & helped us carry bags up the stairs. There are steps to climb, but don’t let that be a deterrent. The building is full of charm & character! We especially enjoyed the AC on the very hot & humid days we were there.
This place is perfect. Comfortable bed, close to restaurants, train stations, and cafes. All that I needed. 100% recommended!

The penthouse is as described with great location and fantastic view. It was spacious for us  family of 3 and the co-host John is responsive and given a clear instructions. We surely will come back to stay here for our next Paris visit. Thank you for hosting us.
Perfect location and great to have a kitchen!  Host met us upon arrival and walked us through everything, helpful!
Had a lovely stay at Agnes's place. Nice area of Paris and located close to public transport for easy travel.

Camille was an amazing host and her apartment is perfect. I visited with my family (husband and 2 boys) for 4 days at the start of the Olympic Games. The apartment is in a great location, there are so many fabulous shops  and restaurants nearby. We had a few days ticking off all of the key Paris spots (so easy to get to) and then a day at the Stade de France. We loved every single second of it. Camille gave us great advice in advance of the stay and was super responsive during the trip. We couldn’t have asked for more. Highly recommend.
Georges apartment was clean and spacious and close to transport,restaurants and supermarkets.Georges was helpful and friendly and a very good communicator.Highly recommended !

Catherine’s apartment is in a fabulous location, and within easy walking distance of several metro stations. It feels very safe. There are good restaurants bakeries and bars close by. The apartment is beautifully organised and decorated and you have all you need but note this is not for anyone with mobility issues - think steep steps and low ceilings and a sit down shower. Catherine is a great host and when we had an unforeseen issue she sorted it immediately.

We really enjoyed our stay at Mathilde's Apartment. It is located in a lovely neighborhood, with nice boutiques, coffeeshops and restaurants at your doorstep. We didn't meet Mathilde personally, but she was always very responsive and made it possible to check in early and check out later. Thank you very much Mathilde!

Very charming and comfortable apartment - appreciated air con during sweltering weather. Excellent location, peaceful but just steps away from bustling cafes and bars. Great transport links made Olympic venues easy to reach. Thanks for fab Parisian stay.

We came to Paris for the Olympics and a few tourist attractions and spent a fantastic 11 days in France. This house was just perfect for our needs. Being 4 adults and 1 child it was great to have the many bedrooms and bathrooms across the different floors. The location was great for local shops, including a supermarket really close and the public transport links were close to hand. Axelle and her husband were fantastic at communication about the house and local area before we arrived and both check in and out went smoothly. Highly recommend!
with a minor hiccup on check in, her place was wonderful. Especially considering it was during the Olympics.Thank you Hannelore!

We stayed at Francois’ place during a partial time of the Olympics.  We thought it was pricey but perhaps it was due to the Olympics.   However he was very kind and responsive.   He allowed us to leave our luggage when we arrived too early as well as during check out.  The air conditioner is only on the floor of the bedrooms and you must leave both bedroom doors open for the AC to cool both rooms as much as possible.  The location is wonderful and very centrally located.  We enjoyed our stay!
Llana’s condo was perfect for our group of 5. Great restaurants and close to the Metro. Perfect for our trip to Paris and communication was excellent! Would recommend!!

We booked this apartment in Montmarte as we were visiting Paris for the Olympics! Firstly, Arthur, the host, was amazing. He was responsive and very easy to deal with! The apartment itself is located near a metro station and very close to the main strip of montmarte, amazing location!The apartment itself is beautiful! Very clean and modern amenities paired with a classic French interior! We had 3 people staying here with more than enough room. We fell in love with the space and would recommend it to anyone staying in Paris!

Betty provided us with a great place to live in the past 10 days. The whole place was stunning and clean, and the location was superb as well. The only problem was the refrigerator, it was not freezing properly (very minor issue!). Well highly recommended. Thanks Betty.

This was a gem in a wonderful and convenient location in Paris, 3 minute walk from the Odeon Metro stop, 2 minutes from a fabulous boulangerie/patisserie that we frequented daily,  and 4 minutes from a lovely local small grocery store. The space was perfect for our family of three and it was ideal that my 8 year old son had his own room which we could close off after he was in bed. We were delighted to not only have effective air conditioning in the heat of Paris in the summer, but also a dishwasher and washer/dryer which we utilized multiple times during our 2.5 week stay. Despite its location “in the heart of things,” the apartment was located on a quieter side street. It was well stocked with adequate paper products, dishwasher soap, and laundry detergent for our stay; we bought only some trash bags in the way of necessities.  I cannot recommend this apartment highly enough!
Thanks Aurelien very thoughtful, we had great stay. Is close the south Arena, very convenient for us walking around. Safe place and near by have restaurants and cafe.:)

Our stay was absolutely amazing. The space was lovely and very walkable to metro and restaurants. Felt very safe walking around the area even late at night. Host was very responsive, kind, and helped make us feel right at home. Also the two cats at the apartment are so sweet. Would recommend to all.

Great place we had 8 adults and 1 kid, it was clean and pleasant. The stove is a bit tricky. It’s close to metro, shops, bakery and many restaurants. Plus just a walk away from the Eiffel Tower. Easy to get to other tourist attractions. Would definitely recommend and stay again.

Absolutely perfect - i wish i could stay longer! It’s the perfect mix of Parisian charm and character. The windows… the plants.. the beautiful touches. I am in awe! Everything you would ever need in the kitchen, too. And the bed was SO comfy - i could sleep forever. I am very picky so for me to give a 5 star review means a lot 🥹

Great place in le marais! Wonderful little bar downstairs and extremely walkable to all the neighborhood has to offer. Metro stop nearby. All amenities for baby - high chair and pack and play! Elevator is very small but super helpful to get luggage up and down the 3 flights of stairs. The terrace was a nice place to hang. Beds very comfortable and AC was super nice to have after  long days exploring Paris in August. Would stay again!

We stayed in Sophie's wonderful apartment, a beautiful and real Parisian apartment, will put you right into the magical atmosphere of Paris!!Sophie is a great host, a smart and kind-hearted woman who helped us and responded to every request. She has a lovely and quiet dog that is an integral part of the experience of staying in the apartment!The apartment is located in a quiet and pleasant street about 5 minutes walk from the metro and about 25-30 minutes by public transport almost anywhereThanks you sophie❤️

Great location with a lovely courtyard and walking distance to Marché Monge. The apartment was clean, but there was no dining space for four people and had minimal cooking utensils. Otherwise, enjoyed our stay very much!
We have a really good time here! Very close to Eiffel Tower. Facilities in house are good . Toilet and bathroom are separated which is nice and clean.

Pros:Host allowed us to use the place three hours earlier than check in time Location is actually 10 mins walking distance from Eiffel. Cons:Oddly builtMain bathroom door doesn’t close or lock so there is zero privacy. The rooms trap the heat in. No aircon. Awful for summer time. Must use fans provided except the fans are very dust and you don’t want to turn them on because of what you will inhale. Have to keep all doors open to get air circulation. Towels were old and super smallOne very tiny soap bar provided. The place was so dirty we didn’t feel very good sleeping in it.

In the center of 5eme Paris, where you can enjoy local life rather than stuck with a full of tourist. There're full of nice restaurants nearby as well as several metro stations. Very neat and clean apartment.

Beautiful spacious apartment in great location. Clean, friendly host, great tips for what to see. Walking distance to arc de triomphe.  The only thing to be aware of is that there is a lift but it doesn’t serve the flat itself - there are about 15 steps up to the apartment for those with mobility issues.
Our second time staying here, and was great to be back. Perfect location. The space is small but has everything you need. Excellent a/c and balcony are huge pluses.

We had a wonderful stay here. The location was perfect - tucked away in a quiet street, but right around the corner from one of the districts in Paris. The bedrooms were very nice and having 3 bathrooms was a nice bonus as well. The cleaners came every day to tidy up. The door code and wifi worked perfectly. Very cool design living room and a big beautiful terrace to hang out on. Would strongly recommend this bnb to everyone! Merci beaucoup!
Our stay exceeded our expectations. This area of Paris is safe, clean, and had everything we wanted. Rita & James are ideal hosts. We hope to return soon!
Incredible stay with Gilbert! The place is as close to the park as you could imagine and Gilbert took very good care of everything 🙌

Marina was very helpful especially as she waited for us when we arrived as our flight got delayed. The place was exactly as advertised, clean and in a very good and safe area (close to the Metro station, supermarket and Parc des Princes). Definitely recommend 👍

We had a wonderful time in Anne and Jean-Luc’s beautiful apartment. It was comfortable and spacious for 3. Anne made us feel at home and gave us lots of pertinent information and advice on the neighborhood. Make sure you have the croissants around the corner!
Mold in the apartment not worth it. We had to leave and find another place.Great service from Airbnb

Enjoyed our stay. We weren’t aware this apartment was on the 3rd floor but there was a lift to use so not a problem. Had everything we needed, would only suggest adding a box of tissue & hand soap for the bathroom sink. Very secure entry, which we appreciated.
A lovely place to stay in Paris. Monique is warm, welcoming and has a beautiful apartment in a wonderful area of the city.

The apartment is in a great location and is beautifully decorated. It is also very spacious for a Paris apartment. It was perfect for two couples. Everything was spotlessly clean and the beds were very comfortable with high quality linens. Amanda was very responsive and checked in several times to make sure everything was going well. She also proactively made sure the WiFi was working for us. The in-apartment washer and dryer were very nice to have and she supplied the basic kitchen and laundry amenities. She also recommended a nearby restaurant, Joya, and it was so good we went twice. Overall it is a great place to stay and I highly recommend it. I have stayed in quite a few Airbnb's and this was one of the best.
Everything here was fantastic! The apartment, the location and most of all Ines. She was very helpful and responsive!

Really fantastic place! The apartment is beautifully appointed and in a great location, so close to the train station but it’s also peaceful inside. Great restaurants nearby and Denka provided a lot of welcome suggestions. Check in was easy. Beds are really comfortable. Can’t recommend enough!
Very responsive and helpful host, easy to get in and everything in the apartment was as described and worked well.

A very comfortable apartment with wonderful views. Excellent location with stores, malls, restaurants, supermarket and pharmacy within a short walking distance. Train station and bus stop to the city and to the Eiffel Tower are only a few minutes walk away.

Apartment was nice and cozy! I really enjoyed coming back to it each night after a day out in the city. It just felt like the perfect little Parisian studio!The area is amazing and close to so many restaurants and bars! Milan was great and very accommodating to my late arrival time and early departure times. Will absolutely be looking to stay here again on my next Paris visit.
The place is really well located, quiet, and great to stay at with a couple. The bathroom is a bit small, but that's usual in Paris. I would highly recommend Elise's place!
Beautifully positioned between two Metro stations, covering lines 2&4. Great food, drinks and bakeries very close by. Would happily recommend this apartment.

A nice apartment in a very quiet small street, but just a few steps from a lively neighborhood.There is everything you need for a comfortable stay.The self check-in gave us the opportunity to arrive at a later hour with no necessity of an arrangement.
Had a great stay. Place was perfect for me my husband and toddler. First floor made it easy with our luggage and stroller. It was very walkable with lots around! Definitely recommend.

Great place if you want to stay near the Effie Tower! And great area! The only thing was the stairs, that got to me at times. Overall great stay and my first trip to Paris was lovely staying with her. Would definitely stay with her again!!!

Morgan’s place is well located, she was very helpful with questions. I think maybe a Manual on how things work in the apartment will be a little more efficient. The sheets are quite old and have some stains. The bathroom is clean and the apartment too. Is a nice place to stay in general for two persons, just renovate the bed sheets, but everything else is lovely. Thanks Morgan!
The place was really nice! Great location, walkable to important sites like the Louvre. We would definitely come back.
Cozy and nice apartment. Might be too small for more than 2 people. Great location and a very responsive host

Loved the Lander! Very spacious for Paris and loved the comfortable bed and decorating. We (perhaps our issue) had trouble figuring out the self check in but someone helped us quickly. Thank you for a wonderful stay in your beautiful city!

We had a wonderful stay. The location was perfectly central but whisper quiet. Jean Luc was responsive and helpful with every question. The beds super comfortable and the shower hot ! Definitely would stay again.

I recently stayed at this apartment, and I had a wonderful experience. The comfort level was excellent, with all the amenities I needed for a relaxing stay. The location was perfect, conveniently situated near major attractions and public transportation, making it easy to explore Paris. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and provided a cozy atmosphere. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and conveniently located place to stay in the city. Thank you for a great stay!
Ludovic’s apartment is very very nice. Very near to a major Metro station so going around is convenient. We highly recommend his apartment. The host is also very kind.

We moved our stay!  This apartment is remarkably beautiful, and it feels like a comfortable, well appointed home (which it is) rather than a sterile AirBNB. This apartment sits above a bustling street (that quiets at night) with bakeries and restaurants. It’s a short walk to the metro. The area really couldn’t have been better.
Wonderful host and location. I couldn’t ask for anything more as it being my first time in Paris.

Helene was a very helpful host! She responded within a day and kindly provided my wife and I with helpful suggestions on places to dine like a local. She has a cozy apartment and you will love the neighborhood!

This was by far my favorite place in Paris I’ve stayed! The location is amazing and is right in the heart of Marais. There are local shops and restaurants right outside the door. The place looked as good as the pictures and was extremely spacious and modern. We loved sitting on the patio every night and taking it in. I would highly recommend it to anyone considering staying!
Nice place. The location is perfect. Just cross the street you find the train. Easy to do whatever you want. The place is big with all the services and amenities.
Wonderful view of the Eiffel tower and a beautiful apartment no complaints at all! Would 1000% recommend to anyone

Excellent place for two guests needing separate beds. Irune provides so many extrasL   milk, oil, coffee, honey, etc. Very bountiful. Beds are comfortable. (a little more hot-water for showers would be nice if possible.  Excellent location.  Good value for price.The walk-up to the 5th floor is significant. We struggled with the check-in. Hopefully Irune will provide an extra set of keys so lock box is not longer crucial.Overall, highly recommend.
Had a lovely few days at Manon’s, was able to see all the sights of Paris using the nearby metro.Nice quiet part of Paris.
we liked the area,  our hosts were  great. we think of staying in their house again in the future.
Location is amazing. The host was very easy to communicate with. The instructions were clear. However, the accommodation was smaller than expected

What a wonderful time we had. The apartment was so stylish and even larger than the photos depict. Communication with Soline was very easy and they were so kind and responsive to all of our questions and needs. The neighborhood was easily accessible to all of Paris. Excellent experience all around. Can’t wait to come back!

If I could give Pascal and his Airbnb 100 stars, I would in a heartbeat. My husband and I were blown away by the views and style of the apartment. We have traveled a lot, and Pascal’s place blew our minds. We felt right at home in our little oasis above the city. We spent hours on the balcony talking and taking everything in. It is absolutely magical watching the sun set and Eiffel Tower sparkle at night. There are so many amazing food places around. The kabob sandwiches from Basic and the burgers from Avec Amour- le burger were some of our favorites! The train station is very accessible! The app Pascal recommended (Bonjour RAPT) was incredible. We could not have imagined a better stay. Whenever we are back in Paris, we hope to stay at Pascals.

Clean, sleek, minimalist space in an excellent location. The added convenience of a washer/dryer was very helpful. The apartment is small but very strategically laid out so you have access to everything you need. I would say this space is best for a single traveler or a couple/close friends who don't mind the lack of privacy (ex the shower area is exposed).  Great communication with host we appreciated the flexibility in checking in.
We enjoyed the location and the room in general. It was just a bit dirty and the shower was clogged.

What a lovely appartment. Accessible via very quiet court yard in a lovely neighborhood. The appartment has curved ceilings and low beams so as a long Dutchman like myself you have to remember to bend down. But that's a small price to pay for a perfect, authentic family home.
Great location, very clean, exactly as described. The restaurant downstairs can be noisy so bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper. Will definitely stay again next time.

Perfect place to stay in Paris! It’s in walking distance to many great restaurants and a variety of great spots in the city. The apartment was perfectly clean and our communication with Marine very easy! We are definitely coming back!
Francis is a very kind and helpful host, peaceful and safe neighborhood with metro stations within 5 minutes walking distance.
It was a great stay at the place of Agnes. I felt safe in the residency and liked the location of the flat. Communication with Agnes was easy :-) I would recommend! Thank you, Agnes!

We had to leave after the first night. Significant Mold in both bathrooms, dusty and not clean/stained elsewhere.No working space as advertised. No closet where to hand your shirts, small and doubles as cleaning tools storage area.Should not be listed on Airbnb

Delphine’s house was lovely!! Very clean and homey with great decoration, the place was spacious and the kitchen perfect for cooking meals if you’re looking to save money during your stay. Delphine as a host was responsive, kind and passionate about her space, would love to visit Paris again and If so would definitely choose Delphine’s airbnb!!!
Had a great experience. Sébastien was always alert and responded when required even though there was not much to ask him for since he hands out a link with intructions and places he recommends.
Great location, secure, near to Eiffel Tower, Nicolas was always resonding all doubts, I would definitely come back again.
We really enjoyed our stay here. The neighborhood is fabulous and very safe, near tons of great restaurants and close to transit. I would definitely stay here again next time I’m in Paris!
Miguel was a fantastic host. The apartment was comfortable, cosy and spotlessly clean. There was a little noise from other apartments and the street but I would 100% stay there again.

Jean-Christophe's place is perfect for a stay in Paris. It's very comfortable and clean and located in a very nice neighborhood as well. Jean-Christophe is also incredibly gracious and friendly and has lots of great recommendations for exploring Paris!

This place was great. It is very clean. The metro is right next to the place. It is a safe area. There are many restaurants nearby. The louvre is walking distance. Les Halle’s is nearby.  There is a supermarket below the building.  Also Catherine is a great host. The place was spotless and well decorated. Catherine explained everything well and gave us a nice tour of the place. The apt is also safe and there are elevators which is a huge plus. I was highly recommend this apt.
Beatrice was a wonderful, friendly host who communicated with us constantly and made us feel at home. Excellent location and easy access, highly recommend!

A great place amongst it, nice open plan studio with easy ground floor access. The studio is bright and airy with natural light from the courtyard. It feels like old Paris, and you wouldn’t know the city is right there. An urban retreat!
The apartment was very cozy and the place was a great area. The beds were big and super comfortable. We enjoyed our stay.

Maria is a great host, they met me at the house, introduced the house in detail. Apartment was so clean, everything is thought. She is lovely and very helpfull. I rented the apartment again for january. There was nothing unexpected and you can reach them any time you need. Location is great. Heating is great. I gelt like I am living in my own place.
Had a comfortable and nice stay there. Location is amazing with so many things to do, walkable distance to the attractions and many metro stations around.

This apartment was absolutely perfect for our family of 5. It was clean, spacious, and had every necessary amenity. The neighborhood was wonderful! So much to see and do. We had on-foot access to museums, historical sites, shopping, dining, and the Metro within minutes. The elevator was a nice feature, too. We would happily stay here again!
The apartment was in a great location with an amazing view of the Eiffel Tower!! Abel was a great host and was super responsive. Thank you for hosting us!
Nice airbnb for a short stay in Paris - great location and easy check-in and communication with the hosts!

We loved our stay as it was close to so many restaurants, cafes, bakery, cheese shop, wine shop, you name it! Not far from public transportation, but it was a bit difficult to acquire an Uber. You have to walk out 10 min or so to the bigger streets. Felt at home and the area was lively and safe!

Amazing location with great restaurants on your doorstep and easy to access the great attractions of Paris. Very good communication from the host. Please travel with someone with whom you are very comfortable - there are large windows from the bedroom/lounge into the bathroom!

Our hosts were very helpful and quick to respond with recommendations. The apartment was so charming and unique. We loved the area full of great restaurants and shopping. We definitely would recommend to anyone considering a stay here!
A great apartment. Easy enough to access all tourists spots from the metro that was about a 5 minute walk. Lovely decorated and clean. Thank you
Everything was perfect and described in details . Couldn’t have wish for a better host and place to stay in Paris!
Great place! It’s the second time that I’m staying at Julia’s place. It’s always a pleasure. She’s reactive, flexible and communicate very well. Her place is warm and makes me feel like home.

This apartment was in a fantastic location close to the Louvre and metro stope so you can easily get anywhere in Paris. There were fantastic restaurants nearby. The apartment itself was spacious and clean. The bed was comfortable and the shower had great pressure and hot water. The apartment had all the comforts of home and was a nice place to relax after walking all day. It is up some flights of stairs but the apartment is very quiet and private. I would definitely stay here again when visiting Paris. Thanks for a great stay!
Very kind owner, always responsive and accommodation was ready on time and perfectly clean. Very good location and high quality .

Great apt in an excellent location.  Rahim was an amazing host.  He even help me talking to airbnb after i reserved by mistake another dates and even helped me avoid the extras fees.   All well as described
Stay was very comfortable. Helene is a good host  and would love to stay again when I visit Paris
Great place to be, superb host who is always helpful. The place could have been cleaner, but other than that quite perfect and location is best possible in the budget.

The perfect airbnb for a family of 4. We stayed at Haiyan’s place over Christmas/New Year’s and we loved it. Walking distance to Arc du Triomphe and buses/metro, plenty of options to eat and close to the famous Lenôtre Patisserie. The apartment itself is spacious and beds comfortable. Kitchen has gas stove perfect for cooking which is essential when travelling with young kids. There is no baby cot however but we managed fine with the two comfortable beds. Highly recommend!
Lou was very nice, he was willing to answer any of our questions. The apartment was located in very good destination with a lot of grocery stores, restaurants etc. We recommend :)
We loved the apartment-it was a fun place in Paris! We had a great time & it was easy to walk or take Uber around-thank you
Nice and quiet neighborhood close to subway stations and some nice bakeries and restaurants. The apartment was cozy and had everything necessary for our stay.

The apartment is lovely. We stayed in winter and didn’t get to enjoy the terrace but would definitely recommend anytime of year. It’s warm and cozy and clean and quiet. Building is pretty. Location is fantastic. Very close to metro station so easy to get everywhere. Would highly recommend.

This was the PERFECT spot for our 2 night stay in Paris! We loved the easy walking to restaurants, shopping and museums. The apartment is cozy, clean and well equipped. It doesn’t have a kitchen but all we needed were  the microwave and refrigerator for drinks and snacks. The bed and pillows were very comfortable. Oh was cheerful, quick to respond and super flexible with our requests. We look forward to staying here again!
We enjoyed our stay. The location is terrific. The apartment is close to the Louvre and the Petit Palais. Lots of fashionable shops nearby.

Very nice and cozy private room close to all transport facilities. Delphine is a very welcoming and responsive, all the instructions were very clear and helpful. We had a comfortable conversation during my stay. Thanks again, Delphine! 🙂

The perfect stay in Paris!  Tucked away on a quiet street but within a short walk-of everything you want to see & do in Paris.  Very close to the Notre Dame and the Louvre.  Many shops and restaurants within in walking distance.   I would definitely stay here again.
Communication was really nice and location is great. Bathroom doors were hard to open as there was no handle. But we enjoyed it nonetheless :)

Very nice apartment, as described. Short walking distance to more than 2 metro stations. Near restaurants, grocery stores and cafes. Apartment confortable for a family of 3 or 4 people. Maybe a little bit noise when the apartment upstairs is busy. Recommend apartment to stay in Paris.

Honestly a great find. Perfect location, very private and in a great area. Host was so quick to respond and was really helpful, flexible and accommodating when it came to check in/out. Also the bath is huge! Will definitely stay here again.

The apartment was so lovely and bright! There were great windows that let in a lot of light. We loved the colorful decor and beautiful touches throughout.Loved the location and we had everything we needed for our quick trip!
The place had everything I needed for a long weekend. Perfect location!  Great value! Thank you Alex!
Clémence was so responsive and swiftly assisted me with my requests. The flat had everything one needed to enjoy a stay in Paris. Felt right at home!

Perfect apartment for a business trip. The bed was super comfortable and the bathroom was spot on! The hosts were really friendly and recommended some good places to eat/drink. Having a hair dryer and shampoo/body wash was a nice touch as meant I could pack light - thankyou guys, I will be back next year!

This apartment is absolutely beautiful! A great space and location, especially if you want to enjoy Paris without being in the tourist-y area. Anne-Charlotte is a great host- super responsive and helpful explaining anything you have questions about. The apartment is set back in a courtyard, so it’s extremely peaceful and quiet. I’d definitely recommend!
Great time in Paris! Would definitely book the same location! Only problem I had was the closets smelled a little old but besides that everything was great
Amazing flat! We really felt home there. It’s small but has everything it needs. Loved the neighbourhood, super close to nice places, restaurants and bars :) would come again!

Lovely stay at Arthur's place. Very fast responses. Excellent location (5 minutes walk from Metro station and walkable distance to Montmartre) with very good facilities nearby (lovely bakeries and local supermarkets). The home itself is very well equipped and has all the requirements for a pleasant stay. Everything worked perfectly. Highly recommended host and place to stay.

I loved staying here & would totally stay here again! This was a great and easy spot which made my time in Paris so easy and convenient. As an American, I always forget to check for an elevator and boy was I glad to see i didn’t have to lug my 50 lb bag up the stairs. If you’re looking for a quiet and roomy spot, definitely recommend this one!

This is a great location and well connected for exploring the city.  We used the Vilib bikes and the Metro mostly and once figured out was a great way to get around.The apartment is cosy and you have to be organised in the space. All the essentials are here and Laurent was extremely helpful.Would have no issue with staying again, thank you.
The stairs are a little dangerous and the old building… was very easy to find and enter. The room is nice and has everything you need
Julien is a very attentive host. He gave very detailed check-in instructions as well as a warm welcome. The flat was a very cosy and stylish one which I loved!
Francis was very friendly and always quick to answer. Whenever I’m back in Paris, I would definitely check his AirBnB again!

Great stay !  Thank you for having us.  Spotless place.  Would stay there again.  There was a tiny smell from sewage but that’s not Jethros fault, something through the pipes.  Really responsive and helpful.  Note: this might not be the best for seniors.  4 flights of stairs Note: security requires 3 codes to entry

We visited Paris for a holiday with our family, and our stay was absolutely perfect! Julian was extremely responsive and regularly checked in to make sure everything was going well. The location was ideal, with major landmarks nearby, making it a perfect place to stay. Highly recommended!
Very clean and nice apartment. The host was so helpful and responds quick. We were very comfortable during our stay. Would highly recommend.

This is a real gem fantastic area restaurant's all around  and the apartment is of very high quality it's  in very good condition with lots of extras thanks for a excellent sleep in a great area I have ased lots of Airs and this is a good one
nice place, looks like in the pictures, good view of the street, only the shower is a little problem in this apartment

Anne’s place was small, cozy, and stocked with everything our group of 5 needed. Check in was easy, the neighborhood was lovely, bustling, with the metro right outside, yet our apartment was very quiet.

I had a great stay at this apartment. The room was spacious, clean, and the bed was very comfortable. The location is excellent — just a short walk to the subway, which made it easy to get to the city centre quickly. There’s also a supermarket nearby, which was super convenient. Would definitely recommend!
Very good location with plenty of restaurant and cafe options around. Super close to Eiffel Tower, and very close to a metro and a bus stop which made it easy to get around. Great deal for the price

had the most amazing stay !! perfect and quick communication from anne, was able to check out early and drop bags off early as well which made life so easy !! the most beautiful place, felt so safe and comfortable, would stay 100x over 🤍🤍

I highly recommend staying at this  place for anyone looking for an excellent and comfortable stay in paris. It exceeded my expectations, and I'm already looking forward to staying here again in the future. Thank you, Majesti  and David for every thing  also for the quick response you make our staying very easy .Aslo we found everything which just we think near to us public transportation bakery supermarket and grand stores. Thank you guys again for the hospitality.Moemen

The host has been very helpful, responsive, understandable, supportive and respectful of all our requests and inquiries. The apartment is more than adequate for my family of nine. The area has a lot of nice restaurants to pick from.  We couldn’t ask for a better weather. Our experience is vet memorable and plan to rerun in the future. I highly recommend this place. Thank you so much for everything!!!!

We loved our stay at this cute apartment! The location is excellent-in the heart of the Marais yet a close walk to Notre Dame, with easy metro access (St Paul) and bus routes which are fun for sightseeing. The apartment is delightful-a typical Parisian pied a terre   Daphne is a thoughtful host and lovely person. Communication was excellent. We felt very at home and would definitely stay again on a return trip to Paris. Merci Daphne!

We had a lovely stay at Harry’s place. The apartment was well appointed with all the things you can need in the kitchen. Traveling from the US it took us some time to get adjusted to time zone so I appreciated the black out curtains in the bedroom. Great location overall  in La Marais close to shops, restaurants and several metro lines. We enjoyed our time as everything was walkable from the apartment. I would definitely stay here again.
Excellent Host!! It was so nice to see meet such an incredible host. Olivier was extremely attentive and helpful. 100% will stay with him the next time in Paris :)

This is an incredibly unique apartment in a perfect location. Guillaume is a wonderful host - attentive and responsive. We definitely want to come back! There's not much privacy for the bathroom, so be aware if traveling with friends.

The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos, felt very cosy and was a great base after a day out. There is a metro nearby and it's a nice area to take a stroll by the canal. The host was friendly and even left us a sweet little gift. All the instructions were clear so getting in was easy, we also really appreciated the suggestions for nearby restaurants! The only issues were less responsiveness at first and water slightly leaking on the floor during showering, but this could be managed with a towel and paled in comparison to all the good things :)
Incredible stay with Quentin: Location, convenience, clean and safe apartment, everything was 10/10. We will be back!!
Beautiful and Cosy space and an excellent base from which to explore the city. I would recommend highly :)

after the first night I send Lionel a message that I believe he needs to stay himself a night and see if he likes the bed and the shower that was broke.  the sofa sleeper is terrible to lay on. it broke my back. it's super hard and the iron structure popped through the mattress I weight 85kg. the shower head was dangling on the side and the temperature switched for out of nowhere to extremely hot. it's very small and too cosy,  I was cheaper out with a hotelroom and a bed then in this airbnb. Lionel responded that the sleep sofa was very expensive and the shower was fixed. so he found my complaint not correct. I added pictures and I don't think the reviews are correct either.

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as described and looked just like the pictures. The hosts were incredibly accommodating, allowing us to check in at a time that suited us, which we greatly appreciated. The location was perfect, and the amenities provided made our stay comfortable and enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Ygal’s space was great for our 4 day stay with my family. The view was spectacular, the garden overview and the Eiffel Tower as well. The space invited lots of sunlight with large windows, furniture matched the whole vibe of the place so well, and the elevator was a huge plus. The beds were comfortable, showers were clean and spacious, and the living room was very spacious and home-y. It’s very close to lots of main attractions, great to take walks as the neighborhood is safe, and restaurants and Boulanger everywhere as well. I would definitely recommend this place to others.
Nice location easy to find a lot to do in the neighborhood. Calm and pleasant stay Feel like home Beautiful decoration

Chachou's place is located idlely.  Very easy to reached and almost walkable to the signature attractions in Paris. Added point is eiffel tower is just a short walk about 15minutes. The amenities and furniture is as described.  Moreover, Patrick is a very responsive and helpful host. He even help us to booked the taxi to airport, quick reply when we have encounter any problems.
Great apartment, convenient location. The host is always in touch and helps. Easy check-in and check-out. Thank you for our great week in Paris !
Thank you, Didier for a lovely stay at your appartement! We enjoyed your place a lot with our two kids and can recommend it to everybody intending to spend some time in Paris.

This is the second time we have stayed at Ax’s home. We love it. It was me and my wife, our two young kids, and my parents. There was enough room for everyone to be comfortable. Our boys love playing with Ax’s kids’ toys. The neighborhood is lovely, extremely walkable, very close to the train, and quiet at night. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Perfect weeklong stay in Marion’s apartment with my nieces. Loved the location and the local vibes of the area. Adored the aesthetic of the apartment and it made me wake up everyday happy. Thank you Marion for opening your home to us. Both my nieces and I had a fabulous time in Paris.

We stayed at Patrick and Nathalie's apartment this spring. It was the perfect home base for our first trip to Paris and is an incredible find. Not only is Patrick extremely responsive, but his recommendations and suggestions made our stay that much more memorable. The apartment is comfortable and perfectly situated to restaurants, public transit and a delightful Parisian neighborhood. 5 stars for both the apartment and owners. Merci for a wonderful stay in Paris!

We had a great time in Giovanni’s lovely studio. Super close to the city centre, but in a nice and calm area. Giovanni was super nice and communicated clearly. Already looking forward to come back some day!

In many ways, this apartment in the middle of Saint-Germain Street was wonderful. It was quiet, even though it was on a street, and it was comfortable like home. Pierre and all his family were welcoming and helped me while I stayed. If I visit Paris again, I’d love to stay this apartment.
I booked this apartment for the second time. Everything is great as before.👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
Victorine's place has been perfect for our stay. Such a lovely home on a gorgeous little street in a great neighbourhood. Thank you so much for making it available to us!

Michael is a very hospitable host, he's always responsive to any inquiry.The flat is in a very nice location, nearby many public transportations.The surrounding area has all the necessities (Supermarket, pharmacy, boulangerie...)The flat is cozy and clean.
Jana's place was really nice, with a great location. It looked just like the pictures, would recommend for a short stay in Paris!

It’s a pleasant experience, Kathleen shows warmly host, makes me feel like home. I leave early in the morning and back at night, the room is clean and quiet, which is very nice for me. kitty Nero comes to see me everyday when I come back, she is so cute. Highly recommend ❤️

nice apartment, great location. close to the metro and a supermarket.bathroom -  the toilet is a bit too close to the sink , and the shower head is hung too low,  but there is always hot water.host was very responsive at first, but  when we had an issue that required action, it was poorly handled.
