This place is a lovely, modern, well-stocked apartment.  It’s centrally located in the 1st arrondissement.  It’s a 15-20 min walk to Notre Dame.  Highly recommend to others!
Loved our stay in this little studio. Was quiet but still right in the heart of Paris. We had a great time

The apartment has a great location, you can easily get to absolutely all the sights. The apartment is cozy in the French style, there is everything you need even for a long stay, including a washing machine, iron and hair dryer. Thanks for the prompt support 24/7 and clear instructions.

Haiyan communicated beautifully with us, requesting that we notify her an hour before our anticipated arrival so that we could receive the key to the apartment. The location was superb…with the Arch de Triumphe only a 5-minute walk from the apartment. We tried a different Boulangerie every morning-all close by. In addition to the great location, I should mention that a grocery store and laundromat were just 2-minute walk away.  And even though the apartment is in the very heart of Paris, the nights were very quiet. I highly recommend a stay here!

Location for us as a family with a toddler and pregnant mama was 10/10. We had everything we needed from a beautiful park to great food options, grocery store, shopping, pharmacy, metro and more! The space was great, a little dusty but that could be the area and being on the top floor? We brought up a few things and the host did his best to take care of it. We needed a crib as well and that was provided for, we were really grateful!

I had a great 3-day stay in this charming little studio! The place is beautifully decorated, very clean, and had everything I needed. It’s well located, near to the metro station . The host was friendly and helpful.

My friend and I really enjoyed our stay. The flat is a great find, thoughtfully furnished and the area itself is fantastic, close enough to many interesting parts of Paris but still quiet at night for a restful night’s sleep. We liked all the streets close by for the simple joy of browsing and soaking up the atmosphere of being in Paris and then got Ubers to particular places of interest as we were short of time and wanted to squeeze in as much as possible. It’s an excellent location for this sort of trip as it’s so central. The place is very well equipped and we would return without hesitation and may well do just that at some point! Thank you Theo and Camille for a lovely stay.

Had a wonderful stay at Ariana’s comfy apartment. It felt very homey and welcoming. Very close to multiple metro lines for getting around the city. Loved being so close to Sacre-Coeur.  Everything we wanted Paris to be for our first time.

The lack of a TV was completely unexpected for me. But I could perfectly live without it.  For somebody it could be a reason to refuse this property.  One advise from  me, you have a bluetooth speaker at your kitchen, which I wasn't able to connect to my phone and it has only few French speaking radio stations preset. Replace it with Amazon Alexa, without TV people are going to have more choices in music and news.

This was our third stay in three years. The apartment is quiet and private with an airy feel and a well-equipped kitchen for our basic needs. Laurel, the Caretaker, was especially helpful and friendly. The location is in a lovely neighborhood with an easy walk to two Metro stops.

I stayed two nights with Delphine. Her home was very nice and once inside the courtyard doors it was extremely peaceful. Sadly I didn't see much of Delphine as she had just returned from holiday and had  work commitments. But everything was well explained on arrival. A great stay. Thank you Delphine.
very spacious. nice internet.  very central on a main street but not too loud so not an issue if you think so. merci!

Can’t fault this apartment. Fantastic location, apartment itself was very lovely and beautifully designed, and exceptionally clean. Vincent is a super host, great communication, and very fast responses to questions. No hesitation in recommending this place!
Thank you Pauline for a stay in your place in Paris: impeccably clean and conveniently located for Gare du Nord/L’Est

Great apartment, well equipped and clean. Very quiet and close to both bus and metro. Just 10 min. walk up to Sacre Ceur and Montmartre. The host responded quickly to our questions and the apartment had a great list of helpful information.We were a party of six and the apartment had plenty of space for us.
Perfect apartment if you have to travel for work as there is a office space and this is quite spacious. Location super convenient close to food stores with la Grande Epicerie right across the street.
Great location and a wonderful apartment! Anne has been very helpful throughout. Will definitely book again when back in Paris!
Cozy apartment with many cafes and restaurants nearby. Very convenient - the metro which is 5mins walk and takes you everywhere. Highly recommended
Great place if you wanna stay at the Champs Elysees area. Building itself is very posh. Would definitely stay here again

Perfect for our family of 6. The location was great. We walked out to a great restaurant on the corner called Chez Emelie and a view of the Eiffel Tower. The flat had everything we needed to have a great stay.

The loft is very conveniently located, the interior of the loft is as described, I can tell the owner has invested a lot of time and effort to keep the place tidy and homey. The check in was smooth and easy. I would totally recommend everyone to book this place!
Good accommodation near the Eiffel Tower and steps away from subway station which was very convenient for us as we explored the city.

Our family of four truly enjoyed our stay in Ethel’s apartment. It was just the right size to be comfortable for all of us. We loved the surrounding neighborhood and felt like we were getting an authentic slice of Parisian life any time we were in and around the apartment. The bathroom was large and kitchen was well appointed - you could tell that this was a space meant to be lived in, not just visited. The apartment listing exactly matched what we found when we got there with one exception: we found the view of the Eiffel Tower to be much more impressive in person than the photos make it appear. You can only see the tower from one window in the flat, but my wife and I watched it sparkle every evening while we were in Paris. We hope to have the opportunity to stay here again someday in the not-too-distant future.

The place is well located, right in front of a metro station which makes easy to move around. Stephane was very helpful and respectful. The apartment is very quietly and has a lot to do on the around.
Great location and amazing views from the apartment. Catherine and Zoe were very accommodating at check in and throughout the visit.

This place is well located. It doesn’t have AC or fans . Also I didn’t like that the window in one of the rooms faced the trash bin so we were hot and didn’t want to open it because flies will get in the apartment. We were a family of 7 and is 2 bedroom and 2 sofa beds in the living room where the kids slept. Other wise we had a good stay here.
I loved having a spotless quiet place all to myself, away from the noise and crowds outside.  It is a small space but thoughtfully arranged.  Location is very convenient.
Awesome location! Quiet but very close to major attractions. Clean and tidy appartement. A bit small with our family of 5 but the location made up for it.
Stay Was good.....location is great....Just down the apartment has many good resturant. All train stations are in walking distance.  Overall a good exprecince.

Our stay was lovely. The apartment was better than the pictures, very stylish and tastefully decorated. Located in a quiet part of town and well connected to the rest of the city. Etienne was responsive and accomodating offering us an early check in.  Definitely among my favorite AirBNBs I have stayed at & would stay again.
It was the best, really!Manar was very friendly, the House was clean with everything you need. It was a pleasure! 😁

We had a great time at Jean Christophe’s apartment! It’s the perfect space and location for us, spacious, easy connection with metro! Would definitely come back again and recommend to anyone who’s coming to Paris.

The apartment is in a great, quiet location, but we were very disappointed to find a huge amount of ants all over the floor, especially in the bedrooms and bathroom. The host sent someone to clean, but they entered the apartment without our permission while we were not there, which is completely unacceptable. When we returned, there were still ants in the apartment. Overall, this was not a pleasant experience, and it really affected our stay.

Great location. Easy to checkin. Would’ve been nice if they provided pods for the excellent coffee machine, and daily fresh towels. Interior courtyard window didn’t provide any fresh air. Overall 8/10.
This was an absolutely perfect location in Paris! The apartment was cozy & clean, and the courtyard was beautiful. I would definitely stay here again!

Julien's place was perfect for our family of three. The space was exactly what we expected and we appreciated how safe it felt with the multiple locked entries. The area is beautiful and so close to the Louvre and gardens where we spent a lot of time. Julien was great to work with. He had someone waiting to greet us and allowed us a slightly later checkout which was very helpful.

The view of Eiffel tower is phenomenal! You can walk to alot of places especially near the tower, lots of restaurants etc. My family thoroughly enjoyed our stay! The elevator is a little tricky but when you can get it to work its much easier since the place is on the 5th floor

Excellent, excellent, excellent!  Wonderfully appointed home had everything one would need for a lovely stay!  The hosts were incredibly gracious and responsive.  Safe, ultra-convenient location that had us feeling like locals.  We would happily stay again if ever in Paris!  Our family of four highly recommends this home!
Our family of four just left Highstay and had a wonderful time! Beautiful and comfortable unit and appreciated the amenities and servicing of the apartment. Would recommend and stay again!

Very nice modern apartment in a very safe and vibrant community located perfectly for easy access to most Parisian sights and activities! Emerald was a helpful host and kept a very clean apartment with brand new appliances and bathroom.

A great stay!! Super good location, close to the Eiffel Tower, good shopping, quiet, and safe. The apartment was clean and perfect for our weekend stay. The only problem we had was figuring out the shower but that was just user error!

Sidonie was an amazing host, we stayed a week and felt right at home.  Sidonie was so welcoming and went above and beyond to make us cosy. Location was very central, easy to get around via walking/subway. Secure building access, but located on top of a bar, so could get a little noisy on occasion, but nothing that bothered us. We loved our stay.

We had a fantastic stay at Karine's. She was very helpful and communicative before and during our stay. Great house to share on a lovely private alleyway. Easy to get around the city via the local metro stops. Would recommend!

We had a wonderful stay in Paris and Jean-Francois' apartment! Our Mother had stayed previously, loved it so much, and insisted we stay too - we were so glad we did.   The location is fantastic, within walking distance to the metro and surrounded by charming cafes and great restaurants.  Jean-Francois was incredibly kind, welcoming and full of helpful tips which made our visit even better.Highly recommend!

Had a great stay at Julien’s place. The room was small but very clean and well-organized – perfect for a short stay. The area is beautiful, with lots of small shops and great food options. Communication with Julien was quick and easy. I really appreciated the responsiveness and smooth process. Would definitely recommend!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is beautiful and perfectly situated by the canal. The host was exceptionally responsive and helpful throughout. I’ll definitely be recommending this place to friends and family.

I would 1000% stay at Kaza Bella again. It’s location was perfect . We checked out so many nice local spots in the neighborhood that were walking distance.  The home itself is luxurious and modern. A nice sanctuary in the city. The hosts were exceptional and clearly very experienced in property management and cultivating guest experiences.  They even offered complimentary cleaning and refreshment of the amenities during our stay which I thought was a standout offering compared to other hosts. It’ll be hard to unsee this level of comfort in the next space I travel to!

Stayed here for 3 days. The stay was absolutely delightful, Cedric was the best host that we have stayed with by far. Apart from the obvious things of being clean and resourceful, beautiful home and accessible metro station, Cedric goes out every day at 7:30 am and gets wonderful croissants for each one of his guests, sets up a wonderful breakfast table and is right there to just give you enough company while you have your breakfast!! Makes you feel so welcomed! Highly recommend

Very well appointed accommodation in a good neighbourhood, lots of bars / pubs and restaurants open till late. Near to Grands Boulevards metro station as well. Apartment is very well-renovated with everything you need from showering to cooking. Lovely place for our kids to stay and there was more than enough space in the apartment.
The location is good. Nearby to tram And Metro. The area is quiet and beautiful. Our host is super friendly.

The apartment is modern and very clean. The bed was comfortable and the TV options very good. Pascal was very informative with local restaurants and updated Notre Dame information. He was very responsive. Unfortunately, we did not sleep well any night due to how hot it was and only one small fan available for 4 people. We had to alternate nightly between the room and the family room. We opened the windows but the wind did not blow at all and it was very noisy early in the morning. We would stay again but definitely not in the summer!
We loved our stay in Elsa’s apartment. It is in a very beautiful location, walking distance to the amazing cafes, bars and restaurants of the isles and of course, Notre Dame. Thanks Elsa!
We really enjoyed our stay at Eleanor’s place. The location was great with lots to do around and lots of nice food spots. Would recommend!
This rental was very conveniently located with plenty of restaurants and groceries available. Antoine was friendly and helpful and responded to our questions promptly.

Great location. Was kind of surprised when we saw the infamous Emily in Paris restaurant right on the doorstep. Very vibrant area, the place itself was giving typical Parisian vibes and gave us a very unique experience. Daniel was very prompt with his responses and made our stay effortless.

Fantastic location and easy to walk to restaurants, cafes and shops as well as a market on the corner. Close to metro and easy to get taxi. Julien was very patient (was traveling with older family) and explained everything clearly. Communication was excellent. He provided bottles of water and basics to ensure we were comfortable at check in. Thank you.
Great and clean apartment with good location. Just a little bit noisy in the night because it is close to the road.
have stayed here before and everything was great. This time there were dirty towels and the bed hadn’t been made

The stay was very nice. It was walking distance from everywhere I had to be and comfortable enough for going back home at night. Hope to come by again if I have to be in Paris. Thank you for everything Ben and Ilan.

Patrick was amazing with his instructions and very helpful. Cedric was a great driver too.Fuse blew in kitchen when I tried to wash clothes and cook in oven and hob but solved that problem by eating out. 😆

As a solo traveler I really liked the locations felt safe. The apartment was the right size for me and decorated beautifully Jesse was amazing with excellent communication and support when needed. I would’ve loved the apartment to be a little more cleaner as there was hairs on the floor but apart from that loved my stay

Good spot for a night's accommodation, the loft was clean when we arrived, had everything we needed, plus some great views to boot. Just be aware of the negatives that arise as inevitabilities of a property like this. For example, I'm 6'3", so the ceilings of this Parisian loft definitely weren't the most comfortable for me, but they were just fine for my 5'5" girlfriend! The stairs can also be an annoyance after a long day of walking around, especially since they can be uneven at times. Again, these are all unavoidable issues that are inherent to this type of property, not shortcomings to this specific listing.The only thing I would ask to be improved is the shower curtain, which is effectively useless since water can splash right through. We ended up with a pretty significant water puddle as a result. Otherwise, the listing was great and served our purposes well, thanks!
Julia was indeed a superhost!!! She was responsive and clear on directions. Her place was perfect and the location truly made Paris feel like home.
Beautiful location and beautiful apartment. There was AC which was phenomenal as we arrived during a significant heat wave. The apartment is delightful and very spacious.

This place was perfect for my girlfriend and me for our week-long stay in Paris.  It’s a few minutes from several metro stops and it’s in an area with many restaurants and several grocery stores.  Very safe, peaceful and culturally diverse neighborhood.  The apartment itself is just as shown and described in the listing.  It has everything you’d need to be comfortable.  We messed up and didn’t follow the check-in instructions so we ended up at the wrong building, but Benoit was very understanding and came to pick us up by car.  We also locked the keys in the apartment by accident one day, and Benoit arranged to have us let back in within an hour.  I highly recommend this place if you’re planning a stay near Nation in Paris.

this was a nice easy stay for me and my girlfriend during our time in Paris! It was a bit hot inside with no A/C, but we also were there on the hottest day of the year. otherwise everything was great. easy walk ability to Montmartre

Monique and her husband were wonderful host. I really appreciated for their help during my journey.The house is amazing, located in the center of city, very safe, and the room is quiet and tidy, also with a good view. The restaurants and shops nearby are also good, I can get whatever I want. I had a good week here. :)

This was the ideal spot to spend two weeks in  Paris. The location is perfect to walk everywhere & then also close to a multiple metro lines if you don't have the energy. JM was a super proactive host, even bringing extra fans during a heatwave without us even asking.  would hope to stay here again the next time we're in town.
This is a perfect little hideaway in the middle of Paris. It is a typical, attic-floor space and feels very traditional. The view is amazing - you will not get better.
The apartment was really clean and close to the city center! Our family had a wonderful experience staying here!

This apartment is so much more beautiful than the photos convey. The island is equally as special. Not only is it close to everything, but it has so many amazing places to explore. Of all the places I’ve stayed in Paris, I think this is my new favorite.

Very nice walkable apartment with comfortable beds (including sofa bed),good air conditioning, clean facilities and all required amenities. Host was also flexible and met us early when we needed to enter an hour early to drop bags.

A bijou of an apartment in a charming neighbourhood with a wide selection of eateries, artisan bakeries and outlets offering fresh, quality produce.The accommodation is both comfortable & quiet with every amenity at hand for a relaxing stay.Its location is perfect - Montmartre is easily accessible on foot & Moulin Rouge is just a 10 mins walk away - with excellent transport links for wider sightseeing opportunities in the city and beyond.The host, Anne, is prompt and precise in her communications and her welcoming touch is just lovely.Thank you for a delightful stay 🙂
I had a lovely stay at Philippe and Antonie's charming flat!  It's is in a wonderful location. Checking in and out was easy. And they are communicative and responsive hosts.

The Passy neighborhood was great. Everything was in walking distance; grocery, wine, cafes, Metro, coffee shop.  Living area was comfortable, bedrooms spacious and kitchen well stocked.  Overall a great stay.

Arianne is by far the most responsive and helpful host I've had in all my Airbnb stays. Thank you, Arianne, for the recommendations, the help, and most of all - the top notch hospitality and kindness as we explored Paris.Arianne's home indeed feels like a away from home as every detail and amenity is thought through from entryway to kitchen to bedrooms to bathrooms. The use of space is commendable for it's comfort and decorated with gorgeous, unique art. Arianne's home is very close to a myriad of shops, cafes, restaurants, and metro stops. The Notre Dame is mere blocks away. You cannot go wrong with this home or location for a stress-free and cosmopolitan stay in Paris.
Very Nice appartment and nice host easy to communicate with her she is super reactiveappartment very clean will be back
Absolutely adorable apartment. We felt right at home. Peggy was always responsive to our needs, helpful and accommodating. A wonderful experience for our first Airbnb stay

Great location for sure! Very clean, has all you need. Safe option for a short stay. The downside is that only a living room has a real window to the outside, the two bedrooms have “windows” to the living room.

Highly recommend! But please pay attention to the apartments being on 6th floor - it’s mentioned in description and Marie also made sure that I know about it before booking.Apartments were great, very clean, had everything needed. Located closely to bus/metro station, neighborhood itself is also very walkable.

For 6 people, this was a very comfortable and open living space. The bathrooms were clean, and the shower pressure was amazing! The area was big enough to house 6 people, including luggage & souvenirs! I recommend this AirB&B!!!
Amazing place. We had a great time. Everything is clean and new. And the host took great care of us. Thank you

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was spotlessly clean, very comfortable, and in a fantastic location — surrounded by shops, restaurants, and everything you could need. The coffee was great, and we really appreciated how easy everything was, from check-in to check-out. Communication with the host was smooth and helpful throughout. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Paris!Joaquin A.

Fantastic stay in Paris!The apartment was clean, stylish, and perfectly located near Tour Eiffel . Domus was friendly and responsive, and check-in was super easy. I’d definitely stay here again — highly recommended!

This place is accurately described and provides a place to crash while exploring Paris. It's nothing extravagant and is rather small, about the size of a hotel suite. But the space has everything provided that is necessary, and it was clean. It's right next to Gare de Lyon, which is super convenient.

We had a very nice stay. Chokris small apartment is centrally located among small shops and stores. Communication was quick and friendly, and we were even allowed to check out an hour or two later, which was very helpful. We can only recommend this apartment.

Beautiful luxury apartment in a great location. It was very clean and comfortable for our family of four. The host was great and the service was excellent. We recommend and would definitely stay again.

Good place for 1, location, cleaniness are both good. The host is fairly responsive. The problem with the place is that the bathroom fan makes loud noises and runs 24:7 and will turn itself on 10 minutes after you turn it off, which made my sleep less pleasant.Other than that, it’s a good place. 4/5.

Absolutely lovely stay! The apartment was spacious, clean, and very well maintained. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the bathtub was a perfect way to relax after a long day of walking around Paris. The living room was tastefully decorated, and the couch was so plush and cozy. The location couldn’t be better, wonderfully walkable with tons of great food options and charming brasseries nearby. Highly recommend checking out “Big Black Cook” an amazing, underrated spot just around the corner. Truly a 10/10 experience. Would definitely stay here again!

We (2 adults, 2 older kids) had a great stay in this apartment.  If felt more like a hotel stay than an AirBnB.  It has a sofa bed and a bed. Loved the little table, fridge and microwave for our baguette and croissant breakfasts.  The location is great.  We chose it because it is an easy walk from the train from CdG (Les Halles station), so no need for metro once you've arrived with your luggage if you can do a 10 minute walk. The street is quiet, the lobby is welcoming with someone there to.   We walked everywhere and it is close to two main metro lines. We especially enjoyed rue Montorgeuil that had endless food choices, cafés and people watching.  Brijid sent us recommendations, clear instructions and when I had a question, she answered instantly.  I hope to return one day.
Had a wonderful time with my mother and daughter!  The place was perfect and in a great location for sight seeing.

We had a truly wonderful stay at Marie’s beautiful apartment on Rue Custine in Paris 💫 From the moment we stepped in, we were charmed by the elegant and artistic design — the rich tones, vintage touches, and mural wall gave the space such a cozy, Parisian flair. It felt like a boutique hideaway tucked right into the heart of the city!The location couldn’t have been better, just a short stroll from Montmartre and Sacré-Cœur, with cafés, bakeries, and metro stations all nearby. It was the perfect base to explore the city, but also a peaceful retreat to come back to after a long day of wandering.Every detail was thoughtfully curated, and Marie was a fantastic host.. responsive, warm, and helpful. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for an authentic and stylish Paris experience 🇫🇷🖤✨

Absolutely amazing Airbnb!! One of my favorites ever! The location was perfect. It was on a quiet side street, so we slept well, but it was still just steps to everything! We could easily walk to so many fun and historic things (including the Eiffel Tower and Champ de Mars), and there were countless restaurants just down the street. The apartment is on the ground floor, so getting our luggage inside was easy. The apartment is inside a secure entryway with double doors, but the area feels safe. Our host, Patrick, greeted us and helped us inside, ensuring we had everything we needed. He also arranged our airport transportation for us, and the car service was super nice. The space itself was clean and well-stocked. The beds were comfortable, the bathroom was spacious, and it was nice to be able to do laundry. Thank you to Patrick for this awesome experience. Cannot wait to return!!

I stayed here with my two young children for the summer, and the location couldn’t have been better. It’s just a short walk to Place de la Concorde and the Tuileries Garden, and getting to the Grand Palais and the Louvre was incredibly easy. The host was proactive and thoughtful—he even offered to store our luggage before check-in and after check-out if needed. We didn’t end up needing it, but really appreciated the kind gesture.

UnbeatableLocation & Great Hosts!  Able to walk to all the sites within 15-20 minutes and located near the Metro. Many bustling restaurants on the street with multiple markets.  The layout enabled great privacy between the two bedrooms..

Our family of 4 had a great stay. Very central location, walkable to many sightseeing options. Washer/dryer in unit was very helpful. Lots of eateries right outside the door. We encountered an unpleasant situation with a car rental on our check out day and the host was very flexible and understanding.

David and Marie's place was clean, spacious, and well-located. David was proactive with communication, was quick to respond to queries, and allowed us to check-in much earlier than the official time. Loved that the bathroom was separate from the toilet. Loved the high-end appliances (although it did make me feel a bit anxious about breaking things, but that's on me, it's clear from the pictures what was being provided). Loved the location, too; quiet but close to tourist attractions and surrounded by stores (my family really enjoyed the Passy Plaza and the big Monoprix inside). Thank you, David and Marie, for sharing your home with us!

Our family of four had a wonderful stay at Bruno's apartment, which was in a wonderful, walkable neighbor full of shops, parks, cafes, and restaurants. The space was roomy and as described. There is a strong use of incense/fragrances which may not bother some, but if you are sensitive to strong smells it's worth checking with the host before arrival. It was a wonderful stay in Paris, Bruno and Sacha were helpful and kind (and able to orient us in English), and we'd recommend it to others and happily stay again.
clean and well maintained apartment in an excellent location.  Very close to Gare de Lyon for easy transit to anywhere in Paris.  Marlène was a excellent host who with great communication.

Beautiful apartment! Squeaky clean, and all essentials provided. The bed and the pillows were very comfortable.Fantastic location in The Marais area of Paris. Restaurants, cafes and good shopping all around. The metro a 5 minute walk from the apartment. Honestly a great place to stay!
The view, the location, and the amenities were key to a great home base while we stayed in Paris for 10 days. We would want to stay at this same place every time we visit Paris if it was possible!
Paul was an amazing host and very helpful. The place was amazing with good lighting and secure. Very easy to move around the neighborhood.
No mirror in apartmentVery small apartment hard to  place baggage in a roomCheck in very late

A real treat to stay in such an elegant Paris apartment. Highly recommended. It was not just a centrally located place to stay but part of the Paris experience spending time in such a beautiful home.Everything is as described. The only negative is such a classic building doesn’t have AC, and the list of do’s and dont’s is a little oppressive.But would return in a heartbeat

Everything was perfect. The apartment was great. Antoine was always available for any question  we had with a prompt answer and very good tips. It was a great stay and we would love come back next time in Paris. Thanks Antoine

The apartment was fabulous and in a great location. It was spotlessly clean and beautifully furnished. The local bakery was divine and there were lots of places to eat and drink close by and some more great places further up the canal! Vincent was a great host and gave us some great recommendations for our stay. We would definitely stay here again.

Amazing, unbeatable location! You can walk out and find lots of places to eat and walk around. The place was clean, convenient and comfortable. Host was easy to communicate with, and we all enjoyed our stay here.

Jean-Luc’s place was great. The location was  ideal and perfect for walking to the local sites. The square that the apartment was located was quiet and tucked away which was ideal. Highly recommend for families. Would definitely stay again!

Great place to stay for a few nights! Was a bit further than expected from main attractions but the metro was right down the street and made traveling around easy. Great host with great recommendations!

Great location in Paris. Lots of restaurants nearby and easy access to public transportation. Just understand that this apartment and bathroom are very small and you will have to climb two flights of stairs to access the apartment. This is a good spot for a solo traveler, but would be tight even for two people.
This is a very cool, uniquely furnished apartment. It’s very clean, well appointed and feels very secure. It’s in a great location, near the metro with a number of nice bars and cafes nearby.

I do not even know where to begin! Traveled solo and it was perfect! The views was beautiful to wake up to and get ready in front of.  Will definitely come back in the future. Cannot recommend it enough!! Also everything is walkable distance from there!

This beautiful, bright and charming apartment is perfect for a Paris getaway! We felt right at home and enjoyed our stay very much. The location was also great, with the Metro, bakeries, restaurants and shops all within walking distance. Yet the apartment was quiet because it faces the backyard. I would definitely recommend it.

Wonderful stay! The apartment is in a perfect location, in a beautiful and safe neighborhood. Very quiet in the courtyard, clean, and overall just a really pleasant place. A great find—I’d be excited to come back next month.
